# file opened: zpolice.asm
   1  0000              ;==============================================================================
   2  0000              ; Z-POLICE  -  3D vector city flight for the ZX Spectrum Next
   3  0000              ;
   4  0000              ;  Z80N assembler (sjasmplus --zxnext).  Layer 2 256x192x8bpp, double buffered.
   5  0000              ;  The 3D viewport is the top 256x128; the bottom third is an instrument panel.
   6  0000              ;  Maths: world positions are 16-bit integers (one city cell = 256 units),
   7  0000              ;         trig values are S7.8 fixed point (1.0 = $0100).
   8  0000              ;  Hidden line removal: painter's algorithm. Buildings are walked over the
   9  0000              ;  grid far-to-near (no sort needed). Each visible face is filled in its
  10  0000              ;  shade (roof lighter, side turned away darker) and optionally outlined, so
  11  0000              ;  nearer buildings overwrite those behind them. Faces with every corner on
  12  0000              ;  screen use cached projections; faces crossing the view frustum are
  13  0000              ;  clipped in 3D (Sutherland-Hodgman, 5 planes). Rasterisation then only
  14  0000              ;  ever sees on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
  15  0000              ;
  16  0000              ;  Controls: Q/A speed up/down   Z air brake O/P turn left/right
  17  0000              ;            W/S climb/descend   E/D nose up/down
  18  0000              ;            SPACE fire          1-5 select weapon slot
  19  0000              ;            0 change the centre slot's weapon
  20  0000              ;
  21  0000              ;  Source files: zpolice.asm (resident main code), memory_bank_defs.asm
  22  0000              ;  (slots and pages).  Game logic pages, swapped into slot 6 at $C000:
  23  0000              ;  player.asm (input/movement), weapons.asm, menu.asm (main menu).  Core
  24  0000              ;  function pages, swapped into slot 7 at $E000: city.asm (Layer 2
  25  0000              ;  drawing), hud.asm (ULA HUD), input.asm (redefinable keys, joysticks), sprites.asm
  26  0000              ;  (hardware sprites).  Always mapped: zombie.asm at $2000, human.asm and
  27  0000              ;  map.asm (the city map) at $7000.
  28  0000              ;
  29  0000              ;  Memory while running:
  30  0000              ;    $0000-$1FFF  Layer 2 back buffer, one 8K section at a time (slot 0)
  31  0000              ;    $2000-$3FFF  zombie page (slot 1)
  32  0000              ;    $4000-$7FFF  occlusion data; cell colours, humans, map (slots 2-3)
  33  0000              ;    $8000-$9FFF  ULA screen (slot 4)
  34  0000              ;    $A000-$BFFF  resident code, tables, variables, stack (slot 5)
  35  0000              ;    $C000-$DFFF  game logic page (slot 6)
  36  0000              ;    $E000-$FFFF  core function page (slot 7)
  37  0000              ;==============================================================================
  38  0000
  39  0000                      DEVICE ZXSPECTRUMNEXT
  40  0000                      SLDOPT COMMENT WPMEM, LOGPOINT, ASSERTION
  41  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
  42  0000 ~                    CSPECTMAP "release_tmp/zpolice.map"
  43  0000                  ELSE
  44  0000                      CSPECTMAP zpolice.map
  45  0000                  ENDIF
  46  0000                      OPT --zxnext=cspect --syntax=a --reversepop
  47  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48  0000              ; Build options
  49  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  50  0000              ; RELEASE: the build for players (-DRELEASE: build.bat release).  Turns off
  51  0000              ; everything for testing, whatever is set below: the DEBUG_ settings, DRAW_FPS
  52  0000              ; and DOTS_ALL, a START_LEVEL_SET, a START_SALVAGE.  It's assembled into
  53  0000              ; release_tmp/, so the debug build's files (and the tests') stay as they are.
  54  0000
  55  0000              ; REAL_HARDWARE: the build for a real Next (-DREAL_HARDWARE: build.bat
  56  0000              ; hardware), which may use DMA+ (the zxnDDMA, the blitter of core 3.03.00, see
  57  0000              ; layer2_cls.asm).  Off, the DMA routines use only the plain zxnDMA, as CSpect
  58  0000              ; doesn't have DMA+ yet.  The .nex then also asks for core 3.03.00: on an older
  59  0000              ; core DMA+'s commands would be misread, not ignored.
  60  0000                      ;DEFINE REAL_HARDWARE
  61  0000                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE                 ; (said in the build's output)
  62  0000                      DISPLAY "REAL_HARDWARE set: the build for a real Next (DMA+, core 3.03.00 or later)"
  63  0000                  ELSE
  64  0000 ~                    DISPLAY "REAL_HARDWARE not set: the CSpect build (plain zxnDMA, no DMA+)"
  65  0000                  ENDIF
  66  0000
  67  0000              ; DRAW_LINES: outline building faces with EDGE_COL vectors.  Comment it out for solid-colour buildings only; the HUD
  68  0000              ; is always drawn.  Can also be set from the command line: -DDRAW_LINES
  69  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_LINES
  70  0000
  71  0000              ; WAIT_FOR_VBLANK: wait for the raster to leave the display area before
  72  0000              ; flipping the Layer 2 buffers (no tearing).  Comment it out to flip as soon
  73  0000              ; as a frame is drawn: faster, but the flip may tear mid-screen.
  74  0000              ; Command line: -DWAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  75  0000                      ;DEFINE WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  76  0000
  77  0000              ; DRAW_FPS: measure frames per second from the raster (vtick) and show it at
  78  0000              ; the top left of the ULA screen.  Comment it out to drop the measuring and
  79  0000              ; the display.  Command line: -DDRAW_FPS
  80  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_FPS
  81  0000
  82  0000              ; SKY_IS_WALL: the camera can never rise above the perimeter wall, so fill
  83  0000              ; the sky in the wall's colour and draw wall cells only up to camera height
  84  0000              ; (their top edge is then exactly the horizon).  No sky is ever seen.
  85  0000              ; Command line: -DSKY_IS_WALL
  86  0000                      DEFINE SKY_IS_WALL
  87  0000
  88  0000              ; OCCLUSION_CULL: in level flight, record the buildings, then cull those
  89  0000              ; completely hidden behind nearer ones (a per-column cover buffer, front to
  90  0000              ; back) before drawing the rest.  Uses pages PAGE_OCC0/1 at $4000-$7FFF.
  91  0000              ; Command line: -DOCCLUSION_CULL
  92  0000                      DEFINE OCCLUSION_CULL
  93  0000
  94  0000              ; OCC_PITCHED: OCCLUSION_CULL pitched too, up to OCC_PMAX (18, city2.asm;
  95  0000              ; past it the plain way).  Pitched, occ_pretest has bounds of its own
  96  0000              ; (occ_pretest.pit), and a building covers only the columns of both its top
  97  0000              ; and bottom corners (its vertical edges lean).  Pixel-identical (124 random
  98  0000              ; pitched views; test_render.py checks 16 against the painter's path).
  99  0000              ; Comment it out for level flight only.  Command line: -DOCC_PITCHED
 100  0000                      DEFINE OCC_PITCHED
 101  0000
 102  0000              ; LEVEL_FAST_PATH: while pitch is 0 (level flight) a building's top corners
 103  0000              ; have the same camera X and Z as the bottom corners below them, so each top
 104  0000              ; corner reuses its bottom corner's screen x and 1/Z and only works out its
 105  0000              ; screen y.  Comment it out to project every corner in full.
 106  0000              ; Command line: -DLEVEL_FAST_PATH
 107  0000                      DEFINE LEVEL_FAST_PATH
 108  0000
 109  0000              ; CLIP_2D: a face that crosses only the screen's sides, top or bottom, and is
 110  0000              ; within a guard band (|X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z), has its corners projected to
 111  0000              ; 16-bit screen coordinates and is clipped against the screen in 2D, not in
 112  0000              ; 3D (no new points to project, one multiply per new point, not three).
 113  0000              ; Faces crossing the near plane, or outside the guard band, are clipped in
 114  0000              ; 3D as before.  Comment it out to clip every face in 3D.
 115  0000              ; Command line: -DCLIP_2D
 116  0000                      DEFINE CLIP_2D
 117  0000
 118  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
 119  0000 ~                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
 120  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DRAW_FPS
 121  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 122  0000 ~                  IFDEF DOTS_ALL
 123  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DOTS_ALL
 124  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 125  0000 ~                  IFDEF START_LEVEL_SET
 126  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE START_LEVEL_SET
 127  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 128  0000                  ENDIF

# file opened: memory_bank_defs.asm
   1+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 0000              ; Z-POLICE - memory bank definitions
   3+ 0000              ;
   4+ 0000              ; The Next maps its RAM into the Z80's 64K as eight 8K MMU slots, each set by
   5+ 0000              ; a NextReg ($50-$57) to an 8K page (page n = half of 16K bank n/2).  This
   6+ 0000              ; file names the slots, their registers and addresses, what each slot is
   7+ 0000              ; used for, and which page holds what.  Use:
   8+ 0000              ;   nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY            ; page the city code in at $E000
   9+ 0000              ;   MMU CODE_SLOT e, PAGE_CITY, CODE_ADDR ; (sjasmplus) assemble into it
  10+ 0000              ;
  11+ 0000              ; Memory map (see README.md):
  12+ 0000              ;   slot 0 $0000  Layer 2 sections (32 rows each) while drawing; the sine
  13+ 0000              ;                 table (PAGE_SIN) whenever get_sin reads it
  14+ 0000              ;   slot 1 $2000  zombie page, always mapped: zombies, humans, the HUD
  15+ 0000              ;                 map, the IM 2 table
  16+ 0000              ;   slot 2 $4000  occlusion data; the 320x256 graphics (PAGE_L320) on the
  17+ 0000              ;                 screens outside the game
  18+ 0000              ;   slot 3 $6000  the city bank (always mapped): city_col at $6000,
  19+ 0000              ;                 city_map at $7000, loaded from the level's city file
  20+ 0000              ;   slot 4 $8000  ULA screen (page 10, the first half of bank 5)
  21+ 0000              ;   slot 5 $A000  resident main code, variables, stack (page 11, the unused
  22+ 0000              ;                 second half of bank 5)
  23+ 0000              ;   slot 6 $C000  game logic pages, swapped: player, weapons, menus, level
  24+ 0000              ;                 loading
  25+ 0000              ;   slot 7 $E000  core function pages, swapped: city (Layer 2 drawing), HUD,
  26+ 0000              ;                 keys, sprites; a sprite bank while it is loaded; the
  27+ 0000              ;                 start-up set-up (initialise.asm) once
  28+ 0000              ; So game logic in slot 6 can call any core page in slot 7: main_loop pages
  29+ 0000              ; the keys in at $E000 while the player and weapons pages run at $C000.
  30+ 0000              ; At start-up the NEX loader's default mapping is in place (slot 6 = page
  31+ 0000              ; 0), so the entry point is a stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000 (boot, zpolice.asm)
  32+ 0000              ; that maps the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
  33+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
  34+ 0000
  35+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  36+ 0000              ; MMU slots: number, NextReg, address
  37+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  38+ 0000              MEMBANK_SIZE            equ $2000       ; 8K a slot / page
  39+ 0000
  40+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0              equ 0
  41+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1              equ 1
  42+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2              equ 2
  43+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3              equ 3
  44+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4              equ 4
  45+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5              equ 5
  46+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6              equ 6
  47+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7              equ 7
  48+ 0000
  49+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER     equ $50
  50+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER     equ $51
  51+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER     equ $52
  52+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER     equ $53
  53+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER     equ $54
  54+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER     equ $55
  55+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER     equ $56
  56+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER     equ $57
  57+ 0000
  58+ 0000              membank0                equ $0000
  59+ 0000              membank1                equ $2000
  60+ 0000              membank2                equ $4000
  61+ 0000              membank3                equ $6000
  62+ 0000              membank4                equ $8000
  63+ 0000              membank5                equ $A000
  64+ 0000              membank6                equ $C000
  65+ 0000              membank7                equ $E000
  66+ 0000
  67+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  68+ 0000              ; What each slot is used for: <use>_SLOT, <use>_MMU (its NextReg) and
  69+ 0000              ; <use>_ADDR (the ORG of code or data assembled for it)
  70+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  71+ 0000              ; slot 0: one 32-row section of a Layer 2 buffer at a time (seg_map etc.)
  72+ 0000              L2SEC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_0
  73+ 0000              L2SEC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  74+ 0000              L2SEC_ADDR              equ membank0
  75+ 0000              ; slot 0 also: the sine table, paged in by get_sin (resident).  Only the
  76+ 0000              ; game logic calls it, never the drawing, and every Layer 2 writer maps its
  77+ 0000              ; own section first, so the two never meet.  Nothing may write to
  78+ 0000              ; $0000-$1FFF while it is mapped.
  79+ 0000              SIN_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_0
  80+ 0000              SIN_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  81+ 0000              SIN_ADDR                equ membank0
  82+ 0000
  83+ 0000              ; slot 1: zombie.asm, human.asm, map.asm, interrupts.asm, always mapped
  84+ 0000              ZOMBIE_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_1
  85+ 0000              ZOMBIE_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER
  86+ 0000              ZOMBIE_ADDR             equ membank1
  87+ 0000
  88+ 0000              ; slot 2: occlusion buffer, draw list and building records (OCCLUSION_CULL)
  89+ 0000              OCC_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_2
  90+ 0000              OCC_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  91+ 0000              OCC_ADDR                equ membank2
  92+ 0000              ; slot 2 also: the 320x256 Layer 2 graphics (layer2-320x256.asm), for the
  93+ 0000              ; screens outside the game (menus, load-out, level complete, game over),
  94+ 0000              ; which never draw the city.  The occlusion page goes back before the game
  95+ 0000              ; (l2_game_mode).
  96+ 0000              L320_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_2
  97+ 0000              L320_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  98+ 0000              L320_ADDR               equ membank2
  99+ 0000
 100+ 0000              ; slot 3: the city bank, always mapped: city_col at $6000, city_map at
 101+ 0000              ; $7000, read from the level's city file (level_load.asm) in one go
 102+ 0000              TABLES_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_3
 103+ 0000              TABLES_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER
 104+ 0000              TABLES_ADDR             equ membank3            ; city_col
 105+ 0000              CITYMAP_ADDR            equ membank3+$1000      ; city_map
 106+ 0000
 107+ 0000              ; slot 4: the ULA screen (bank 5's first 8K: bitmap and attributes)
 108+ 0000              ULA_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_4
 109+ 0000              ULA_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 110+ 0000              ULA_ADDR                equ membank4
 111+ 0000              ; slot 4 also: the second city page (city2.asm), over the ULA screen while
 112+ 0000              ; main_loop draws the city (nothing then uses the ULA screen)
 113+ 0000              CITY2_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_4
 114+ 0000              CITY2_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 115+ 0000              CITY2_ADDR              equ membank4
 116+ 0000
 117+ 0000              ; slot 5: resident main code (zpolice.asm), tables, variables, stack
 118+ 0000              MAIN_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_5
 119+ 0000              MAIN_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER
 120+ 0000              MAIN_ADDR               equ membank5
 121+ 0000
 122+ 0000              ; slot 6: game logic pages, swapped (player, weapons, menu)
 123+ 0000              LOGIC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_6
 124+ 0000              LOGIC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER
 125+ 0000              LOGIC_ADDR              equ membank6
 126+ 0000              ; slot 6 at start-up: the boot stub (the NEX loader maps page 0 there)
 127+ 0000              BOOT_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_6
 128+ 0000              BOOT_ADDR               equ membank6
 129+ 0000
 130+ 0000              ; slot 7: core function pages, swapped (city / Layer 2, HUD, keys, sprites)
 131+ 0000              CODE_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_7
 132+ 0000              CODE_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 133+ 0000              CODE_ADDR               equ membank7
 134+ 0000              ; slot 7 also: a sprite pattern bank (sprite_data.asm), paged in to run
 135+ 0000              ; its own loader, spr_load_bank
 136+ 0000              SPRBANK_SLOT            equ MMU_SLOT_7
 137+ 0000              SPRBANK_MMU             equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 138+ 0000              SPRBANK_ADDR            equ membank7
 139+ 0000
 140+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 141+ 0000              ; 8K pages
 142+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 143+ 0000              PAGE_BOOT               equ 0           ; the NEX entry stub (slot 6 at load)
 144+ 0000              PAGE_CITY               equ 1           ; city.asm: Layer 2 drawing (slot 7)
 145+ 0000              PAGE_HUD                equ 2           ; hud.asm: ULA (Layer 1) HUD (slot 7)
 146+ 0000              PAGE_PLAYER             equ 3           ; player.asm: input, movement,
 147+ 0000                                                      ; collision (slot 6)
 148+ 0000              PAGE_WEAPONS            equ 4           ; weapons.asm: player weapons (slot 6)
 149+ 0000              PAGE_ZOMBIE             equ 5           ; zombie.asm (slot 1, always)
 150+ 0000              PAGE_OCC0               equ 6           ; occlusion buffer, draw list and
 151+ 0000                                                      ; building records (slot 2)
 152+ 0000              PAGE_OCC1               equ 7           ; the city bank: city_col and
 153+ 0000                                                      ; city_map (slot 3, always)
 154+ 0000              PAGE_MENU               equ 8           ; menu.asm: game over, game complete,
 155+ 0000                                                      ; the load error (slot 6)
 156+ 0000              PAGE_SPR0               equ 9           ; sprite_data.asm: sprite pattern
 157+ 0000                                                      ; bank 0 (slot 7 while loading);
 158+ 0000                                                      ; more banks: the next free pages
 159+ 0000              PAGE_ULA0               equ 10          ; the ULA screen, bank 5 (slot 4)
 160+ 0000              PAGE_MAIN               equ 11          ; zpolice.asm, resident (slot 5): the
 161+ 0000                                                      ; second half of bank 5
 162+ 0000              PAGE_INPUT              equ 12          ; input.asm: keyboard, joysticks (slot 7)
 163+ 0000              PAGE_SPRITES            equ 13          ; sprites.asm: hardware sprites
 164+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 7)
 165+ 0000              PAGE_SIN                equ 15          ; sin_tables.asm: the sine table
 166+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 0, read by get_sin)
 167+ 0000              PAGE_INIT               equ 14          ; initialise.asm: start-up set-up,
 168+ 0000                                                      ; initgame (slot 7, once)
 169+ 0000              PAGE_FILE               equ 16          ; file_handler.asm: SD card loading
 170+ 0000                                                      ; and saving (slot 7)
 171+ 0000              PAGE_AUDIO              equ 17          ; audio.asm: sound set-up (slot 7)
 172+ 0000              PAGE_SPECIAL            equ 31          ; specials.asm: special monsters
 173+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 6)
 174+ 0000              PAGE_LOADOUT            equ 32          ; loadout.asm: the load-out screen
 175+ 0000                                                      ; between levels (slot 6)
 176+ 0000              PAGE_KEYDEF             equ 33          ; keydef.asm: the redefine keys
 177+ 0000                                                      ; screen (slot 6)
 178+ 0000              PAGE_CITY2              equ 34          ; city2.asm: more Layer 2 drawing
 179+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 4, with the city page)
 180+ 0000              PAGE_L320               equ 35          ; layer2-320x256.asm: Layer 2 320x256
 181+ 0000                                                      ; graphics for the menu screens (slot 2)
 182+ 0000              PAGE_MAINMENU           equ 36          ; mainmenu.asm: the main menu (slot 6)
 183+ 0000              PAGE_LEVELEND           equ 37          ; levelend.asm: level complete (slot 6)
 184+ 0000              PAGE_L320_BG            equ 86          ; 86-95: a copy of a 320x256 screen's
 185+ 0000                                                      ; background (l320_bg_save), to put back
 186+ 0000                                                      ; under text that changes (l320_restore).
 187+ 0000                                                      ; Shared: the figures' last 10 pages
 188+ 0000                                                      ; (shared_pg; gfx_reload puts them back)
 189+ 0000              PAGE_GFX0               equ 38          ; the figures' graphics (pages 38-95,
 190+ 0000                                                      ; GFX_PAGES_MAX at most), loaded from
 191+ 0000                                                      ; ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG at start-up; each
 192+ 0000                                                      ; mapped at $C000 (slot 6) to draw
 193+ 0000              GFX_SHARED              equ PAGE_L320_BG - PAGE_GFX0    ; (its first shared page)
 194+ 0000              PAGE_LEVEL              equ 30          ; level_load.asm: level and city
 195+ 0000                                                      ; files (slot 6); pages 18-29 are
 196+ 0000                                                      ; the Layer 2 buffers
 197+ 0000
 198+ 0000              ; Layer 2 double buffer, in 16K banks (NextReg $12 / $13 take banks; the
 199+ 0000              ; pages are bank * 2).  Layer 2 is clipped to 192 rows, so each buffer
 200+ 0000              ; uses three banks.
 201+ 0000              L2_BANK_A               equ 9           ; 16K banks 9-11 (pages 18-23)
 202+ 0000              L2_BANK_B               equ 12          ; 16K banks 12-14 (pages 24-29)
 203+ 0000              PAGE_L2_A               equ L2_BANK_A*2
 204+ 0000              PAGE_L2_B               equ L2_BANK_B*2
 205+ 0000
 206+ 0000              PAGE_ROM                equ $FF         ; MMU value: ROM in slots 0-1

 132  0000
 133  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 134  0000              ; Tuning constants
 135  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 136  0000              ; Scale: one map tile (cell) is 20 m x 20 m = 256 world units, and one
 137  0000              ; height unit (building heights, the ceiling, the pad) is 10 m = 128 world
 138  0000              ; units.  World units are the same size on every axis, so 1 m = 12.8 units
 139  0000              ; and 1 unit = 7.8 cm.  The city is 64 x 64 tiles = 1280 m.
 140  0000              ; Speeds are per rendered frame, so real speed depends on the frame rate
 141  0000              ; (figures below are at 14 fps).
 142  0000              GRID            equ 64          ; the city is GRID x GRID tiles (gentables.py)
 143  0000              ; A city_map byte: bits 0-4 the cell code (0 road, 1-15 building height

 290  0000              ; Game time (clock_step): ticks of the 50 Hz frame interrupt (isr_ticks).
 291  0000              ; Per-frame values (speeds, steps) were tuned at ASSUMED_FPS frames a

 733  0000              ; Self-modified opcodes for the line drawer
 734  0000              OP_INC_L        equ $2C
 735  0000              OP_DEC_L        equ $2D
 736  0000              OP_INC_H        equ $24
 737  0000              OP_DEC_H        equ $25
 738  0000              ; and for scale_comp's barrel shift (the second byte, after $ED: zpatch)
 739  0000              OP_BSLA         equ $28             ; bsla de,b
 740  0000              OP_BSRL         equ $2A             ; bsrl de,b

 742  0000              ; HL = HL * GRID  (a map row offset)
 743  0000              ; DE = -DE (vproj)
 744  0000                      MACRO NEG_DE
 745  0000 ~                    xor a
 746  0000 ~                    sub e
 747  0000 ~                    ld e,a
 748  0000 ~                    sbc a,a
 749  0000 ~                    sub d
 750  0000 ~                    ld d,a
 751  0000                      ENDM
 752  0000
 753  0000              ; HL = n (>= 0), BC = R (zpatch's reciprocal for Z) -> A = round(n * 128 /
 754  0000              ; Z) as scale_comp, after its shift: n over 511 clamped; P = n_lo R / 256 +
 755  0000              ; 256 (the rounding, first: at most 65535), plus R if bit 8 of n is set (the
 756  0000              ; carry bit 16); A = bits 9-16 of P.  Uses DE.  (vproj)
 757  0000                      MACRO VP_SCALE
 758  0000 ~                    ld a,h
 759  0000 ~                    cp 2
 760  0000 ~                    jr c,$+5
 761  0000 ~                    ld hl,511
 762  0000 ~                    ld d,l
 763  0000 ~                    ld e,c
 764  0000 ~                    mul d,e                         ; n_lo Rl
 765  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 766  0000 ~                    ld d,l
 767  0000 ~                    ld e,b
 768  0000 ~                    mul d,e                         ; n_lo Rh
 769  0000 ~                    add a,e
 770  0000 ~                    ld e,a
 771  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 772  0000 ~                    adc a,1
 773  0000 ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = n_lo R / 256 + 256, carry 0
 774  0000 ~                    bit 0,h
 775  0000 ~                    jr z,$+5
 776  0000 ~                    ex de,hl
 777  0000 ~                    add hl,bc                       ; + 256 n_hi R / 256: carry = bit 16
 778  0000 ~                    ex de,hl
 779  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 780  0000 ~                    rra
 781  0000                      ENDM
 782  0000
 783  0000              ; The cell walks' call of try_cell (draw_row, occ_row), skipped for a cell
 784  0000              ; whose centre (the walk's yaw-space X, Z1 in HL', DE') is surely out of
 785  0000              ; view: in level flight |X| - Z1 >= WALK_R (outside the left or right
 786  0000              ; edge), pitched Z1 < -WALK_R (behind: no multiply by draw_bld's cull_c).
 787  0000              ; WALK_R is over draw_bld's BLD_R, so every building it skips draw_bld
 788  0000              ; would reject, and the 64 over leaves room for a figure standing at a
 789  0000              ; street cell's edge (an off-screen figure draws nothing and notes
 790  0000              ; nothing: fig_draw returns before fig_seen).  The walk still steps every
 791  0000              ; cell, so the cells drawn have the same positions.  Uses A, BC'.
 792  0000              WALK_R          equ 320
 793  0000                      MACRO WALK_TRY
 794  0000 ~                    exx
 795  0000 ~                    ld a,(pitch)
 796  0000 ~                    or a
 797  0000 ~                    jr nz,.pt
 798  0000 ~                    ld b,h
 799  0000 ~                    ld c,l
 800  0000 ~                    bit 7,b
 801  0000 ~                    jr z,.ap
 802  0000 ~                    xor a
 803  0000 ~                    sub c
 804  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 805  0000 ~                    sbc a,a
 806  0000 ~                    sub b
 807  0000 ~                    ld b,a                          ; |X|
 808  0000 ~            .ap:    ld a,c
 809  0000 ~                    sub e
 810  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 811  0000 ~                    ld a,b
 812  0000 ~                    sbc a,d
 813  0000 ~                    ld b,a                          ; |X| - Z1
 814  0000 ~                    ld a,c
 815  0000 ~                    sub low WALK_R
 816  0000 ~                    ld a,b
 817  0000 ~                    sbc a,high WALK_R
 818  0000 ~                    exx
 819  0000 ~                    jp p,.out                       ; |X| - Z1 >= WALK_R
 820  0000 ~                    jr .try
 821  0000 ~            .pt:    ld a,e
 822  0000 ~                    add a,low WALK_R
 823  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 824  0000 ~                    adc a,high WALK_R
 825  0000 ~                    exx
 826  0000 ~                    jp m,.out                       ; Z1 + WALK_R < 0
 827  0000 ~            .try:   call try_cell
 828  0000 ~            .out:
 829  0000                      ENDM
 830  0000
 831  0000                      MACRO ROWOFS
 832  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 833  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 834  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 835  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 836  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 837  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 838  0000                      ENDM
 839  0000
 840  0000              ; A building's 8 corners (vtx, 16 bytes each; index = x + 2*z + 4*top) from
 841  0000              ; corner 0, component C (0 X, 2 Y, 4 Z) at a time: v1 = v0 + vx, v3 = v1 +
 842  0000              ; vz, v2 = v0 + vz (vx, vz: vecs0, its edge vectors), and each top corner
 843  0000              ; its bottom corner + vy (vy_vec, the vertical edge).  The sums the corners
 844  0000              ; share are made once, in registers (draw_bld, city.asm).
 845  0000                      MACRO VBOX C
 846  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 847  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)                 ; vx
 848  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)               ; vz
 849  0000 ~                    push hl
 850  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 851  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 852  0000 ~                    push hl
 853  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 854  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 855  0000 ~                    ld de,(vy_vec+C)                ; vy
 856  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 857  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7 = v3 + vy
 858  0000 ~                    pop hl
 859  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 860  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5 = v1 + vy
 861  0000 ~                    pop hl
 862  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 863  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 864  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 865  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6 = v2 + vy
 866  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)
 867  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 868  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0 + vy
 869  0000                      ENDM
 870  0000              ; The same for a component of vy that is 0 (X always; Z in level flight):
 871  0000              ; each top corner is its bottom corner
 872  0000                      MACRO VBOX0 C
 873  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 874  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0
 875  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)
 876  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)
 877  0000 ~                    push hl
 878  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 879  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 880  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5
 881  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 882  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 883  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7
 884  0000 ~                    pop hl
 885  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 886  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 887  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6
 888  0000                      ENDM

 934  A061                      INCLUDE "levels.asm"            ; the current level's record
# file opened: levels.asm
   1+ A061              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A061              ; Z-POLICE - the current level's settings (resident, so any page can read
   3+ A061              ; them)
   4+ A061              ;
   5+ A061              ; level_cur holds the record of the level being played, loaded from its file
   6+ A061              ; ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL by load_level (level_load.asm).  LV_SIZE bytes:
   7+ A061              ;   +0  LV_NUM          level number
   8+ A061              ;   +1  LV_NAME         city name, 8 characters (ASCII, space padded)
   9+ A061              ;   +9  LV_ZOMBIES      number of zombies a wave (at most NZOMB)
  10+ A061              ;   +10 LV_WAVES        number of zombie waves (1..LV_MAX_WAVES)
  11+ A061              ;   +11 LV_FAST         number of fast zombies (of LV_ZOMBIES)
  12+ A061              ;   +12 LV_VIEW_R       draw distance in tiles, 2..VIEW_R (fewer: night or
  13+ A061              ;                       fog); load_level sets view_r / dot_r from it
  14+ A061              ;   +13 LV_WAVE_DATA    the special monsters of each wave, waves 1 to
  15+ A061              ;                       LV_MAX_WAVES (wave 1 is the level's start), LV_WAVE_REC
  16+ A061              ;                       bytes each:
  17+ A061              ;         +0  LV_SPECIAL_ID   LV_SPEC_SLOTS special types (SPEC_*;
  18+ A061              ;                             SPEC_NONE, 255: none in that place)
  19+ A061              ;         +5  LV_SPECIAL      how many of each (in the same places)
  20+ A061              ; The levels and their cities are made by gentables.py (ZPDATA/); a level
  21+ A061              ; file can be replaced by a hand-made one (or its text form, .TXL, edited).
  22+ A061              ;==============================================================================
  23+ A061
  24+ A061              LV_NUM          equ 0
  25+ A061              LV_NAME         equ 1
  26+ A061              LV_NAME_LEN     equ 8
  27+ A061              LV_ZOMBIES      equ LV_NAME+LV_NAME_LEN
  28+ A061              LV_WAVES        equ LV_ZOMBIES+1
  29+ A061              LV_FAST         equ LV_WAVES+1
  30+ A061              LV_VIEW_R       equ LV_FAST+1
  31+ A061              LV_WAVE_DATA    equ LV_VIEW_R+1
  32+ A061              LV_MAX_WAVES    equ 10              ; waves a level can have specials for
  33+ A061              LV_SPEC_SLOTS   equ 5               ; special types a wave
  34+ A061              LV_SPECIAL_ID   equ 0               ; (in a wave's data) the types,
  35+ A061              LV_SPECIAL      equ LV_SPEC_SLOTS   ;   then how many of each
  36+ A061              LV_WAVE_REC     equ 2*LV_SPEC_SLOTS
  37+ A061              LV_SIZE         equ LV_WAVE_DATA+LV_MAX_WAVES*LV_WAVE_REC   ; 113 bytes
  38+ A061                      ASSERT LV_SIZE == 113           ; (gentables.py writes it)
  39+ A061              ; Special monster types in the level files (specials.asm: spec_types)
  40+ A061              SPEC_GHOST      equ 0
  41+ A061              SPEC_BANSHEE    equ 1
  42+ A061              SPEC_GHOUL      equ 2
  43+ A061              SPEC_LICH       equ 3
  44+ A061              SPEC_DEVIL      equ 4               ; the final boss (devil.asm): alone, last
  45+ A061              SPEC_IDS        equ 5               ; (how many types)
  46+ A061              SPEC_CLUSTER    equ 5               ; not a monster: the wave's zombies spawn in
  47+ A061                                                  ; this many clusters (zcluster, zombie.asm)
  48+ A061                      ASSERT SPEC_CLUSTER >= SPEC_IDS ; (spec_wave skips it)
  49+ A061              SPEC_NONE       equ 255
  50+ A061
  51+ A061              ; -> HL = the current level's record
  52+ A061              level_entry:
  53+ A061 21 65 A0             ld hl,level_cur
  54+ A064 C9                   ret
  55+ A065
  56+ A065 00 00 00...  level_cur:  ds LV_SIZE                  ; the level being played (load_level)
  57+ A0D6

 103+ A147              ; Wait for the start of the next video frame (the raster reaching line 192)
 104+ A147              menu_frame:
 105+ A147 CD 52 A1     .in:    call menu_line                  ; let any current blanking end
 106+ A14A 30 FB                jr nc,.in

 111+ A152              ; Carry clear if the raster is at line 192 or later (blanking).  The line is
 112+ A152              ; read as high byte ($1E), low byte ($1F), high byte again: if the high
 113+ A152              ; byte changed in between (line 255 -> 256) the pair is torn, so read again.
 114+ A152              menu_line:

  36+ A376                                                      ; (with DDMA_FLAG_XY: X lo, X hi, Y)

  40+ A376              DDMA_B_STRIDE                equ $ef    ; 2D: then port B's stride (word)
  41+ A376              DDMA_A_EXT                   equ $d7    ; then port A address bits 23:16
  42+ A376              DDMA_B_EXT                   equ $db    ; then port B address bits 23:16
  43+ A376              DDMA_A_STRIDE                equ $eb    ; 2D: then port A's stride (word)

  48+ A376              DDMA_FLAG_FILL               equ %00001000  ; no reads: the fill value

1237  A626              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1238  A626              ; After a frame (its view shown) that started a level (WP_START: no figures
1239  A626              ; drawn if their pages are being read back) or the devil's wave (WP_DEVIL:
1240  A626              ; it isn't drawn yet): PREPARE FOR COMBAT over the view (as PAUSED is)
1241  A626              ; while
1242  A626              ;   * at a level's start, the figures' pages a screen's background copy
1243  A626              ;     (shared_pg) or the devil's graphics (devil_gfx) went over are read
1244  A626              ;     back from the figures' file (gfx_stale, gfx_reload);
1245  A626              ;   * in the devil's wave, its graphics go over the other monsters' pages
1246  A626              ;     (devil_load: from the figures' kept pages on, gfx_keep);
1247  A626              ; (one can't be read: the SD card's at fault, the load error screen), and
1248  A626              ; for WPREP_TICKS interrupts (2 s) at least from its start (isr_ticks; the
1249  A626              ; interrupts are off while the SD card is read, so a long read adds to it).
1250  A626              ; Then the box goes and the game runs.
1251  A626              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1252  A626              WPREP_ROW       equ 7               ; ULA character row and column of the box
1253  A626              WPREP_COL       equ 6
1254  A626              WPREP_TICKS     equ 100             ; at least 2 s (interrupts)
1255  A626              WP_START        equ 0               ; wave_prep bits: a level's start,
1256  A626              WP_DEVIL        equ 1               ;   the devil's wave
1257  A626              wave_prepare:
1258  A626 3A B3 A6             ld a,(wave_prep)
1259  A629 32 B4 A6             ld (wp_what),a
1260  A62C AF                   xor a
1261  A62D 32 B3 A6             ld (wave_prep),a
1262  A630 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1263  A633 22 9D 3C             ld (isr_ticks),hl               ; (one instruction: no tearing)
1264  A636 21 89 A6             ld hl,txt_wprep
1265  A639 11 06 07             ld de,WPREP_ROW<<8 | WPREP_COL
1266  A63C 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1267  A63E CD FD A0             call menu_print
1268  A641 ED 91 56 1E          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_LEVEL    ; (level_load.asm)
1269  A645 3A B4 A6             ld a,(wp_what)
1270  A648 CB 47                bit WP_START,a
1271  A64A 28 11                jr z,.dv
1272  A64C CD B5 A6             call gfx_stale                  ; pages to read back?
1273  A64F 38 05                jr c,.fresh
1274  A651 CD C1 C2             call gfx_reload
1275  A654 38 13                jr c,.err
1276  A656 AF           .fresh: xor a                           ; the figures' pages all theirs
1277  A657 32 BB A8             ld (shared_pg),a
1278  A65A 32 84 A8             ld (devil_gfx),a
1279  A65D 3A B4 A6     .dv:    ld a,(wp_what)
1280  A660 CB 4F                bit WP_DEVIL,a
1281  A662 28 0C                jr z,wp_wait
1282  A664 CD 1F C3             call devil_load                 ; its graphics over the others'
1283  A667 30 07                jr nc,wp_wait
1284  A669 ED 91 56 08  .err:   nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_MENU     ; couldn't: the SD card's at fault
1285  A66D C3 30 C1             jp load_error_screen            ; (menu.asm)
1286  A670              wp_wait:                                ; (tests: zptest skips the wait here)
1287  A670 2A 9D 3C             ld hl,(isr_ticks)
1288  A673 11 64 00             ld de,WPREP_TICKS
1289  A676 B7                   or a
1290  A677 ED 52                sbc hl,de
1291  A679 38 F5                jr c,wp_wait
1292  A67B CD 9C A7             call clock_reset                ; (no game time passed meanwhile)
1293  A67E 21 9E A6             ld hl,txt_wprep_off             ; the box gone: the view again
1294  A681 11 06 07             ld de,WPREP_ROW<<8 | WPREP_COL
1295  A684 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR
1296  A686 C3 FD A0             jp menu_print

1298  A68D 50 41 52 45
1298  A691 20 46 4F 52
1298  A695 20 43 4F 4D
1298  A699 42 41 54 20
1298  A69D 00
1299  A69E 20 20 20 20  txt_wprep_off:  db "                    ", 0
1299  A6A2 20 20 20 20
1299  A6A6 20 20 20 20
1299  A6AA 20 20 20 20
1299  A6AE 20 20 20 20
1299  A6B2 00
1300  A6B3                      ASSERT txt_wprep_off - txt_wprep == $ - txt_wprep_off
1301  A6B3 00           wave_prep:      db 0                    ; wave_prepare after this frame: bits
1302  A6B4                                                      ; WP_START, WP_DEVIL
1303  A6B4 00           wp_what:        db 0                    ; (wave_prepare: what it's for)
1304  A6B5
1305  A6B5              ; A = the first figure page to read back from the figures' file at a
1306  A6B5              ; level's start: a screen's background copy took the shared ones
1307  A6B5              ; (shared_pg), the devil's graphics went over those from the kept ones on
1308  A6B5              ; (devil_gfx, gfx_keep).  Carry set if none (or no graphics at all).
1309  A6B5              gfx_stale:
1310  A6B5 0E 3A                ld c,GFX_PAGES_MAX
1311  A6B7 3A BB A8             ld a,(shared_pg)
1312  A6BA B7                   or a

1314  A6BD 0E 30                ld c,GFX_SHARED

1320  A6C9 30 01                jr nc,.c
1321  A6CB 4F                   ld c,a
1322  A6CC 3A 82 A8     .c:     ld a,(gfx_pages)
1323  A6CF B7                   or a
1324  A6D0 37                   scf
1325  A6D1 C8                   ret z                           ; (no graphics)
1326  A6D2 3D                   dec a                           ; its last page before the first stale
1327  A6D3 B9                   cp c                            ; one: carry, none to read
1328  A6D4 79                   ld a,c
1329  A6D5 C9                   ret
1330  A6D6
1331  A6D6              ;==============================================================================
1332  A6D6              ; Frames per second, shown on the ULA layer above Layer 2.
1333  A6D6              ;
1334  A6D6              ; Interrupts stay off (the span filler borrows SP), so time is taken from the
1335  A6D6              ; raster: vtick reads the current video line and counts a new 50Hz video
1336  A6D6              ; frame whenever the line number has gone backwards.  It must be called at
1337  A6D6              ; least once per video frame (~560K T at 28MHz); the main loop and draw_cell
1338  A6D6              ; do that.  Every 50 video frames (1 second) the number of frames rendered
1339  A6D6              ; becomes the FPS figure.
1340  A6D6              ;==============================================================================
1341  A6D6                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1342  A6D6 ~            vtick:
1343  A6D6 ~                    ld bc,$243B
1344  A6D6 ~                    ld a,$1E
1345  A6D6 ~                    out (c),a
1346  A6D6 ~                    inc b
1347  A6D6 ~                    in d,(c)                        ; line MSB
1348  A6D6 ~                    dec b
1349  A6D6 ~                    ld a,$1F
1350  A6D6 ~                    out (c),a
1351  A6D6 ~                    inc b
1352  A6D6 ~                    in e,(c)                        ; line LSB
1353  A6D6 ~                    dec b
1354  A6D6 ~                    ld a,$1E
1355  A6D6 ~                    out (c),a
1356  A6D6 ~                    inc b
1357  A6D6 ~                    in a,(c)
1358  A6D6 ~                    cp d
1359  A6D6 ~                    jr nz,vtick                     ; MSB changed mid-read: try again
1360  A6D6 ~                    and 1
1361  A6D6 ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = video line 0..311
1362  A6D6 ~                    ld hl,(fps_line)
1363  A6D6 ~                    ld (fps_line),de
1364  A6D6 ~                    or a
1365  A6D6 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; previous - current
1366  A6D6 ~                    ret c
1367  A6D6 ~                    ret z
1368  A6D6 ~                    ld hl,fps_vframes               ; line went backwards: new frame
1369  A6D6 ~                    inc (hl)
1370  A6D6 ~                    ret
1371  A6D6 ~
1372  A6D6 ~            ; Once per rendered frame, after the flip
1373  A6D6 ~            fps_tick:
1374  A6D6 ~                    call vtick
1375  A6D6 ~                    ld hl,fps_count
1376  A6D6 ~                    inc (hl)
1377  A6D6 ~                    ld a,(fps_vframes)
1378  A6D6 ~                    cp 50
1379  A6D6 ~                    ret c
1380  A6D6 ~                    sub 50
1381  A6D6 ~                    ld (fps_vframes),a
1382  A6D6 ~                    ld a,(fps_count)
1383  A6D6 ~                    ld (fps_value),a
1384  A6D6 ~                    xor a
1385  A6D6 ~                    ld (fps_count),a
1386  A6D6 ~                    jp fps_draw                     ; HUD page (paged in by main_loop)
1387  A6D6                  ENDIF
1388  A6D6
1389  A6D6              ; A = NextReg number -> A = its value
1390  A6D6              read_nextreg:
1391  A6D6 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1392  A6D9 ED 79                out (c),a
1393  A6DB 04                   inc b
1394  A6DC ED 78                in a,(c)
1395  A6DE C9                   ret
1396  A6DF
1397  A6DF              ; Select the shadow Layer 2 buffer for drawing: remember the 8K page of its
1398  A6DF              ; first row.  Sections are then paged in on demand by seg_map / line_seg.
1399  A6DF              map_shadow:
1400  A6DF 3E 13                ld a,$13
1401  A6E1 CD D6 A6             call read_nextreg
1402  A6E4 87                   add a,a                         ; 16K bank -> 8K page
1403  A6E5 32 3D B6             ld (seg_base),a
1404  A6E8 C9                   ret
1405  A6E9
1406  A6E9              ; Back from the screens outside the game (320x256, layer2-320x256.asm) to
1407  A6E9              ; the game's Layer 2, 256x192 and hidden, and the occlusion page back in
1408  A6E9              ; slot 2 where the 320x256 page was.  (Nothing changes if it wasn't.)
1409  A6E9              l2_game_mode:
1410  A6E9 ED 91 52 23          nextreg L320_MMU,PAGE_L320
1411  A6ED CD 56 40             call l320_mode256
1412  A6F0 ED 91 52 06          nextreg OCC_MMU,PAGE_OCC0
1413  A6F4 C9                   ret
1414  A6F5
1415  A6F5              ; Show the shadow buffer and make the old active buffer the new shadow
1416  A6F5              l2_flip:
1417  A6F5 3E 12                ld a,$12
1418  A6F7 CD D6 A6             call read_nextreg
1419  A6FA 5F                   ld e,a                          ; old active
1420  A6FB 3E 13                ld a,$13
1421  A6FD CD D6 A6             call read_nextreg
1422  A700 ED 92 12             nextreg $12,a                   ; shadow -> active
1423  A703 7B                   ld a,e
1424  A704 ED 92 13             nextreg $13,a                   ; old active -> shadow
1425  A707 C9                   ret
1426  A708
1427  A708              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1428  A708              ; Layer 2 writes go through MMU slot 0 ($0000-$1FFF) only.  Each 8K page of
1429  A708              ; the buffer is a 32-row section, so row y is page seg_base + y/32 and its
1430  A708              ; pixels are at (y & 31)*256 + x.  Sections are paged in as drawing reaches
1431  A708              ; them.  Slots 4-5 keep the ULA screen.
1432  A708              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1433  A708
1434  A708              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1435  A708              ; Screen shake, when the VTOL hits a building (player.asm sets shake_t to
1436  A708              ; SHAKE_LEN), and heavier when a wreck hits the ground (shake_big:
1437  A708              ; SHAKE_BIG_LEN of shake_big_xy, up to 4 pixels).  Each rendered frame, as it
1438  A708              ; is shown, the Layer 2 view is offset by the next pair of the table
1439  A708              ; (shake_tab) through the scroll registers, dying away; the last pair (0, 0)
1440  A708              ; puts it back, and the table back to shake_xy.  Only
1441  A708              ; Layer 2 moves: the HUD is on the ULA.  (X wraps at 256, Y at 192: -n is
1442  A708              ; 256-n and 192-n.  An edge row or column of the view shows the far side's
1443  A708              ; meanwhile.)
1444  A708              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1445  A708              SHAKE_LEN       equ 6               ; rendered frames (about half a second)
1446  A708              SHAKE_BIG_LEN   equ 16              ; a wreck's (over a second)
1447  A708              shake_tick:
1448  A708 3A 80 A8             ld a,(shake_t)
1449  A70B B7                   or a
1450  A70C C8                   ret z
1451  A70D 21 73 A8             ld hl,fsteps                    ; (frames' worth)
1452  A710 96                   sub (hl)
1453  A711 30 01                jr nc,.k
1454  A713 AF                   xor a
1455  A714 32 80 A8     .k:     ld (shake_t),a
1456  A717 2A 7E A8             ld hl,(shake_tab)
1457  A71A 20 07                jr nz,.t
1458  A71C 11 44 A8             ld de,shake_xy                  ; (the last: the usual table again)
1459  A71F ED 53 7E A8          ld (shake_tab),de
1460  A723 87           .t:     add a,a
1461  A724 ED 31                add hl,a
1462  A726 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1463  A727 ED 92 16             nextreg $16,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
1464  A72A 23                   inc hl
1465  A72B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1466  A72C ED 92 17             nextreg $17,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
1467  A72F C9                   ret
1468  A730
1469  A730              ; The heavy shake (a wreck hitting the ground), over any going
1470  A730              shake_big:
1471  A730 21 50 A8             ld hl,shake_big_xy
1472  A733 22 7E A8             ld (shake_tab),hl
1473  A736 3E 10                ld a,SHAKE_BIG_LEN
1474  A738 32 80 A8             ld (shake_t),a
1475  A73B C9                   ret
1476  A73C
1477  A73C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1478  A73C              ; Game time.  Once a frame (main_loop) clock_step works out:
1479  A73C              ;   dt      the ticks (isr_ticks, 50 Hz) since the last frame, 0..DT_MAX
1480  A73C              ;           (at most DT_MAX: a stall doesn't jump the game);
1481  A73C              ;   fs      the frames' worth of them at ASSUMED_FPS, 8.8 (fs_tab): what
1482  A73C              ;           per-frame speeds are scaled by (fs_mul, fs_amount);
1483  A73C              ;   fsteps  whole frames' worth this frame (fs added up, fraction kept):
1484  A73C              ;           how many times a per-frame step (a key's speed change, a
1485  A73C              ;           damping step) happens this frame, 0, 1, 2 ...;
1486  A73C              ;   game_now  the game's own clock (+dt), only while it runs.
1487  A73C              ; Intervals count down by dt.  Game time only passes in main_loop: after
1488  A73C              ; anything that holds it up (a pause, PREPARE FOR COMBAT, a level's load)
1489  A73C              ; clock_reset starts the count afresh.  The tests run without interrupts:
1490  A73C              ; with clk_test set (zptest), every frame is CLK_TEST_DT ticks and one whole
1491  A73C              ; frame (fs 1.0).
1492  A73C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1493  A73C              clock_step:
1494  A73C                  IFNDEF RELEASE
1495  A73C 3A 7D A8             ld a,(clk_test)
1496  A73F B7                   or a
1497  A740 28 0A                jr z,.real
1498  A742 21 00 01             ld hl,256                       ; (a whole frame)
1499  A745 22 79 A8             ld (fsinv),hl
1500  A748 3E 04                ld a,CLK_TEST_DT
1501  A74A 18 31                jr .set
1502  A74C              .real:
1503  A74C                  ENDIF
1504  A74C CD A3 A7             call clk_read                   ; HL = isr_ticks
1505  A74F ED 5B 77 A8          ld de,(clk_last)
1506  A753 22 77 A8             ld (clk_last),hl
1507  A756 B7                   or a
1508  A757 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; ticks since (16-bit: right across
1509  A759 7C                   ld a,h                          ; the roll-over too)
1510  A75A B7                   or a
1511  A75B 20 05                jr nz,.max
1512  A75D 7D                   ld a,l
1513  A75E FE 09                cp DT_MAX+1
1514  A760 38 02                jr c,.ok
1515  A762 3E 08        .max:   ld a,DT_MAX
1516  A764 21 1F A8     .ok:    ld hl,fsinv_tab
1517  A767 ED 31                add hl,a
1518  A769 ED 31                add hl,a
1519  A76B 5E                   ld e,(hl)
1520  A76C 23                   inc hl
1521  A76D 56                   ld d,(hl)
1522  A76E ED 53 79 A8          ld (fsinv),de
1523  A772 21 0D A8             ld hl,fs_tab
1524  A775 ED 31                add hl,a
1525  A777 ED 31                add hl,a
1526  A779 5E                   ld e,(hl)
1527  A77A 23                   inc hl
1528  A77B 56                   ld d,(hl)
1529  A77C EB                   ex de,hl
1530  A77D 32 70 A8     .set:   ld (dt),a
1531  A780 22 71 A8             ld (fs),hl
1532  A783 2A 75 A8             ld hl,(game_now)
1533  A786 ED 31                add hl,a
1534  A788 22 75 A8             ld (game_now),hl
1535  A78B 2A 71 A8             ld hl,(fs)
1536  A78E 3A 74 A8             ld a,(fs_acc)                   ; whole frames: fs added up
1537  A791 85                   add a,l
1538  A792 32 74 A8             ld (fs_acc),a
1539  A795 7C                   ld a,h
1540  A796 CE 00                adc a,0
1541  A798 32 73 A8             ld (fsteps),a
1542  A79B C9                   ret
1543  A79C
1544  A79C              ; Start counting game time afresh from now (nothing passed meanwhile)
1545  A79C              clock_reset:
1546  A79C CD A3 A7             call clk_read
1547  A79F 22 77 A8             ld (clk_last),hl
1548  A7A2 C9                   ret
1549  A7A3
1550  A7A3              ; HL = isr_ticks, read whole (the interrupt may change it between the
1551  A7A3              ; bytes: read until two reads agree)
1552  A7A3              clk_read:
1553  A7A3 2A 9D 3C             ld hl,(isr_ticks)
1554  A7A6 ED 5B 9D 3C          ld de,(isr_ticks)
1555  A7AA 7D                   ld a,l
1556  A7AB BB                   cp e
1557  A7AC 20 F5                jr nz,clk_read
1558  A7AE 7C                   ld a,h
1559  A7AF BA                   cp d
1560  A7B0 20 F1                jr nz,clk_read
1561  A7B2 C9                   ret
1562  A7B3
1563  A7B3              ; HL = HL * fs >> 8: a signed per-frame amount -> this frame's (|HL| * fs
1564  A7B3              ; under 65536).  Preserves IX, IY.
1565  A7B3              fs_mul:
1566  A7B3 ED 5B 71 A8          ld de,(fs)
1567  A7B7                      ; fall through
1568  A7B7
1569  A7B7              ; HL = HL * DE >> 8: HL signed, DE an unsigned 8.8 factor under 8.0 (the
1570  A7B7              ; result under 32768).  Preserves IX, IY.
1571  A7B7              mul_88:
1572  A7B7 7C                   ld a,h
1573  A7B8 B7                   or a                            ; (S: the sign)
1574  A7B9 F5                   push af
1575  A7BA CD CA AE             call abs_hl
1576  A7BD ED 53 7B A8          ld (m88_f),de
1577  A7C1 E5                   push hl
1578  A7C2 7B                   ld a,e                          ; |x| * the factor's fraction, >> 8
1579  A7C3 55                   ld d,l
1580  A7C4 ED 30                mul d,e
1581  A7C6 4A                   ld c,d
1582  A7C7 E1                   pop hl
1583  A7C8 E5                   push hl
1584  A7C9 3A 7B A8             ld a,(m88_f)
1585  A7CC 5F                   ld e,a
1586  A7CD 54                   ld d,h
1587  A7CE ED 30                mul d,e
1588  A7D0 7B                   ld a,e
1589  A7D1 81                   add a,c
1590  A7D2 6F                   ld l,a
1591  A7D3 7A                   ld a,d
1592  A7D4 CE 00                adc a,0
1593  A7D6 67                   ld h,a
1594  A7D7 D1                   pop de                          ; + |x| * its whole part
1595  A7D8 3A 7C A8             ld a,(m88_f+1)
1596  A7DB B7                   or a
1597  A7DC 28 04                jr z,.s
1598  A7DE 19           .w:     add hl,de
1599  A7DF 3D                   dec a
1600  A7E0 20 FC                jr nz,.w
1601  A7E2 F1           .s:     pop af
1602  A7E3 F0                   ret p
1603  A7E4 C3 C3 AE             jp neg_hl
1604  A7E7
1605  A7E7              ; HL = a change over this frame -> its rate a frame (at ASSUMED_FPS):
1606  A7E7              ; HL / fs (fsinv).  Preserves IX, IY.
1607  A7E7              per_frame:
1608  A7E7 ED 5B 79 A8          ld de,(fsinv)
1609  A7EB 18 CA                jr mul_88
1610  A7ED
1611  A7ED              ; A = a per-frame amount (0..255), HL -> its fraction byte (kept between
1612  A7ED              ; frames): A = the whole units this frame (amount * fs + the fraction, the
1613  A7ED              ; new fraction kept; amount * fs under 65536).  Preserves IX, IY, BC.
1614  A7ED              fs_amount:
1615  A7ED C5                   push bc
1616  A7EE E5                   push hl
1617  A7EF 47                   ld b,a
1618  A7F0 57                   ld d,a
1619  A7F1 3A 71 A8             ld a,(fs)
1620  A7F4 5F                   ld e,a
1621  A7F5 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = amount * fraction of fs
1622  A7F7 3A 72 A8             ld a,(fs+1)
1623  A7FA 4F                   ld c,a
1624  A7FB 7A                   ld a,d
1625  A7FC 0D           .w:     dec c                           ; + amount * whole frames of fs
1626  A7FD FA 03 A8             jp m,.d
1627  A800 80                   add a,b
1628  A801 18 F9                jr .w
1629  A803 57           .d:     ld d,a                          ; DE = amount * fs, 8.8
1630  A804 E1                   pop hl
1631  A805 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1632  A806 83                   add a,e
1633  A807 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; the fraction kept
1634  A808 7A                   ld a,d
1635  A809 CE 00                adc a,0                         ; the whole units
1636  A80B C1                   pop bc
1637  A80C C9                   ret
1638  A80D
1639  A80D              ; fs for dt = 0..DT_MAX ticks: dt * ASSUMED_FPS / TICK_HZ frames, 8.8;
1640  A80D              ; and its reciprocal (0 for dt 0)
1641  A80D              fs_tab:
1642  A80D              FS_I    DEFL 0
1643  A80D                      DUP DT_MAX+1
1644  A80D 00 00       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1645  A80F             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1644  A80F 48 00       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1645  A811             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1644  A811 8F 00       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1645  A813             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1644  A813 D7 00       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1645  A815             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1644  A815 1F 01       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1645  A817             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1644  A817 66 01       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1645  A819             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1644  A819 AE 01       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1645  A81B             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1644  A81B F6 01       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1645  A81D             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1644  A81D 3D 02       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1645  A81F             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1646  A81F                      EDUP
1647  A81F              fsinv_tab:
1648  A81F 00 00                dw 0
1649  A821              FS_I    DEFL 1
1650  A821                      DUP DT_MAX
1651  A821 92 03       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1652  A823             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1651  A823 C9 01       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1652  A825             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1651  A825 31 01       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1652  A827             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1651  A827 E5 00       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1652  A829             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1651  A829 B7 00       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1652  A82B             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1651  A82B 98 00       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1652  A82D             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1651  A82D 83 00       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1652  A82F             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1651  A82F 72 00       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1652  A831             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1653  A831                      EDUP
1654  A831                      ASSERT TICK_HZ*256/ASSUMED_FPS < 8*256  ; (mul_88: under 8.0)

1849  A963              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1850  A963              ; Paused (main_loop: the pause control, K_PAUSE, BREAK or a Mega Drive pad's
1851  A963              ; START by default): PAUSED over the view, white on an opaque black ULA box,
1852  A963              ; and under it S: SAVE AND QUIT and X: QUIT, NO SAVE, until the pause control
1853  A963              ; is pressed again.  Nothing moves meanwhile and the screen keeps its last
1854  A963              ; frame.  S (fixed: only while paused) saves the game (save_game) and goes
1855  A963              ; back to the main menu; if it can't be saved, SAVE FAILED, and it stays
1856  A963              ; paused.  (Not in a wreck: nothing to save.)  X (fixed too) goes back to
1857  A963              ; the main menu without saving: the game is lost, and any save game is left
1858  A963              ; as it was.  Needs the input page in slot 7.

1933  AA4B              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1934  AA4B              ; Debug, key 9 (debug_killall, weapons.asm): pick a level.  LEVEL SELECT nn

1936  AA4B              ; Q up, A down (fixed keys; held, they repeat), 1 to LEVEL_LAST.  SPACE goes
1937  AA4B              ; there: the load-out screen, then the level from its first wave (the one
1938  AA4B              ; being played is left, no level complete).  9 again carries on with this

2062  AB83              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2063  AB83              ; Save games: ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS (beside the level files), one game.  Written
2064  AB83              ; by save and quit (game_pause: save_game), read by CONTINUE on the main menu
2065  AB83              ; (load_save, continue_game).  "ZPSV", SG_VERSION, then the fields in
2066  AB83              ; sg_fields, in order: the level and wave, the salvage, the VTOL's integrity
2067  AB83              ; (vtol_hp), its weapon slots (type and ammo each) and the selected one, the
2068  AB83              ; store (wpn_stock, wpn_unlocked), the booster (fitted, fuel), and the
2069  AB83              ; vision modes (vision_owned), and the vertical and lateral thrusters
2070  AB83              ; (vthrust_fitted, lthrust_fitted).  Files of an older version (1: before
2071  AB83              ; the vision modes, 2: before the vertical thrusters, 3: before the lateral
2072  AB83              ; ones, 4: before the linked chain guns, a longer store) are refused, as any
2073  AB83              ; other version.
2074  AB83              ; Continued, the level starts afresh at the saved wave: its zombies, the
2075  AB83              ; humans (and this level's rescues so far) and the base are new.
2076  AB83              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2077  AB83              SG_VERSION      equ 5
2078  AB83              sg_fields:      ; address, bytes
2079  AB83 22 AF                dw level
2080  AB85 01                   db 1
2081  AB86 2D AF                dw wave_number
2082  AB88 01                   db 1
2083  AB89 2F AF                dw salvage_points
2084  AB8B 02                   db 2
2085  AB8C 25 AF                dw vtol_hp
2086  AB8E 01                   db 1
2087  AB8F 15 AF                dw wpn_slots
2088  AB91 0A                   db WPN_SLOTS*2
2089  AB92 1F AF                dw wpn_sel
2090  AB94 01                   db 1
2091  AB95 9F AF                dw wpn_stock
2092  AB97 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
2093  AB98 AA AF                dw wpn_unlocked
2094  AB9A 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
2095  AB9B BA AF                dw boost_fitted                 ; (and boost_fuel, after it)
2096  AB9D 02                   db 2
2097  AB9E B5 AF                dw vision_owned
2098  ABA0 01                   db 1
2099  ABA1 B6 AF                dw vthrust_fitted
2100  ABA3 01                   db 1
2101  ABA4 B7 AF                dw lthrust_fitted
2102  ABA6 01                   db 1
2103  ABA7 00 00                dw 0                            ; (the end)
2104  ABA9                      ASSERT boost_fuel == boost_fitted+1
2105  ABA9              SG_SIZE         equ 5+1+1+2+1+WPN_SLOTS*2+1+2*(WPN_LAST+1)+2+1+1+1
2106  ABA9
2107  ABA9              ; Copy the fields: A = 0 the game's into sg_buf, 1 sg_buf's into the game
2108  ABA9              sg_copy:

2110  ABAC DD 21 83 AB          ld ix,sg_fields
2111  ABB0 11 84 AC             ld de,sg_buf+5

2117  ABBC DD 4E 02             ld c,(ix+2)

2119  ABC1 3A 7D AC             ld a,(sg_dir)
2120  ABC4 B7                   or a
2121  ABC5 28 06                jr z,.out
2122  ABC7 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; into the game: HL = sg_buf
2123  ABC8 ED B0                ldir
2124  ABCA EB                   ex de,hl

2127  ABCF 01 03 00     .nx:    ld bc,3

2129  ABD4 18 DD                jr .lp
2130  ABD6
2131  ABD6              ; Save the game.  Carry set (A = the esxDOS error) if it couldn't be
2132  ABD6              ; written.  Leaves the file handler in slot 7.

2143  ABEC 21 5F AC             ld hl,sg_name
2144  ABEF 11 7F AC             ld de,sg_buf
2145  ABF2 01 30 00             ld bc,SG_SIZE
2146  ABF5 C3 90 E0             jp fh_save
2147  ABF8
2148  ABF8              ; Read the save game into sg_buf: carry set if there's none, or it isn't a
2149  ABF8              ; save game this version can use (its level out of range too).  Leaves the
2150  ABF8              ; file handler in slot 7.

2160  AC0D 7C                   ld a,h
2161  AC0E B5                   or l

2235  ACC4              ; VTOL_HL x VTOL_HW (half size) rectangle, turned to the heading, round
2236  ACC4              ; (cam_x, cam_z).  The rectangle is smaller than a tile, so these six points
2237  ACC4              ; find every cell it overlaps (to within a tile corner nicking a long side).

2399  AE18
2400  AE18              ; A = angle -> HL = sin (S7.8).  Pages the sine table into slot 0 (PAGE_SIN):
2401  AE18              ; call it only outside the Layer 2 drawing (it is: setup_frame, the player,
2402  AE18              ; vtol_ground), never between a section's paging and its writes.
2403  AE18              get_sin:
2404  AE18 ED 91 50 0F          nextreg SIN_MMU,PAGE_SIN        ; the table at $0000 (slot 0)
2405  AE1C 6F                   ld l,a
2406  AE1D 26 00                ld h,high sin_lo

2411  AE23 C9                   ret
2412  AE24
2413  AE24              ; Rotate the building edge vectors (s,0,0) and (0,0,s) into camera space.
2414  AE24              ; HL = s, IX -> 16 bytes: VX(X,Y,Z) VZ(X,Y,Z) corner offset (X,Z1)
2415  AE24              make_vecs:

2417  AE27 ED 5B 19 B6          ld de,(cos_y)

2421  AE34 ED 5B 17 B6          ld de,(sin_y)

2423  AE3B 22 39 B6             ld (mv_n),hl                    ; s*sinY
2424  AE3E                      ; VX = ( s cosY, -s sinY sinP, s sinY cosP )
2425  AE3E 2A 37 B6             ld hl,(mv_c)

2437  AE64 DD 75 04             ld (ix+4),l
2438  AE67 DD 74 05             ld (ix+5),h

2440  AE6A 2A 39 B6             ld hl,(mv_n)

2451  AE8C ED 5B 1D B6          ld de,(cos_p)

2454  AE96 DD 74 0B             ld (ix+11),h

2463  AEAA DD 74 0D             ld (ix+13),h

2465  AEB0 ED 5B 37 B6          ld de,(mv_c)

2471  AEBF DD 74 0F             ld (ix+15),h
2472  AEC2 C9                   ret

2474  AEC3              ;==============================================================================
2475  AEC3              ; Fixed point maths
2476  AEC3              ;==============================================================================
2477  AEC3
2478  AEC3              ; HL = -HL
2479  AEC3              neg_hl:
2480  AEC3 AF                   xor a
2481  AEC4 95                   sub l
2482  AEC5 6F                   ld l,a
2483  AEC6 9F                   sbc a,a
2484  AEC7 94                   sub h
2485  AEC8 67                   ld h,a
2486  AEC9 C9                   ret
2487  AECA
2488  AECA              ; HL = |HL|
2489  AECA              abs_hl:
2490  AECA CB 7C                bit 7,h
2491  AECC C8                   ret z
2492  AECD 18 F4                jr neg_hl
2493  AECF
2494  AECF              ; fmul: HL = HL * DE >> 8
2495  AECF              ;   HL = signed 16-bit integer, DE = S7.8 factor in -1.0..+1.0
2496  AECF              ;   Sign/magnitude using two 8x8 MUL D,E.  Preserves IX, IY.
2497  AECF              fmul:
2498  AECF 7C                   ld a,h
2499  AED0 AA                   xor d
2500  AED1 F5                   push af                         ; result sign in bit 7
2501  AED2 CB 7C                bit 7,h
2502  AED4 28 06                jr z,.ap
2503  AED6 AF                   xor a
2504  AED7 95                   sub l
2505  AED8 6F                   ld l,a
2506  AED9 9F                   sbc a,a
2507  AEDA 94                   sub h
2508  AEDB 67                   ld h,a
2509  AEDC CB 7A        .ap:    bit 7,d
2510  AEDE 28 06                jr z,.bp
2511  AEE0 AF                   xor a
2512  AEE1 93                   sub e
2513  AEE2 5F                   ld e,a
2514  AEE3 9F                   sbc a,a
2515  AEE4 92                   sub d
2516  AEE5 57                   ld d,a
2517  AEE6 7A           .bp:    ld a,d
2518  AEE7 B7                   or a
2519  AEE8 20 10                jr nz,.one                      ; |factor| == 1.0
2520  AEEA 7B                   ld a,e
2521  AEEB 55                   ld d,l
2522  AEEC ED 30                mul d,e                         ; lo * f
2523  AEEE 4A                   ld c,d
2524  AEEF 54                   ld d,h
2525  AEF0 5F                   ld e,a
2526  AEF1 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; hi * f
2527  AEF3 7B                   ld a,e
2528  AEF4 81                   add a,c
2529  AEF5 6F                   ld l,a
2530  AEF6 7A                   ld a,d
2531  AEF7 CE 00                adc a,0
2532  AEF9 67                   ld h,a
2533  AEFA F1           .one:   pop af
2534  AEFB F0                   ret p
2535  AEFC AF                   xor a
2536  AEFD 95                   sub l
2537  AEFE 6F                   ld l,a
2538  AEFF 9F                   sbc a,a
2539  AF00 94                   sub h
2540  AF01 67                   ld h,a
2541  AF02 C9                   ret
2542  AF03
2543  AF03              ; HL = 0.5 * HL (signed): the top/bottom frustum slope, VIEW_CY/128
2544  AF03              zhalf:
2545  AF03 CB 2C                sra h
2546  AF05 CB 1D                rr l
2547  AF07 C9                   ret

  61+ E100              ; Unrolled span writer: entry = push_end - 1 - pairs (pairs 1..128).  SP is
  62+ E100              ; borrowed (it points into the span), so an interrupt pushes its return

  64+ E100              ; but not after the last one.  So interrupts are off from just before the
  65+ E100              ; last PUSH until SP is back (a few instructions: one arriving meanwhile

 173+ E883              ; IX = (HL << 16) / DE   with HL < DE (unsigned) -> 0.16 fraction
 174+ E883              ; Restoring division, unrolled: each quotient bit goes in inverted, as the

 180+ E883 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; (carry clear)

 185+ E883 ~                    sbc hl,de
 186+ E883 ~                    or a                            ; bit 1
 187+ E883 ~                    q                               ; (all the jumps land here)
 188+ E883                  ENDM

 247+ E937
 248+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 249+ E937              ; Perspective projection
 250+ E937              ;   in : HL -> X,Y,Z (camera space, inside the view frustum, Z > 0)
 251+ E937              ;   out: A = screen x (0..255), C = screen y (0..VIEW_H-1)
 252+ E937              ;   sx = 128 + 128*X/Z,  sy = 64 - 128*Y/Z   (90 x 53 degree field of view)
 253+ E937              ;   Z is normalised to 9 bits (256..511) with a barrel shift (count from a
 254+ E937              ;   log2 table) that is also applied to X and Y, which are then multiplied
 255+ E937              ;   by a 16-bit reciprocal from rtab.  |X| <= Z keeps Xn within 9 bits.
 256+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 257+ E937              project:
 258+ E937 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 259+ E938 23                   inc hl
 260+ E939 46                   ld b,(hl)
 261+ E93A 23                   inc hl                          ; BC = X
 262+ E93B 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 263+ E93C 23                   inc hl
 264+ E93D 56                   ld d,(hl)
 265+ E93E 23                   inc hl                          ; DE = Y
 266+ E93F D5                   push de
 267+ E940 C5                   push bc
 268+ E941 7E                   ld a,(hl)

 370+ E9D4                  IFDEF CLIP_2D

 372+ E9D4              ; 2D clip of the current face (df_ptr, df_mask), no corner behind the near
 373+ E9D4              ; plane.  Carry set: a corner is outside the guard band (nothing drawn, clip
 374+ E9D4              ; it in 3D).  Else p2buf / p2n hold the clipped polygon (p2n < 3: none).

 485+ EA99              ; IX -> corner (X, Y, Z; Z >= NEAR) -> its screen x, y (16-bit) at IY+0, +2,

 487+ EA99              ; stored) if outside the guard band |X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z.

 535+ EAFB              ; HL = component, DE = the screen centre, B = the upper bound, C = the lower
 536+ EAFB              ; plane's c2_or bit (the upper's is the next) -> HL = DE + 128 HL / Z (the

 564+ EB20              ; HL = signed component -> HL = round(|HL| * 128 / Z), |HL| <= 2Z: as

 616+ EB70
 617+ EB70              ; clip_isect for a 2D plane: the point where the edge S-E crosses it, out
 618+ EB70              ; at IY (IY and clip_on advanced).  Worked out from the edge's inside end,
 619+ EB70              ; so an edge two faces share is cut at the same point whichever way it
 620+ EB70              ; runs: t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|), the other coordinate o_in + t (o_out -
 621+ EB70              ; o_in), this one exactly on the bound.
 622+ EB70              c2_isect:
