   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - hardware sprites, Layer 3 (8K page PAGE_SPRITES, runs at $E000
   3+ E000              ; in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; The Next has 128 hardware sprites, each 16x16 pixels from a pattern in the
   6+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory (16K, separate from the Z80's: 64 8-bit patterns of
   7+ E000              ; 256 bytes, one byte per pixel, row by row).  A pattern byte is an index
   8+ E000              ; into the sprite palette; SPR_TRANS ($E3, NextReg $4B) is transparent.  The
   9+ E000              ; sprite palette starts as the identity, so until spr_palette changes it a
  10+ E000              ; pattern byte is simply its RRRGGGBB colour.
  11+ E000              ;
  12+ E000              ; Sprites are drawn above Layer 2 and the ULA (priority S U L) and, with
  13+ E000              ; NextReg $15 bit 1 set, over the border as well, so the sprite screen is
  14+ E000              ; 320 x 256 pixels:
  15+ E000              ;
  16+ E000              ;     x 0..319, y 0..255;  (SPR_SCREEN_X, SPR_SCREEN_Y) = (32, 32) is the top
  17+ E000              ;     left of the 256x192 Layer 2 / ULA screen, (288, 224) its bottom right
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; A sprite's position is its top left pixel.  Coordinates are 9 bits and
  20+ E000              ; wrap round at 512, so they may be negative (two's complement): a sprite at
  21+ E000              ; x = -8 shows its right half at the left edge.  With overlapping sprites,
  22+ E000              ; the higher numbered one is drawn on top.
  23+ E000              ;
  24+ E000              ; Use: sprites_init once (start-up), load patterns with spr_patterns or
  25+ E000              ; from a sprite bank (sprite_data.asm: page the bank into slot 7 and call
  26+ E000              ; its spr_load_bank, from outside slot 7), and a palette with spr_palette
  27+ E000              ; if wanted, then set up sprites in the shadow
  28+ E000              ; table with spr_set / spr_pos / spr_pattern / spr_flags / spr_scale /
  29+ E000              ; spr_hide / spr_show / spr_hide_all, and copy the table to the hardware
  30+ E000              ; once a frame with spr_update.  The table holds the first SPR_COUNT sprites;
  31+ E000              ; the rest stay hidden.
  32+ E000              ;
  33+ E000              ; Attributes, SPR_ATTR (5) bytes a sprite, kept in the table as they are
  34+ E000              ; sent (the 5-byte form):
  35+ E000              ;   +0  x bits 0-7
  36+ E000              ;   +1  y bits 0-7
  37+ E000              ;   +2  bits 7-4 palette offset (added to the pattern byte's top nibble),
  38+ E000              ;       bit 3 x mirror, 2 y mirror, 1 rotate 90 degrees clockwise, 0 x bit 8
  39+ E000              ;   +3  bit 7 visible, bit 6 = 1 (byte +4 follows), bits 5-0 pattern
  40+ E000              ;   +4  bits 4-3 x scale, bits 2-1 y scale (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8), 0 y bit 8
  41+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  42+ E000
  43+ E000              SPR_COUNT       equ 42          ; sprites in the shadow table (max 128)
  44+ E000              SPR_HW          equ 128         ; hardware sprites
  45+ E000              SPR_ATTR        equ 5           ; attribute bytes per sprite
  46+ E000              SPR_PATTERNS    equ 64          ; 8-bit 16x16 patterns in pattern memory
  47+ E000              SPR_SIZE        equ 16          ; pixels, each way (at scale x1)
  48+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_X    equ 32          ; sprite coordinates of the 256x192
  49+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_Y    equ 32          ; screen's top left pixel
  50+ E000              SPR_TRANS       equ $E3         ; transparent pattern byte (NextReg $4B)
  51+ E000
  52+ E000              SPRF_PAL        equ $10         ; flags (attribute +2): palette offset x 16,
  53+ E000              SPRF_XMIRROR    equ $08         ; mirror left-right,
  54+ E000              SPRF_YMIRROR    equ $04         ; mirror top-bottom,
  55+ E000              SPRF_ROT        equ $02         ; rotate 90 degrees clockwise
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              SPR_SLOT_PORT   equ $303B       ; write: select sprite / pattern slot
  58+ E000              SPR_ATTR_PORT   equ $57         ; write: attributes, from the selected sprite
  59+ E000              SPR_PAT_PORT    equ $5B         ; write: pattern bytes, from the selected slot
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  62+ E000              ; Start-up: sprites on, shown over the border too (the full 320 x 256),
  63+ E000              ; priority S U L; the transparent index; every hardware sprite hidden and the shadow table cleared (all hidden,
  64+ E000              ; pattern 0, at 0,0).
  65+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ E000              sprites_init:
  67+ E000 ED 91 15 0B          nextreg $15,%00001011           ; priority S U L, sprites over the
  68+ E004                                                      ; border (bit 1), visible (bit 0)
  69+ E004 ED 91 4B E3          nextreg $4B,SPR_TRANS
  70+ E008 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT             ; from sprite 0, the 4-byte form
  71+ E00B AF                   xor a                           ; (+3 bit 6 clear): all hidden
  72+ E00C ED 79                out (c),a
  73+ E00E 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
  74+ E010 11 00 02             ld de,SPR_HW*4
  75+ E013 ED 79        .hw:    out (c),a
  76+ E015 1B                   dec de
  77+ E016 7A                   ld a,d
  78+ E017 B3                   or e
  79+ E018 3E 00                ld a,0
  80+ E01A 20 F7                jr nz,.hw
  81+ E01C 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
  82+ E01F 06 2A                ld b,SPR_COUNT
  83+ E021 77           .sh:    ld (hl),a                       ; x, y, flags 0
  84+ E022 23                   inc hl
  85+ E023 77                   ld (hl),a
  86+ E024 23                   inc hl
  87+ E025 77                   ld (hl),a
  88+ E026 23                   inc hl
  89+ E027 36 40                ld (hl),$40                     ; hidden, 5-byte form, pattern 0
  90+ E029 23                   inc hl
  91+ E02A 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; scale x1
  92+ E02B 23                   inc hl
  93+ E02C 10 F3                djnz .sh
  94+ E02E                      ; fall through: send it
  95+ E02E
  96+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E02E              ; Copy the shadow table to sprites 0..SPR_COUNT-1.  Once a frame, after the
  98+ E02E              ; changes (best just after the frame flip, so a move doesn't show half done).
  99+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100+ E02E              spr_update:
 101+ E02E 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 102+ E031 AF                   xor a
 103+ E032 ED 79                out (c),a                       ; from sprite 0
 104+ E034 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 105+ E037 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
 106+ E039 16 2A                ld d,SPR_COUNT
 107+ E03B 06 05        .lp:    ld b,SPR_ATTR
 108+ E03D ED B3                otir
 109+ E03F 15                   dec d
 110+ E040 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 111+ E042 C9                   ret

 114+ E043              ; Load B 8-bit patterns (256 bytes each) from HL into pattern memory, from

 142+ E062              ; Sprite A (0..SPR_COUNT-1) in the shadow table.  BC = x, DE = y (sprite
 143+ E062              ; screen, signed 9 bits), H = pattern (0..63), L = flags (SPRF_*).  Shows it.

   1+ E2D2              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E2D2              ; Z-POLICE - HUD sprites (in the sprites page, PAGE_SPRITES, at $E000 in slot
   3+ E2D2              ; 7): the human status column and the compass bar, as hardware sprites on
   4+ E2D2              ; the 320 x 256 sprite screen.  hud_sprites sets both and sends the sprite
   5+ E2D2              ; table to the hardware; main_loop calls it once a frame, after the flip.
   6+ E2D2              ;
   7+ E2D2              ; Sprites used: 0..HUMAN_MAX-1 the humans, CSPR_SPR0.. the compass bar's
   8+ E2D2              ; marks, CSPR_PTR_SPR its pointer, FRM_SPR0.. the viewport's frame.
   9+ E2D2              ;==============================================================================
  10+ E2D2
  11+ E2D2              hud_sprites:
  12+ E2D2 3A 44 E4             ld a,(frm_on)                   ; the frame, once (they stay set)
  13+ E2D5 B7                   or a
  14+ E2D6 CC 32 E3             call z,frame_spr
  15+ E2D9 CD ED E3             call hum_hud
  16+ E2DC CD 82 E3             call compass_spr
  17+ E2DF C3 2E E0             jp spr_update
  18+ E2E2
  19+ E2E2              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  20+ E2E2              ; The viewport's frame: curved corners and edges in hardware sprites, over
  21+ E2E2              ; Layer 2 and the border, so nothing is drawn into the view.  Set once after
  22+ E2E2              ; the sprites are hidden (frm_on; spr_hide_all clears it).  frame_tab: x, y,
  23+ E2E2              ; pattern and flags, then scale across and down: the edges are 1-row patterns
  24+ E2E2              ; stretched, FRM_H across (two at x8 overlapping, 224 pixels) and FRM_V down
  25+ E2E2              ; (two at x4 overlapping, 96).  (The panel's bottom corners aren't rounded:
  26+ E2E2              ; sprites there covered the city map's bottom left.)
  27+ E2E2              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  28+ E2E2              FRM_SPR0        equ CSPR_PTR_SPR+1  ; the frame's sprites (10)
  29+ E2E2              FRM_L           equ SPR_SCREEN_X
  30+ E2E2              FRM_R           equ SPR_SCREEN_X+256-SPR_SIZE

 112+ E382              ; The compass bar, across the top of the screen in the top border (sprite
 113+ E382              ; row COMP_SPR_Y): a tape of marks every 16 yaw units (22.5 degrees), at 2
 114+ E382              ; pixels a yaw unit, centred on the heading at sprite x COMP_SPR_CX, across
 115+ E382              ; the full 320-pixel width of the sprite screen: 225 degrees (+-COMP_HALF,
 116+ E382              ; 80 yaw units).  Marks at the very edges are half off the screen (their x
 117+ E382              ; wraps, as sprite x does).  The letters N,
 118+ E382              ; E, S, W (red) at 0, 64, 128, 192; a yellow dot at the 45 degree points;
 119+ E382              ; a small white dot between.  A white pointer under the bar's middle marks
 120+ E382              ; the heading.  Turning right (yaw up) moves the marks left.

 195+ E3ED              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 196+ E3ED              ; The human status HUD: a column of hardware sprites, sprite k for human k,
 197+ E3ED              ; HUD_SPR_X pixels in from the left edge of the 320 x 256 sprite screen,
 198+ E3ED              ; human 0 at the bottom and each next one HUD_SPR_STEP higher, the column
 199+ E3ED              ; centred on the screen: its middle sprite (human (nhumans - 1) / 2) at row
 200+ E3ED              ; HUD_SPR_MID.  Each shows its human's state with the human status patterns
 201+ E3ED              ; (sprite_data.asm): waiting in the city (HSPR_FIELD), aboard the VTOL
 202+ E3ED              ; (HSPR_ABOARD), rescued (HSPR_SAVED) or dead (HSPR_DEAD).  Unused humans'
 203+ E3ED              ; sprites are hidden, and any that would go off the top.
 204+ E3ED              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 205+ E3ED              HUD_SPR_X       equ 8
 206+ E3ED              HUD_SPR_MID     equ 128             ; the middle sprite's row
 207+ E3ED              HUD_SPR_STEP    equ SPR_SIZE
 208+ E3ED              HUD_SPR_LOW     equ 256-8-SPR_SIZE  ; the lowest the bottom one goes
 209+ E3ED                      ASSERT HUD_SPR_STEP == 16       ; (* 16: four shifts)
 210+ E3ED                      ASSERT HSPR_FIELD == HS_WAIT-1 && HSPR_ABOARD == HS_ABOARD-1
 211+ E3ED                      ASSERT HSPR_SAVED == HS_SAVED-1 && HSPR_DEAD == HS_DEAD-1
 212+ E3ED                      ASSERT HUMAN_MAX <= SPR_COUNT

 221+ E3FA 87                   add a,a
 222+ E3FB 87                   add a,a
 223+ E3FC 87                   add a,a

2745  E446                      INCLUDE "tiles.asm"             ; the hardware tilemap (page 14, after
# file opened: tiles.asm
   1+ E446              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E446              ; Z-POLICE - the hardware tilemap (in the sprites page, PAGE_SPRITES, at
   3+ E446              ; $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before
   4+ E446              ; calling)
   5+ E446              ;
   6+ E446              ; The Next's tilemap layer: a grid of 8x8 tiles, 40x32 (or 80x32) over the
   7+ E446              ; whole 320x256 screen, drawn with the ULA (in front of it here, $6B bit 0;
   8+ E446              ; its pixel index 0 transparent, $4C).  Its map and its tile definitions
   9+ E446              ; must be in bank 5 or the first half of bank 7: page 14 (PAGE_TILES),
  10+ E446              ; which holds the start-up code (initialise.asm) until start-up is done and
  11+ E446              ; is free after.  In page 14:
  12+ E446              ;   $0000-$09FF  the map: 2 bytes a cell (tile, attribute), row by row,
  13+ E446              ;                40 x 32 (the 40-column mode only: the screen's 320 x 256)
  14+ E446              ;   $0A00-$1FFF  the tile definitions: 176 tiles of 32 bytes (4 bits a
  15+ E446              ;                pixel, 2 pixels a byte, the left one in the high nibble,
  16+ E446              ;                row by row): 0-63 the font (font8, text.asm: ASCII 32-95,
  17+ E446              ;                ink 1 on index 0), 64-175 free (tm_defs; the console's)
  18+ E446              ; The routines map page 14 into slot 0 to write it ($0000: the scratch
  19+ E446              ; slot, which get_sin and the Layer 2 drawing map for themselves), and
  20+ E446              ; leave it there.
  21+ E446              ;
  22+ E446              ; A cell's attribute: bits 7-4 its palette offset (tile pixel n shows
  23+ E446              ; tilemap palette entry offset*16+n), bit 3 mirror x, bit 2 mirror y, bit
  24+ E446              ; 1 rotate, bit 0 1: the ULA over it.  tm_init sets the first tilemap
  25+ E446              ; palette: for each offset 0-15, entry 1 (the font's ink) one of
  26+ E446              ; tm_inks (white, red, green ...); tm_colour changes one.
  27+ E446              ;
  28+ E446              ; Routines (preserve IX, IY):
  29+ E446              ;   tm_init      A = TM_40 (the columns: 40 only): the map cleared, the font's
  30+ E446              ;                tiles, the palette, the registers; the tilemap shown
  31+ E446              ;   tm_off       hidden (the map and tiles kept); tm_on shows it again
  32+ E446              ;   tm_clear     every cell blank (tile TM_BLANK, attribute 0)
  33+ E446              ;   tm_tile      D = row, E = column, A = tile, C = attribute
  34+ E446              ;   tm_putc      D, E, A = an ASCII character, C = attribute; E steps on
  35+ E446              ;   tm_print     D, E, HL -> text (ending 0), C = attribute; HL past the 0
  36+ E446              ;   tm_defs      HL -> definitions (32 bytes each), A = first tile, B = how
  37+ E446              ;                many
  38+ E446              ;   tm_colour    A = palette offset 0-15, E = its ink colour (RRRGGGBB)
  39+ E446              ;   tm_scroll    HL = x offset (0-319), A = y (0-255)
  40+ E446              ;   tm_pal16     A = palette offset 0-15, HL -> its 16 colours (RRRGGGBB)
  41+ E446              ;   tm_pal16_9   A = palette offset 0-15, HL -> its 16 colours, 9-bit (2
  42+ E446              ;                bytes each: RRRGGGBB, then blue's low bit in bit 0)
  43+ E446              ;   console_on   the VTOL console round the view (in the game): below
  44+ E446              ;==============================================================================
  45+ E446
  46+ E446              PAGE_TILES      equ PAGE_INIT       ; page 14: bank 7's first half
  47+ E446                      ASSERT PAGE_TILES == 14
  48+ E446              TM_MMU          equ SIN_MMU         ; (slot 0: the scratch slot)
  49+ E446              TM_ADDR         equ SIN_ADDR        ; $0000
  50+ E446              TM_MAP          equ 0               ; offsets in page 14
  51+ E446              TM_DEFS         equ $0A00
  52+ E446              TM_TILE_SIZE    equ 32
  53+ E446              TM_TILES        equ ($2000-TM_DEFS)/TM_TILE_SIZE    ; 176
  54+ E446              TM_FONT_FIRST   equ 32              ; the font: ASCII 32-95 as tiles 0-63
  55+ E446              TM_FONT_N       equ 64
  56+ E446              TM_FREE         equ TM_FONT_N       ; the first free tile
  57+ E446              TM_BLANK        equ 0               ; (ASCII space: every pixel index 0)
  58+ E446              TM_INK          equ 1               ; the font's pixels' index
  59+ E446              TM_ROWS         equ 32
  60+ E446              TM_40           equ 40
  61+ E446                      ASSERT TM_MAP + TM_40*TM_ROWS*2 <= TM_DEFS && TM_TILES >= TM_FONT_N
  62+ E446                      ASSERT TM_TILES <= 256          ; (the 256-tile mode)
  63+ E446
  64+ E446              ; NextRegs
  65+ E446              NR_TM_CTRL      equ $6B             ; bit 7 on, 6 80 columns, 5 no
  66+ E446              TM_ON           equ %10000000       ;   attributes, 4 second palette, 3 text
  67+ E446              TM_80COL        equ %01000000       ;   mode, 1 512 tiles, 0 over the ULA
  68+ E446              TM_OVER_ULA     equ %00000001
  69+ E446              NR_TM_ATTR      equ $6C             ; the default attribute (no attributes)
  70+ E446              NR_TM_MAP       equ $6E             ; bit 7: bank 7; bits 5-0: offset / 256
  71+ E446              NR_TM_DEFS      equ $6F
  72+ E446              NR_TM_TRANS     equ $4C             ; the transparent pixel index (0-15)
  73+ E446              NR_TM_CLIP      equ $1B             ; x1, x2, y1, y2 (x / 2 at 40 columns)
  74+ E446              NR_TM_XMSB      equ $2F
  75+ E446              NR_TM_XLSB      equ $30
  76+ E446              NR_TM_Y         equ $31
  77+ E446              TM_BANK7        equ %10000000
  78+ E446

 151+ E4C9 D5                   push de
 152+ E4CA 3A 9A E5             ld a,(tm_stride)
 153+ E4CD 5F                   ld e,a
 154+ E4CE ED 30                mul d,e                         ; row * the row's bytes
 155+ E4D0 EB                   ex de,hl
 156+ E4D1 D1                   pop de
 157+ E4D2 7B                   ld a,e
 158+ E4D3 87                   add a,a                         ; + column * 2
 159+ E4D4 ED 31                add hl,a
 160+ E4D6 C9                   ret
 161+ E4D7                      ASSERT TM_ADDR+TM_MAP == 0
 162+ E4D7
 163+ E4D7              ; D = row, E = column: tile A, attribute C
 164+ E4D7              tm_tile:
 165+ E4D7 E5                   push hl
 166+ E4D8 F5                   push af
 167+ E4D9 CD C6 E4             call tm_at
 168+ E4DC F1                   pop af
 169+ E4DD 77                   ld (hl),a
 170+ E4DE 23                   inc hl
 171+ E4DF 71                   ld (hl),c
 172+ E4E0 E1                   pop hl
 173+ E4E1 C9                   ret
 174+ E4E2
 175+ E4E2              ; A = an ASCII character at D, E, attribute C; E steps on.  Lower case is
 176+ E4E2              ; shown as upper case; anything else not in the font as a space.
 177+ E4E2              tm_putc:
 178+ E4E2 FE 61                cp 'a'
 179+ E4E4 38 06                jr c,.u
 180+ E4E6 FE 7B                cp 'z'+1
 181+ E4E8 30 02                jr nc,.u
 182+ E4EA D6 20                sub 32
 183+ E4EC D6 20        .u:     sub TM_FONT_FIRST
 184+ E4EE FE 40                cp TM_FONT_N
 185+ E4F0 38 02                jr c,.ok
 186+ E4F2 3E 00                ld a,TM_BLANK
 187+ E4F4 CD D7 E4     .ok:    call tm_tile
 188+ E4F7 1C                   inc e
 189+ E4F8 C9                   ret
 190+ E4F9
 191+ E4F9              ; HL -> text ending 0, at D, E, attribute C.  HL ends past the 0.
 192+ E4F9              tm_print:
 193+ E4F9 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 194+ E4FA 23                   inc hl
 195+ E4FB B7                   or a
 196+ E4FC C8                   ret z
 197+ E4FD CD E2 E4             call tm_putc
 198+ E500 18 F7                jr tm_print
 199+ E502
 200+ E502              ; HL -> tile definitions (TM_TILE_SIZE bytes each), A = the first tile
 201+ E502              ; (TM_FREE..), B = how many
 202+ E502              tm_defs:
 203+ E502 C5                   push bc
 204+ E503 CD B0 E4             call tm_page
 205+ E506 5F                   ld e,a                          ; DE = TM_DEFS + A * 32
 206+ E507 16 20                ld d,TM_TILE_SIZE
 207+ E509 ED 30                mul d,e
 208+ E50B 7A                   ld a,d
 209+ E50C C6 0A                add a,high (TM_ADDR+TM_DEFS)
 210+ E50E 57                   ld d,a
 211+ E50F C1                   pop bc
 212+ E510 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; BC = B * 32
 213+ E512 CB 38                srl b
 214+ E514 CB 19                rr c
 215+ E516 CB 38                srl b
 216+ E518 CB 19                rr c
 217+ E51A CB 38                srl b
 218+ E51C CB 19                rr c
 219+ E51E ED B0                ldir
 220+ E520 C9                   ret
 221+ E521                      ASSERT TM_TILE_SIZE == 32 && low (TM_ADDR+TM_DEFS) == 0
 222+ E521
 223+ E521              ; The first tilemap palette: for each of the 16 offsets, entry 0 black
 224+ E521              ; (see through anyway) and entry 1 (the font's ink) from tm_inks; the rest
 225+ E521              ; black
 226+ E521              tm_palette:
 227+ E521 3E 43                ld a,$43
 228+ E523 CD D6 A6             call read_nextreg               ; (zpolice.asm) the layers' choices
 229+ E526 32 9B E5             ld (tm_nr43),a
 230+ E529 E6 0F                and %00001111                   ; kept; edit the tilemap's first
 231+ E52B F6 30                or %00110000                    ; palette, auto-incrementing
 232+ E52D ED 92 43             nextreg $43,a
 233+ E530 ED 91 40 00          nextreg $40,0
 234+ E534 21 89 E5             ld hl,tm_inks
 235+ E537 0E 10                ld c,16
 236+ E539 AF           .o:     xor a
 237+ E53A ED 92 41             nextreg $41,a                   ; 0
 238+ E53D 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 239+ E53E 23                   inc hl
 240+ E53F ED 92 41             nextreg $41,a                   ; 1: the ink
 241+ E542 06 0E                ld b,14
 242+ E544 AF           .z:     xor a
 243+ E545 ED 92 41             nextreg $41,a                   ; 2-15
 244+ E548 10 FA                djnz .z
 245+ E54A 0D                   dec c
 246+ E54B 20 EC                jr nz,.o
 247+ E54D 3A 9B E5             ld a,(tm_nr43)                  ; (as it was)
 248+ E550 ED 92 43             nextreg $43,a
 249+ E553 C9                   ret
 250+ E554                      ASSERT TM_INK == 1
 251+ E554
 252+ E554              ; A = palette offset 0-15, E = its ink colour (RRRGGGBB)
 253+ E554              tm_colour:
 254+ E554 E6 0F                and 15
 255+ E556 57                   ld d,a
 256+ E557 3E 43                ld a,$43
 257+ E559 CD D6 A6             call read_nextreg
 258+ E55C 32 9B E5             ld (tm_nr43),a
 259+ E55F E6 0F                and %00001111
 260+ E561 F6 30                or %00110000
 261+ E563 ED 92 43             nextreg $43,a
 262+ E566 7A                   ld a,d                          ; entry offset * 16 + TM_INK
 263+ E567 87                   add a,a
 264+ E568 87                   add a,a
 265+ E569 87                   add a,a
 266+ E56A 87                   add a,a
 267+ E56B C6 01                add a,TM_INK
 268+ E56D ED 92 40             nextreg $40,a
 269+ E570 7B                   ld a,e
 270+ E571 ED 92 41             nextreg $41,a
 271+ E574 3A 9B E5             ld a,(tm_nr43)
 272+ E577 ED 92 43             nextreg $43,a
 273+ E57A C9                   ret
 274+ E57B
 275+ E57B              ; HL = x offset, A = y offset
 276+ E57B              tm_scroll:
 277+ E57B ED 92 31             nextreg NR_TM_Y,a
 278+ E57E 7C                   ld a,h
 279+ E57F E6 03                and 3
 280+ E581 ED 92 2F             nextreg NR_TM_XMSB,a
 281+ E584 7D                   ld a,l
 282+ E585 ED 92 30             nextreg NR_TM_XLSB,a
 283+ E588 C9                   ret
 284+ E589
 285+ E589              ; The inks of the 16 palette offsets (attribute bits 7-4)
 286+ E589 FF E0 1C FC  tm_inks:    db $FF, $E0, $1C, $FC, $1F, $E3, $F4, $6D   ; white, red, green,
 286+ E58D 1F E3 F4 6D
 287+ E591 92 03 10 80              db $92, $03, $10, $80, $B6, $FD, $9F, $49   ; yellow, cyan, magenta,
 287+ E595 B6 FD 9F 49
 288+ E599                                                                      ; amber, grey ...
 289+ E599 28           tm_cols:    db TM_40                    ; the columns (TM_40)
 290+ E59A 50           tm_stride:  db 2*TM_40                  ;   a row's bytes in the map
 291+ E59B 00           tm_nr43:    db 0                        ; (tm_palette: NextReg $43 kept)
 292+ E59C 00           con_attr:   db 0                        ; (console_on: a cell's bank)
 293+ E59D
 294+ E59D              ; A = palette offset 0-15, HL -> 16 colours (RRRGGGBB): its entries
 295+ E59D              ; offset*16 .. +15 in the first tilemap palette
 296+ E59D              tm_pal16:
 297+ E59D E6 0F                and 15
 298+ E59F 87                   add a,a
 299+ E5A0 87                   add a,a
 300+ E5A1 87                   add a,a
 301+ E5A2 87                   add a,a
 302+ E5A3 57                   ld d,a
 303+ E5A4 3E 43                ld a,$43
 304+ E5A6 CD D6 A6             call read_nextreg
 305+ E5A9 32 9B E5             ld (tm_nr43),a
 306+ E5AC E6 0F                and %00001111
 307+ E5AE F6 30                or %00110000
 308+ E5B0 ED 92 43             nextreg $43,a
 309+ E5B3 7A                   ld a,d
 310+ E5B4 ED 92 40             nextreg $40,a
 311+ E5B7 06 10                ld b,16
 312+ E5B9 7E           .c:     ld a,(hl)
 313+ E5BA 23                   inc hl
 314+ E5BB ED 92 41             nextreg $41,a
 315+ E5BE 10 F9                djnz .c
 316+ E5C0 3A 9B E5             ld a,(tm_nr43)
 317+ E5C3 ED 92 43             nextreg $43,a
 318+ E5C6 C9                   ret
 319+ E5C7
 320+ E5C7              ; A = palette offset 0-15, HL -> 16 colours, 9-bit (2 bytes each: RRRGGGBB,
 321+ E5C7              ; then the third blue bit in bit 0; NextReg $44, which steps on after the
 322+ E5C7              ; second): its entries offset*16 .. +15 in the first tilemap palette.  HL
 323+ E5C7              ; ends past them.
 324+ E5C7              tm_pal16_9:
 325+ E5C7 E6 0F                and 15
 326+ E5C9 87                   add a,a
 327+ E5CA 87                   add a,a
 328+ E5CB 87                   add a,a
 329+ E5CC 87                   add a,a
 330+ E5CD 57                   ld d,a
 331+ E5CE 3E 43                ld a,$43
 332+ E5D0 CD D6 A6             call read_nextreg
 333+ E5D3 32 9B E5             ld (tm_nr43),a
 334+ E5D6 E6 0F                and %00001111
 335+ E5D8 F6 30                or %00110000
 336+ E5DA ED 92 43             nextreg $43,a
 337+ E5DD 7A                   ld a,d
 338+ E5DE ED 92 40             nextreg $40,a
 339+ E5E1 06 20                ld b,32                         ; (16 colours, 2 bytes each)
 340+ E5E3 7E           .c:     ld a,(hl)
 341+ E5E4 23                   inc hl
 342+ E5E5 ED 92 44             nextreg $44,a
 343+ E5E8 10 F9                djnz .c
 344+ E5EA 3A 9B E5             ld a,(tm_nr43)
 345+ E5ED ED 92 43             nextreg $43,a
 346+ E5F0 C9                   ret
 347+ E5F1
 348+ E5F1              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 349+ E5F1              ; The VTOL console (next_level, each level's start): the tilemap at 40
 350+ E5F1              ; columns with the console's tiles (tables_console.inc, tools/
 351+ E5F1              ; consoletiles.py: TM_FREE on), their colours (CON_BANKS banks of 16, 9-bit,
 352+ E5F1              ; bank k at tilemap palette offset CON_OFFSET0 + k: each tile has its bank,
 353+ E5F1              ; console_tbank) and its map (console_map: 2 bytes a cell, the tile's
 354+ E5F1              ; place in the console's tiles + 1 (0: see-through), then its flags, the
 355+ E5F1              ; attribute's bit 3 mirror x, bit 2 mirror y, bit 1 rotate, bit 0 the ULA
 356+ E5F1              ; over it: so the tilemap isn't forced over the ULA, $6B bit 0).  The font's colours (tm_inks) stay at offset 0
 357+ E5F1              ; only: the banks take the other offsets.  Under the HUD's
 358+ E5F1              ; sprites (the compass, the humans, the view's frame) and beside the ULA
 359+ E5F1              ; panel; the vision modes leave it as it is (its own palette).  menu_quiet
 360+ E5F1              ; (text.asm) hides it on the screens outside the game.
 361+ E5F1              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 362+ E5F1              console_on:
 363+ E5F1 3E 28                ld a,TM_40
 364+ E5F3 CD 46 E4             call tm_init                    ; (cleared, the font, shown)
 365+ E5F6 21 21 E7             ld hl,console_defs
 366+ E5F9 3E 40                ld a,TM_FREE
 367+ E5FB 06 35                ld b,CON_N
 368+ E5FD CD 02 E5             call tm_defs
 369+ E600 21 4C E6             ld hl,console_pal               ; the banks' colours
 370+ E603 3E 01                ld a,CON_OFFSET0
 371+ E605 F5           .bk:    push af
 372+ E606 CD C7 E5             call tm_pal16_9
 373+ E609 F1                   pop af
 374+ E60A 3C                   inc a
 375+ E60B FE 06                cp CON_OFFSET0+CON_BANKS
 376+ E60D 20 F6                jr nz,.bk
 377+ E60F CD B0 E4             call tm_page
 378+ E612 21 C1 ED             ld hl,console_map
 379+ E615 11 00 00             ld de,TM_ADDR+TM_MAP
 380+ E618 01 00 05             ld bc,TM_40*TM_ROWS
 381+ E61B 7E           .lp:    ld a,(hl)                       ; its tile's place + 1
 382+ E61C 23                   inc hl
 383+ E61D B7                   or a
 384+ E61E 28 1D                jr z,.e                         ; none: see-through
 385+ E620 E5                   push hl
 386+ E621 21 EB E6             ld hl,console_tbank-1           ; its bank (its attribute's top half;
 387+ E624 ED 31                add hl,a                        ; BC is the cells' count)
 388+ E626 6E                   ld l,(hl)
 389+ E627 67                   ld h,a
 390+ E628 7D                   ld a,l
 391+ E629 32 9C E5             ld (con_attr),a
 392+ E62C 7C                   ld a,h
 393+ E62D E1                   pop hl
 394+ E62E C6 3F                add a,TM_FREE-1
 395+ E630 12                   ld (de),a                       ; the tile (TM_FREE + its place),
 396+ E631 13                   inc de
 397+ E632 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; its flags (mirrors, rotation),
 398+ E633 23                   inc hl
 399+ E634 E5                   push hl
 400+ E635 21 9C E5             ld hl,con_attr                  ; and its bank's colours
 401+ E638 B6                   or (hl)
 402+ E639 E1                   pop hl
 403+ E63A 12                   ld (de),a
 404+ E63B 18 04                jr .n
 405+ E63D 23           .e:     inc hl                          ; (its flags: none)
 406+ E63E 12                   ld (de),a
 407+ E63F 13                   inc de
 408+ E640 12                   ld (de),a
 409+ E641 13           .n:     inc de
 410+ E642 0B                   dec bc
 411+ E643 78                   ld a,b
 412+ E644 B1                   or c
 413+ E645 20 D4                jr nz,.lp
 414+ E647 ED 91 6B 80          nextreg NR_TM_CTRL,TM_ON        ; each tile's attribute bit 0 says
 415+ E64B C9                   ret                             ; which is on top: it or the ULA
 416+ E64C                      ASSERT CON_N <= TM_TILES-TM_FREE && CON_N < 128
 417+ E64C                      ASSERT CON_OFFSET0 >= 1 && CON_OFFSET0+CON_BANKS <= 16
 418+ E64C
 419+ E64C                      INCLUDE "tables_console.inc"    ; console_pal, console_defs,
# file opened: tables_console.inc

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - start-up initialisation (8K page PAGE_INIT, runs at $E000 in
   3+ E000              ; slot 7)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Code needed only once, at start-up, kept out of the resident page: start
   6+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm) pages this in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INIT and calls
   7+ E000              ; initgame, then slot 7 is free for the other core pages.
   8+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E000
  10+ E000              ; Hardware set-up: 28MHz, Layer 2 mode, transparency, layer priority, Layer
  11+ E000              ; 2 scroll and clip window, the memory map of the always-mapped slots, the
  12+ E000              ; peripheral settings (AY sound, turbo sound, internal speaker, no
  13+ E000              ; contention), and a black border.
  14+ E000              initgame:
  15+ E000 ED 91 07 03          nextreg $07,3                   ; 28MHz
  16+ E004 ED 91 70 00          nextreg $70,0                   ; Layer 2 256x192 mode
  17+ E008 ED 91 14 E3          nextreg $14,$E3                 ; global transparency colour
  18+ E00C ED 91 15 08          nextreg $15,%00001000           ; priority S U L (ULA over L2); sprites
  19+ E010                                                      ; off until sprites_init
  20+ E010 ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
  21+ E014 ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
  22+ E018 ED 91 1C 01          nextreg $1C,%00000001           ; reset L2 clip index
  23+ E01C ED 91 18 00          nextreg $18,0                   ; Layer 2 clip: x 0..255,
  24+ E020 ED 91 18 FF          nextreg $18,255
  25+ E024 ED 91 18 00          nextreg $18,0                   ; y 0..191: the viewport, and the
  26+ E028 ED 91 18 BF          nextreg $18,191                 ; city map through the ULA panel
  27+ E02C ED 91 54 0A          nextreg ULA_MMU,PAGE_ULA0       ; ULA screen (bank 5) at $8000
  28+ E030 ED 91 51 05          nextreg ZOMBIE_MMU,PAGE_ZOMBIE  ; zombie code/data stays at $2000
  29+ E034 ED 91 52 06          nextreg OCC_MMU,PAGE_OCC0       ; occlusion data at $4000-$5FFF,
  30+ E038 ED 91 53 07          nextreg TABLES_MMU,PAGE_OCC1    ; city_col at $6000-$6FFF
  31+ E03C                      ; Peripheral settings.  $06 and $08 are read, changed and written
  32+ E03C                      ; back, so the bits not named here keep their values (in $06, bit 4
  33+ E03C                      ; is the divMMC automap, which the file handler's RST $08 needs).
  34+ E03C 3E 06                ld a,$06                        ; Peripheral 2: audio chip mode
  35+ E03E CD D6 A6             call read_nextreg               ; (bits 1-0) = %01, AY
  36+ E041 E6 FC                and %11111100
  37+ E043 F6 01                or %00000001
  38+ E045 ED 92 06             nextreg $06,a
  39+ E048 3E 08                ld a,$08                        ; Peripheral 3:
  40+ E04A CD D6 A6             call read_nextreg
  41+ E04D F6 52                or %01010010                    ; bit 6: no RAM / I/O contention,
  42+ E04F ED 92 08             nextreg $08,a                   ; bit 4: internal speaker on,
  43+ E052                                                      ; bit 1: turbo sound on
  44+ E052 ED 91 09 20          nextreg $09,AY_MONO_ENGINES     ; Peripheral 4: the engines' AY mono
  45+ E056                                                      ; (centred), the others stereo; no
  46+ E056                                                      ; sprite id lockstep, HDMI audio on,
  47+ E056                                                      ; no scanlines
  48+ E056 ED 91 CC 00          nextreg $CC,0                   ; DMA Interrupt Enable 0: no NMI, line
  49+ E05A                                                      ; or ULA interrupt stops a DMA transfer
  50+ E05A ED 91 CD 00          nextreg $CD,0                   ; DMA Interrupt Enable 1: nor a CTC
  51+ E05E ED 91 CE 00          nextreg $CE,0                   ; DMA Interrupt Enable 2: nor a UART
  52+ E062 AF                   xor a
  53+ E063 D3 FE                out ($FE),a                     ; black border
  54+ E065 C9                   ret

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - file handling: loading and saving on the SD card (8K page
   3+ E000              ; PAGE_FILE, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg
   4+ E000              ; CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE before calling)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; General-purpose routines over the esxDOS / NextZXOS file API (RST $08 with
   7+ E000              ; a function code after it).  Game-specific loading and saving (save games,
   8+ E000              ; high scores, settings) go on top of these.
   9+ E000              ;
  10+ E000              ; The ROM: the divMMC only traps RST $08 while the ROM is paged in at
  11+ E000              ; $0000-$3FFF, but the game keeps other pages there (slot 0: a Layer 2
  12+ E000              ; section or the sine table; slot 1: the zombie page).  So every call pages
  13+ E000              ; the ROM into slots 0 and 1 (fh_rom_in), makes the RST $08, then puts the
  14+ E000              ; game's pages back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off over the call (the
  15+ E000              ; game's IM 2 routine is in slot 1, covered by the ROM, and IY is in use and
  16+ E000              ; slot 2 holds game data, so the ROM's routine must not run either), and
  17+ E000              ; fh_rom_out turns them back on if they were on.
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; Rules for callers:
  20+ E000              ;   * page this in at $E000 (slot 7) first, and call from outside slot 7:
  21+ E000              ;     resident code or a game logic page in slot 6;
  22+ E000              ;   * file names and data buffers must be in $4000-$DFFF: not in slots 0-1
  23+ E000              ;     (the ROM and esxDOS are there during a call) nor slot 7 (this page);
  24+ E000              ;   * file names end with a 0 byte.
  25+ E000              ;
  26+ E000              ; Every routine returns carry clear on success; carry set on failure with
  27+ E000              ; A = the esxDOS error code.  A file that was opened is closed again on
  28+ E000              ; any error in fh_load / fh_save.
  29+ E000              ;
  30+ E000              ; Routines:
  31+ E000              ;   fh_init      get the default drive (call once, before the others)
  32+ E000              ;   fh_open      HL = name, B = mode (FA_*)      -> A = handle
  33+ E000              ;   fh_close     A = handle
  34+ E000              ;   fh_read      A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read
  35+ E000              ;   fh_write     A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
  36+ E000              ;   fh_seek      A = handle, BCDE = offset, L = SEEK_* -> BCDE = position
  37+ E000              ;   fh_size      A = handle                      -> BCDE = file size
  38+ E000              ;   fh_load      HL = name, DE = address, BC = most bytes -> BC = bytes read
  39+ E000              ;   fh_save      HL = name, DE = address, BC = length (created / replaced)
  40+ E000              ;   fh_exists    HL = name -> carry clear if the file exists
  41+ E000              ;   fh_delete    HL = name
  42+ E000              ;   fh_mkdir     HL = name: make the folder (its parent must exist; carry,
  43+ E000              ;                A = the error, if it can't: it's there already, say)
  44+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  45+ E000
  46+ E000              ; esxDOS function codes (the byte after RST $08)
  47+ E000              M_GETSETDRV     equ $89             ; A = 0: get the default drive
  48+ E000              F_OPEN          equ $9A
  49+ E000              F_CLOSE         equ $9B
  50+ E000              F_READ          equ $9D
  51+ E000              F_WRITE         equ $9E
  52+ E000              F_SEEK          equ $9F
  53+ E000              F_FSTAT         equ $A1
  54+ E000              F_UNLINK        equ $AD
  55+ E000              F_MKDIR         equ $AA
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              ; F_OPEN modes (B)
  58+ E000              FA_READ         equ $01             ; read
  59+ E000              FA_WRITE        equ $02             ; write
  60+ E000              FA_OPEN_EX      equ $00             ; open an existing file only
  61+ E000              FA_OPEN_AL      equ $08             ; open, or create if it doesn't exist
  62+ E000              FA_CREATE_NEW   equ $04             ; create, fail if it exists
  63+ E000              FA_CREATE_AL    equ $0C             ; create, replacing any existing file
  64+ E000              FA_OVERWRITE    equ FA_WRITE|FA_CREATE_AL   ; for saving a whole file
  65+ E000
  66+ E000              ; F_SEEK modes (L)
  67+ E000              SEEK_START      equ 0               ; from the start of the file
  68+ E000              SEEK_FWD        equ 1               ; forwards from the current position
  69+ E000              SEEK_BACK       equ 2               ; backwards from the current position
  70+ E000
  71+ E000              FSTAT_SIZE      equ 7               ; F_FSTAT buffer: file size, 4 bytes
  72+ E000              FSTAT_LEN       equ 11              ; F_FSTAT buffer length
  73+ E000
  74+ E000              ESX_DEFAULT     equ '*'             ; drive: the default drive
  75+ E000
  76+ E000              ; An esxDOS call: the ROM in at $0000-$3FFF for the RST $08, the game's
  77+ E000              ; pages back after.  Registers in and out are the function's own; flags
  78+ E000              ; and A come back from esxDOS (carry set = error, A = code).
  79+ E000                      MACRO ESXDOS fn
  80+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_in
  81+ E000 ~                    rst $08
  82+ E000 ~                    db fn
  83+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_out
  84+ E000                      ENDM
  85+ E000
  86+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  87+ E000              ; Get the default drive into fh_drive (else the '*' default is used)
  88+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  89+ E000              fh_init:
  90+ E000 AF                   xor a                           ; A = 0: get
  91+ E001                      ESXDOS M_GETSETDRV
  91+ E001 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
  91+ E004 CF          >        rst $08
  91+ E005 89          >        db M_GETSETDRV
  91+ E006 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
  92+ E009 D8                   ret c
  93+ E00A 32 29 E1             ld (fh_drive),a
  94+ E00D C9                   ret
  95+ E00E
  96+ E00E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E00E              ; HL -> file name, B = mode (FA_*) -> A = handle (also in fh_handle)
  98+ E00E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  99+ E00E              fh_open:
 100+ E00E DD E5                push ix
 101+ E010 E5                   push hl
 102+ E011 DD E1                pop ix                          ; IX = HL = the name (both
 103+ E013 3A 29 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)                 ; conventions: programs, dot
 104+ E016                      ESXDOS F_OPEN                   ; commands)
 104+ E016 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 104+ E019 CF          >        rst $08
 104+ E01A 9A          >        db F_OPEN
 104+ E01B CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 105+ E01E DD E1                pop ix
 106+ E020 D8                   ret c
 107+ E021 32 2A E1             ld (fh_handle),a
 108+ E024 C9                   ret
 109+ E025
 110+ E025              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 111+ E025              ; A = handle: close it
 112+ E025              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 113+ E025              fh_close:
 114+ E025                      ESXDOS F_CLOSE
 114+ E025 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 114+ E028 CF          >        rst $08
 114+ E029 9B          >        db F_CLOSE
 114+ E02A CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 115+ E02D C9                   ret
 116+ E02E
 117+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 118+ E02E              ; A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read (fewer at the end
 119+ E02E              ; of the file)
 120+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 121+ E02E              fh_read:
 122+ E02E DD E5                push ix
 123+ E030 E5                   push hl
 124+ E031 DD E1                pop ix
 125+ E033                      ESXDOS F_READ
 125+ E033 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 125+ E036 CF          >        rst $08
 125+ E037 9D          >        db F_READ
 125+ E038 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 126+ E03B DD E1                pop ix
 127+ E03D C9                   ret
 128+ E03E
 129+ E03E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 130+ E03E              ; A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
 131+ E03E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 132+ E03E              fh_write:
 133+ E03E DD E5                push ix
 134+ E040 E5                   push hl
 135+ E041 DD E1                pop ix
 136+ E043                      ESXDOS F_WRITE
 136+ E043 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 136+ E046 CF          >        rst $08
 136+ E047 9E          >        db F_WRITE
 136+ E048 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 137+ E04B DD E1                pop ix
 138+ E04D C9                   ret
 139+ E04E
 140+ E04E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 141+ E04E              ; A = handle, BCDE = offset (32-bit), L = mode (SEEK_*) -> BCDE = position
 142+ E04E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 143+ E04E              fh_seek:
 144+ E04E DD E5                push ix
 145+ E050 E5                   push hl
 146+ E051 E5                   push hl
 147+ E052 DD E1                pop ix                          ; mode in IXL (programs) and L
 148+ E054                      ESXDOS F_SEEK
 148+ E054 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 148+ E057 CF          >        rst $08
 148+ E058 9F          >        db F_SEEK
 148+ E059 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 149+ E05C E1                   pop hl
 150+ E05D DD E1                pop ix
 151+ E05F C9                   ret
 152+ E060
 153+ E060              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 154+ E060              ; A = handle -> BCDE = file size (32-bit)
 155+ E060              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 156+ E060              fh_size:
 157+ E060 DD E5                push ix
 158+ E062 E5                   push hl
 159+ E063 21 2E E1             ld hl,fh_stat
 160+ E066 E5                   push hl
 161+ E067 DD E1                pop ix
 162+ E069                      ESXDOS F_FSTAT
 162+ E069 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 162+ E06C CF          >        rst $08
 162+ E06D A1          >        db F_FSTAT
 162+ E06E CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 163+ E071 38 0A                jr c,.x
 164+ E073 2A 35 E1             ld hl,(fh_stat+FSTAT_SIZE)
 165+ E076 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; DE = low word
 166+ E077 2A 37 E1             ld hl,(fh_stat+FSTAT_SIZE+2)
 167+ E07A 44                   ld b,h                          ; BC = high word
 168+ E07B 4D                   ld c,l
 169+ E07C B7                   or a
 170+ E07D E1           .x:     pop hl
 171+ E07E DD E1                pop ix
 172+ E080 C9                   ret
 173+ E081
 174+ E081              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 175+ E081              ; Load a file: HL -> name, DE = address, BC = most bytes to read
 176+ E081              ; -> BC = bytes read.  The file is opened, read and closed.
 177+ E081              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 178+ E081              fh_load:
 179+ E081 D5                   push de
 180+ E082 C5                   push bc
 181+ E083 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 182+ E085 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 183+ E088 C1                   pop bc
 184+ E089 E1                   pop hl                          ; HL = address
 185+ E08A D8                   ret c                           ; couldn't open (A = error)
 186+ E08B CD 2E E0             call fh_read
 187+ E08E 18 0D                jr fh_done                      ; close it, keeping any error
 188+ E090
 189+ E090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ E090              ; Save a file: HL -> name, DE = address, BC = length.  The file is created,
 191+ E090              ; replacing any file of that name.
 192+ E090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 193+ E090              fh_save:
 194+ E090 D5                   push de
 195+ E091 C5                   push bc
 196+ E092 06 0E                ld b,FA_OVERWRITE
 197+ E094 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 198+ E097 C1                   pop bc
 199+ E098 E1                   pop hl
 200+ E099 D8                   ret c
 201+ E09A CD 3E E0             call fh_write
 202+ E09D                      ; fall through
 203+ E09D
 204+ E09D              ; After a read / write on fh_handle: close the file.  Carry and A as from
 205+ E09D              ; that read / write if it failed, else as from the close.
 206+ E09D              fh_done:
 207+ E09D F5                   push af
 208+ E09E 3A 2A E1             ld a,(fh_handle)
 209+ E0A1 CD 25 E0             call fh_close
 210+ E0A4 38 02                jr c,.cerr
 211+ E0A6 F1                   pop af                          ; the read / write's result
 212+ E0A7 C9                   ret
 213+ E0A8 E1           .cerr:  pop hl                          ; the close failed: if the read /
 214+ E0A9 CB 45                bit 0,l                         ; write had already failed, report
 215+ E0AB 28 01                jr z,.ce                        ; that, else the close's error
 216+ E0AD 7C                   ld a,h
 217+ E0AE 37           .ce:    scf
 218+ E0AF C9                   ret
 219+ E0B0
 220+ E0B0              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 221+ E0B0              ; HL -> name: carry clear if the file exists (it can be opened to read)
 222+ E0B0              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 223+ E0B0              fh_exists:
 224+ E0B0 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 225+ E0B2 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 226+ E0B5 D8                   ret c
 227+ E0B6 C3 25 E0             jp fh_close
 228+ E0B9
 229+ E0B9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 230+ E0B9              ; HL -> name: delete the file
 231+ E0B9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 232+ E0B9              fh_delete:
 233+ E0B9 DD E5                push ix
 234+ E0BB E5                   push hl
 235+ E0BC DD E1                pop ix
 236+ E0BE 3A 29 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)
 237+ E0C1                      ESXDOS F_UNLINK
 237+ E0C1 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 237+ E0C4 CF          >        rst $08
 237+ E0C5 AD          >        db F_UNLINK
 237+ E0C6 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 238+ E0C9 DD E1                pop ix
 239+ E0CB C9                   ret
 240+ E0CC
 241+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 242+ E0CC              ; HL -> name: make the folder
 243+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 244+ E0CC              fh_mkdir:
 245+ E0CC DD E5                push ix
 246+ E0CE E5                   push hl
 247+ E0CF DD E1                pop ix
 248+ E0D1 3A 29 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)
 249+ E0D4                      ESXDOS F_MKDIR
 249+ E0D4 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 249+ E0D7 CF          >        rst $08
 249+ E0D8 AA          >        db F_MKDIR
 249+ E0D9 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 250+ E0DC DD E1                pop ix
 251+ E0DE C9                   ret
 252+ E0DF
 253+ E0DF              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 254+ E0DF              ; Page the ROM into slots 0 and 1 for RST $08, remembering the game's pages
 255+ E0DF              ; (fh_rom_in), and put them back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off in
 256+ E0DF              ; between (the ROM covers the interrupt routine, slot 1), and back on after
 257+ E0DF              ; if they were on before.  Both keep every register and flag.
 258+ E0DF              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 259+ E0DF              fh_rom_in:
 260+ E0DF F5                   push af
 261+ E0E0 ED 57                ld a,i                          ; P/V: interrupts on (IFF2)
 262+ E0E2 F3                   di
 263+ E0E3 3E 00                ld a,0
 264+ E0E5 E2 E9 E0             jp po,.off
 265+ E0E8 3C                   inc a
 266+ E0E9 32 2D E1     .off:   ld (fh_ints),a
 267+ E0EC C5                   push bc
 268+ E0ED 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 269+ E0F0 3E 50                ld a,MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER        ; slot 0's page now
 270+ E0F2 ED 79                out (c),a
 271+ E0F4 04                   inc b
 272+ E0F5 ED 78                in a,(c)
 273+ E0F7 32 2B E1             ld (fh_mmu0),a
 274+ E0FA 05                   dec b
 275+ E0FB 3E 51                ld a,MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER        ; slot 1's
 276+ E0FD ED 79                out (c),a
 277+ E0FF 04                   inc b
 278+ E100 ED 78                in a,(c)
 279+ E102 32 2C E1             ld (fh_mmu1),a
 280+ E105 ED 91 50 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 281+ E109 ED 91 51 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 282+ E10D C1                   pop bc
 283+ E10E F1                   pop af
 284+ E10F C9                   ret
 285+ E110
 286+ E110              fh_rom_out:
 287+ E110 F3                   di                              ; (in case esxDOS enabled them)
 288+ E111 F5                   push af
 289+ E112 3A 2B E1             ld a,(fh_mmu0)
 290+ E115 ED 92 50             nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,a
 291+ E118 3A 2C E1             ld a,(fh_mmu1)
 292+ E11B ED 92 51             nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,a
 293+ E11E 3A 2D E1             ld a,(fh_ints)
 294+ E121 B7                   or a
 295+ E122 28 03                jr z,.off
 296+ E124 F1                   pop af
 297+ E125 FB                   ei                              ; on again, as they were
 298+ E126 C9                   ret
 299+ E127 F1           .off:   pop af
 300+ E128 C9                   ret
 301+ E129
 302+ E129              ;==============================================================================
 303+ E129              ; File handler data
 304+ E129              ;==============================================================================
 305+ E129 2A           fh_drive:   db ESX_DEFAULT              ; drive for F_OPEN (fh_init)
 306+ E12A 00           fh_handle:  db 0                        ; the last file opened
 307+ E12B 00           fh_mmu0:    db 0                        ; the game's slot 0 / 1 pages during
 308+ E12C 00           fh_mmu1:    db 0                        ; an esxDOS call
 309+ E12D 00           fh_ints:    db 0                        ; 1: interrupts were on before it
 310+ E12E 00 00 00...  fh_stat:    ds FSTAT_LEN                ; F_FSTAT buffer (fh_size)

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - audio (8K page PAGE_AUDIO, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in
   3+ E000              ; with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Sound devices: the Next's TurboSound, three AY-3-8912 chips.  initgame
   6+ E000              ; (initialise.asm) has already set the chip mode to AY (NextReg $06),
   7+ E000              ; turned TurboSound and the internal speaker on (NextReg $08), and the
   8+ E000              ; engines' chip, AY 1, to mono (NextReg $09: its three channels in the
   9+ E000              ; centre, AY_MONO_ENGINES), the effects' chips stereo.  init_audio then sets every chip to a
  10+ E000              ; known, silent state (at start-up, and on every menu screen: menu_quiet).
  11+ E000              ; AY 1 is the VTOL's engines: engine_start here, then the interrupt routine
  12+ E000              ; plays them (engine_tick, interrupts.asm).  AY 2 is the weapons' sound
  13+ E000              ; effects, AY 3 explosions: the game asks for one with ld a,SFX_n / ld
  14+ E000              ; (sfx_req),a (AY 2's A and B), ld (sfx2_req),a (AY 3's A and B), ld
  15+ E000              ; (sfx3_req),a (AY 3's C) or ld (sfx4_req),a (AY 2's C: the base's
  16+ E000              ; warnings), and the interrupt plays it (sfx_tick).  (Music would need AY 3
  17+ E000              ; back.)  The interrupt writes the AY ports while eng_on is 1,
  18+ E000              ; so code here writes them only with eng_on 0 (or interrupts off).
  19+ E000              ;
  20+ E000              ; TurboSound ports:
  21+ E000              ;   $FFFD write %1LR111cc: select AY chip cc (AY_CHIP_1..3) with its left
  22+ E000              ;         (L) and right (R) outputs on;
  23+ E000              ;         any value 0..15: select that register of the selected chip
  24+ E000              ;   $BFFD write: the value of the selected register
  25+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  26+ E000
  27+ E000              AY_CTRL_PORT    equ $FFFD           ; chip / register select
  28+ E000              AY_DATA_PORT    equ $BFFD           ; register value
  29+ E000
  30+ E000              ; Chip select ($FFFD): AY_SELECT | AY_LEFT | AY_RIGHT | AY_CHIP_n
  31+ E000              AY_SELECT       equ %10011100       ; bit 7 and bits 4-2 must be set
  32+ E000              AY_LEFT         equ %01000000       ; left output on
  33+ E000              AY_RIGHT        equ %00100000       ; right output on
  34+ E000              AY_CHIP_1       equ %11
  35+ E000              AY_CHIP_2       equ %10
  36+ E000              AY_CHIP_3       equ %01
  37+ E000              ; NextReg $09 (Peripheral 4) bits 5-7 put the hardware's AY 0, 1, 2 in mono:
  38+ E000              ; select %11 is its AY 0, the game's AY 1 (the engines), so bit 5
  39+ E000              AY_MONO_ENGINES equ %00100000
  40+ E000                      ASSERT AY_CHIP_1 == %11
  41+ E000
  42+ E000              ; AY registers
  43+ E000              AY_TONE_A       equ 0               ; channel A tone period: fine, coarse (4)
  44+ E000              AY_TONE_B       equ 2
  45+ E000              AY_TONE_C       equ 4
  46+ E000              AY_NOISE        equ 6               ; noise period (5 bits)
  47+ E000              AY_MIXER        equ 7               ; tone / noise enable, 0 = on:
  48+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_A    equ %00000001       ;   bits 0-2 tone A-C off,
  49+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_B    equ %00000010
  50+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_C    equ %00000100
  51+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_A   equ %00001000       ;   bits 3-5 noise A-C off
  52+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_B   equ %00010000
  53+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_C   equ %00100000
  54+ E000              AY_VOL_A        equ 8               ; amplitude 0-15 (bit 4: use envelope)
  55+ E000              AY_VOL_B        equ 9
  56+ E000              AY_VOL_C        equ 10
  57+ E000              AY_ENV_FINE     equ 11              ; envelope period
  58+ E000              AY_ENV_COARSE   equ 12
  59+ E000              AY_ENV_SHAPE    equ 13              ; envelope shape
  60+ E000              AY_REGS         equ 14
  61+ E000
  62+ E000              AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD equ %1101        ; envelope: rise once, then hold
  63+ E000              AY_MIXER_INIT   equ AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  64+ E000                                                  ; tones on, noise off
  65+ E000
  66+ E000              ; The engines (AY 1): jet turbines, from n = |speed| (at least 1: the idle,
  67+ E000              ; at zero throttle, sounds as speed 1), 1..SPEED_MAX
  68+ E000              ENG_MIXER       equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  69+ E000                                                  ; A noise only, B and C tone only
  70+ E000              ENG_NOISE0      equ 29              ; A, the roar: noise period 29 - n*13/16
  71+ E000              ENG_NOISE_MUL   equ 13              ;   (29 at idle, a rumble; 7 flat out, a hiss)
  72+ E000              ENG_ROAR_VOL0   equ 4               ;   volume 4 + n*7/32 (4..10)
  73+ E000              ENG_WHINE0      equ 222             ; B, the turbine whine: period 222 - 3n
  74+ E000              ENG_WHINE_STEP  equ 3               ;   (~500 Hz at idle, ~790 Hz flat out)
  75+ E000              ENG_WHINE_VOL0  equ 2               ;   volume 2 + n*7/32 (2..8)
  76+ E000              ENG_VOL_MUL     equ 7               ; the volumes rise by n*7/32 (0..6)
  77+ E000              ENG_DETUNE      equ 2               ; C, the same whine 2 periods lower: the
  78+ E000              ENG_SHIMMER_VOL equ 2               ;   two beat (the turbines' shimmer), 2 quieter
  79+ E000              ; Sound effects (sfx_tick, interrupts.asm): their numbers, and the step codes
  80+ E000              SFX_MG          equ 1               ; the machine gun: one round
  81+ E000              SFX_LASER       equ 2               ; the pulse laser: one pulse (a zap)
  82+ E000              SFX_CHAIN       equ 3               ; the chain gun: one round
  83+ E000              SFX_ROCKET      equ 4               ; a rocket fired: a short woosh
  84+ E000              SFX_MISSILE     equ 5               ; a missile fired: a longer woosh
  85+ E000              SFX_AUTOCANNON  equ 6               ; the autocannon / proximity cannon: one shell
  86+ E000              SFX_BOOM_ROCKET equ 7               ; explosions (AY 3, sfx2_req): a rocket's,
  87+ E000              SFX_BOOM_MISSILE equ 8              ;   a missile's,
  88+ E000              SFX_BOOM_AUTOCANNON equ 9           ;   an autocannon shell's,
  89+ E000              SFX_BOOM_PROX   equ 10              ;   a proximity shell's
  90+ E000              SFX_SPLAT       equ 11              ; a zombie hit (AY 3 channel C, sfx3_req)
  91+ E000              SFX_CRASH       equ 12              ; the VTOL hitting a building (AY 3, sfx2_req)
  92+ E000              SFX_LOCK        equ 13              ; the missile lock: a double beep (AY 2)
  93+ E000              SFX_CHARGE      equ 14              ; the devil charging its lightning: a
  94+ E000                                                  ; rising whine (AY 3 channel C, sfx3_req)
  95+ E000              SFX_BOLT        equ 15              ; its lightning: a crackling zap, then
  96+ E000                                                  ; thunder (AY 3, sfx2_req)
  97+ E000              SFX_WARN_LOW    equ 16              ; the base's warnings (AY 2 C, sfx4_req):
  98+ E000                                                  ;   a terrace or barricade hit, a low beep;
  99+ E000              SFX_WARN_MID    equ 17              ;   the landing pad hit, a mid one
 100+ E000              SFX_WARN_HIGH   equ 18              ; integrity below 10%: 3 high beeps
 101+ E000                                                  ;   (AY 2 C, sfx4_req: draw_leds)
 102+ E000              SFX_LAST        equ 18              ; (sfx_table, sfx_data.asm)
 103+ E000              SFX_STEP        equ $FE             ; end of a step: the next, next interrupt
 104+ E000              SFX_END         equ $FF             ; end of the sound
 105+ E000              ; AY 2's mixers keep tone C on (and its noise off): channel C is the
 106+ E000              ; warnings' (voice 4), so the weapons' sounds leave it alone
 107+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A_TONE_B equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 108+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only, B tone only
 109+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_AB equ AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 110+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A and B tones only
 111+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 112+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only
 113+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_A  equ AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 114+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A tone only
 115+ E000              SFX_MIX_BOOM    equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 116+ E000                                                  ; AY 3's mixer: A noise, B tone (the
 117+ E000                                                  ; explosions), C tone (the splats)
 118+ E000                      ASSERT AY_REGS < SFX_STEP
 119+ E000
 120+ E000              ENG_FRAC        equ 16              ; the engines' speed (eng_cur) in 1/16 steps:
 121+ E000              ENG_SPIN_UP     equ 4               ;   up by at most 4/16 an interrupt (12.5 steps
 122+ E000              ENG_SPIN_DOWN   equ 2               ;   a second), down by 2/16 (6.25 a second)
 123+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_SPIN_UP > 0 && ENG_SPIN_DOWN > 0
 124+ E000                      ASSERT -SPEED_MIN <= SPEED_MAX
 125+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE0 - SPEED_MAX*ENG_WHINE_STEP > 0 && ENG_WHINE0 + ENG_DETUNE < 256
 126+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_NOISE0 < 32 && ENG_NOISE0 - (SPEED_MAX*ENG_NOISE_MUL)/16 >= 1
 127+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_ROAR_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15 && ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15
 128+ E000                      ASSERT SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL < 256
 129+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_VOL0 >= ENG_SHIMMER_VOL
 130+ E000
 131+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 132+ E000              ; Set up the sound devices: each AY chip selected with both outputs, every
 133+ E000              ; register 0 (silent: all volumes 0), then the mixer to tones only and the
 134+ E000              ; envelope to attack-and-hold.  AY 1 is left selected.
 135+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 136+ E000              init_audio:
 137+ E000 AF                   xor a                           ; the engines off first: the interrupt
 138+ E001 32 89 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; leaves the AYs alone (interrupts.asm)
 139+ E004 32 8A 3C             ld (sfx_req),a                  ; and no sound effect asked for or
 140+ E007 32 8D 3C             ld (sfx2_req),a                 ; playing, on any voice
 141+ E00A 32 90 3C             ld (sfx3_req),a
 142+ E00D 32 93 3C             ld (sfx4_req),a
 143+ E010 67                   ld h,a
 144+ E011 6F                   ld l,a
 145+ E012 22 8B 3C             ld (sfx_ptr),hl
 146+ E015 22 8E 3C             ld (sfx2_ptr),hl
 147+ E018 22 91 3C             ld (sfx3_ptr),hl
 148+ E01B 22 94 3C             ld (sfx4_ptr),hl
 149+ E01E 3E 01                ld a,AY_CHIP_3
 150+ E020 CD 2A E0             call ay_init_chip
 151+ E023 3E 02                ld a,AY_CHIP_2
 152+ E025 CD 2A E0             call ay_init_chip
 153+ E028 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 154+ E02A                      ; fall through
 155+ E02A
 156+ E02A              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it in stereo, clear it, mixer and envelope
 157+ E02A              ay_init_chip:
 158+ E02A CD 63 E0             call ay_select
 159+ E02D 16 0D                ld d,AY_REGS-1                  ; registers 13..0 = 0
 160+ E02F 7A           .clr:   ld a,d
 161+ E030 1E 00                ld e,0
 162+ E032 CD 6B E0             call ay_write
 163+ E035 15                   dec d
 164+ E036 F2 2F E0             jp p,.clr
 165+ E039 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 166+ E03B 1E 38                ld e,AY_MIXER_INIT
 167+ E03D CD 6B E0             call ay_write
 168+ E040 3E 0D                ld a,AY_ENV_SHAPE
 169+ E042 1E 0D                ld e,AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD
 170+ E044 C3 6B E0             jp ay_write
 171+ E047
 172+ E047              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 173+ E047              ; The VTOL's engines: jet turbines, not rotors, so a steady roar and whine
 174+ E047              ; rather than a chop.  AY 1, all three channels, kept for them.  They never
 175+ E047              ; stop in play: at zero throttle they idle, as at speed 1.  The interrupt
 176+ E047              ; routine plays them, 50 times a second (engine_tick, interrupts.asm): the
 177+ E047              ; sound's speed spools towards the VTOL's, so pitch and volume rise and fall
 178+ E047              ; smoothly.  (The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is
 179+ E047              ; 109375/P Hz.)
 180+ E047              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 181+ E047              ; Start of each level (next_level): AY 1's mixer for the engines, the sound's
 182+ E047              ; speed 0 (they spool up to the idle), and the interrupt playing them
 183+ E047              engine_start:
 184+ E047 AF                   xor a
 185+ E048 32 89 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; (the interrupt off AY 1 meanwhile)
 186+ E04B 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 187+ E04E 22 97 3C             ld (eng_cur),hl
 188+ E051 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 189+ E053 CD 63 E0             call ay_select
 190+ E056 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 191+ E058 1E 31                ld e,ENG_MIXER
 192+ E05A CD 6B E0             call ay_write
 193+ E05D 3E 01                ld a,1
 194+ E05F 32 89 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; the interrupt plays them now
 195+ E062 C9                   ret
 196+ E063
 197+ E063              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 198+ E063              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it, with both outputs on
 199+ E063              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 200+ E063              ay_select:
 201+ E063 F6 FC                or AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT
 202+ E065 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 203+ E068 ED 79                out (c),a
 204+ E06A C9                   ret
 205+ E06B
 206+ E06B              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 207+ E06B              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected chip.  Keeps D, E, HL.
 208+ E06B              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 209+ E06B              ay_write:
 210+ E06B 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 211+ E06E ED 79                out (c),a
 212+ E070 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 213+ E072 ED 59                out (c),e
 214+ E074 C9                   ret
