2763  E075                      INCLUDE "sound.asm"             ; the players (the interrupt calls them)
# file opened: sound.asm
   1+ E075              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E075              ; Z-POLICE - the sound players (in the audio page, PAGE_AUDIO, with
   3+ E075              ; audio.asm and the sounds, sfx_data.asm): called by the interrupt routine
   4+ E075              ; (im2_routine, interrupts.asm) 50 times a second with this page mapped
   5+ E075              ; into slot 7 for them (the page there put back after).  The game asks for
   6+ E075              ; a sound through the resident request bytes (sfx_req, sfx2_req, sfx3_req:
   7+ E075              ; interrupts.asm), so any page can.
   8+ E075              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E075
  10+ E075              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  11+ E075              ; The VTOL's engines (audio.asm has the sound's constants and engine_start):
  12+ E075              ; jet turbines, on AY 1.  eng_cur is the speed the engines sound at, in
  13+ E075              ; 1/ENG_FRAC steps; each interrupt it follows the VTOL's, n = |speed| (at
  14+ E075              ; least 1: zero throttle idles as speed 1), by at most ENG_SPIN_UP going up
  15+ E075              ; and ENG_SPIN_DOWN going down: the turbines spool up, and down more slowly,
  16+ E075              ; instead of jumping.  From it:
  17+ E075              ;   A  noise, the roar: period ENG_NOISE0 - m*13/16, volume ENG_ROAR_VOL0 +
  18+ E075              ;      m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
  19+ E075              ;      (m = eng_cur/ENG_FRAC, whole steps)
  20+ E075              ;   B  tone, the turbine whine: period ENG_WHINE0 - eng_cur*ENG_WHINE_STEP/
  21+ E075              ;      ENG_FRAC (sliding smoothly), volume ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
  22+ E075              ;   C  the same whine ENG_DETUNE periods lower and ENG_SHIMMER_VOL quieter:
  23+ E075              ;      the two beat, the turbines' shimmer
  24+ E075              ; Written only when eng_cur moves.  Nothing while eng_on is 0 (menus).
  25+ E075              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  26+ E075              engine_tick:
  27+ E075 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)
  28+ E078 B7                   or a
  29+ E079 C8                   ret z
  30+ E07A 3A 14 AF             ld a,(speed)
  31+ E07D B7                   or a
  32+ E07E F2 83 E0             jp p,.pos
  33+ E081 ED 44                neg                             ; reversing: its size
  34+ E083 B7           .pos:   or a
  35+ E084 20 01                jr nz,.n
  36+ E086 3C                   inc a                           ; zero throttle: idle, as speed 1
  37+ E087 FE 1D        .n:     cp SPEED_MAX+1
  38+ E089 38 02                jr c,.nm
  39+ E08B 3E 1C                ld a,SPEED_MAX                  ; (boosting: as flat out)
  40+ E08D 5F           .nm:    ld e,a
  41+ E08E 16 10                ld d,ENG_FRAC
  42+ E090 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = the target, in 1/ENG_FRAC steps
  43+ E092 2A 97 3C             ld hl,(eng_cur)
  44+ E095 B7                   or a
  45+ E096 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; HL = eng_cur - target
  46+ E098 C8                   ret z                           ; there: nothing changes
  47+ E099 38 09                jr c,.up
  48+ E09B 01 FE FF             ld bc,-ENG_SPIN_DOWN            ; above: down a step
  49+ E09E 09                   add hl,bc
  50+ E09F 30 0C                jr nc,.tgt                      ; (less than a step away: there)
  51+ E0A1 19                   add hl,de
  52+ E0A2 18 0A                jr .set
  53+ E0A4 01 04 00     .up:    ld bc,ENG_SPIN_UP               ; below: up a step
  54+ E0A7 09                   add hl,bc
  55+ E0A8 38 03                jr c,.tgt                       ; (reached it)
  56+ E0AA 19                   add hl,de
  57+ E0AB 18 01                jr .set
  58+ E0AD EB           .tgt:   ex de,hl
  59+ E0AE 22 97 3C     .set:   ld (eng_cur),hl
  60+ E0B1 3E FF                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_1
  61+ E0B3 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
  62+ E0B6 ED 79                out (c),a
  63+ E0B8 E5                   push hl
  64+ E0B9 54                   ld d,h                          ; B: the whine's period
  65+ E0BA 5D                   ld e,l
  66+ E0BB 29                   add hl,hl
  67+ E0BC 19                   add hl,de                       ; eng_cur * ENG_WHINE_STEP
  68+ E0BD EB                   ex de,hl
  69+ E0BE 06 04                ld b,4
  70+ E0C0 ED 2A                bsrl de,b                       ; / ENG_FRAC
  71+ E0C2                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_STEP == 3 && ENG_FRAC == 16
  72+ E0C2 3E DE                ld a,ENG_WHINE0
  73+ E0C4 93                   sub e
  74+ E0C5 6F                   ld l,a                          ; L = the whine's period
  75+ E0C6 5F                   ld e,a
  76+ E0C7 3E 02                ld a,AY_TONE_B
  77+ E0C9 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  78+ E0CC 3E 03                ld a,AY_TONE_B+1
  79+ E0CE 1E 00                ld e,0
  80+ E0D0 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  81+ E0D3 7D                   ld a,l                          ; C: a little lower, to beat with B
  82+ E0D4 C6 02                add a,ENG_DETUNE
  83+ E0D6 5F                   ld e,a
  84+ E0D7 3E 04                ld a,AY_TONE_C
  85+ E0D9 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  86+ E0DC 3E 05                ld a,AY_TONE_C+1
  87+ E0DE 1E 00                ld e,0
  88+ E0E0 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  89+ E0E3 D1                   pop de                          ; m = eng_cur / ENG_FRAC
  90+ E0E4 06 04                ld b,4
  91+ E0E6 ED 2A                bsrl de,b
  92+ E0E8 63                   ld h,e                          ; H = m
  93+ E0E9 54                   ld d,h                          ; A: the roar's noise period
  94+ E0EA 1E 0D                ld e,ENG_NOISE_MUL
  95+ E0EC ED 30                mul d,e
  96+ E0EE 06 04                ld b,4
  97+ E0F0 ED 2A                bsrl de,b                       ; m*13/16
  98+ E0F2 3E 1D                ld a,ENG_NOISE0
  99+ E0F4 93                   sub e
 100+ E0F5 5F                   ld e,a
 101+ E0F6 3E 06                ld a,AY_NOISE
 102+ E0F8 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 103+ E0FB 54                   ld d,h                          ; the volumes: louder with speed
 104+ E0FC 1E 07                ld e,ENG_VOL_MUL
 105+ E0FE ED 30                mul d,e
 106+ E100 06 05                ld b,5
 107+ E102 ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 108+ E104 7B                   ld a,e
 109+ E105 6F                   ld l,a                          ; L = m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
 110+ E106 C6 04                add a,ENG_ROAR_VOL0
 111+ E108 5F                   ld e,a
 112+ E109 3E 08                ld a,AY_VOL_A
 113+ E10B CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 114+ E10E 7D                   ld a,l
 115+ E10F C6 02                add a,ENG_WHINE_VOL0
 116+ E111 5F                   ld e,a
 117+ E112 3E 09                ld a,AY_VOL_B
 118+ E114 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 119+ E117 7B                   ld a,e
 120+ E118 D6 02                sub ENG_SHIMMER_VOL
 121+ E11A 5F                   ld e,a
 122+ E11B 3E 0A                ld a,AY_VOL_C
 123+ E11D                      ; fall through
 124+ E11D
 125+ E11D              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected AY chip (here: the
 126+ E11D              ; interrupt's own, as ay_write is in a page that may not be in).  Keeps D,
 127+ E11D              ; E, HL.
 128+ E11D              isr_ay:
 129+ E11D 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 130+ E120 ED 79                out (c),a
 131+ E122 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 132+ E124 ED 59                out (c),e
 133+ E126 C9                   ret
 134+ E127
 135+ E127              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 136+ E127              ; Sound effects, three voices: the weapons on AY 2 (sfx_req), explosions on
 137+ E127              ; AY 3's channels A and B (sfx2_req), and splats on AY 3's channel C
 138+ E127              ; (sfx3_req: a tone only, as the chip's noise is the explosions'), so none
 139+ E127              ; cuts another.  (The splats write only channel C's tone and volume, and
 140+ E127              ; the explosions leave channel C alone, its tone kept on in the mixer.)  The
 141+ E127              ; engines have AY 1.  The game asks for a sound by putting its number in a
 142+ E127              ; voice's request byte (SFX_*, audio.asm): one byte, so safe from any page
 143+ E127              ; at any time; only the interrupt writes the AY chips.  Each voice plays one
 144+ E127              ; sound at a time: a new one cuts the last.  A sound is a list of steps, one
 145+ E127              ; an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value pairs, ended by
 146+ E127              ; SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (the sound is over).
 147+ E127              ; Nothing while eng_on is 0 (menus).
 148+ E127              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 149+ E127              sfx_tick:
 150+ E127 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)
 151+ E12A B7                   or a
 152+ E12B C8                   ret z
 153+ E12C 21 8A 3C             ld hl,sfx_req                   ; the weapons, AY 2
 154+ E12F 3E FE                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_2
 155+ E131 CD 49 E1             call sfx_voice
 156+ E134 21 8D 3C             ld hl,sfx2_req                  ; explosions, AY 3 (A, B)
 157+ E137 3E FD                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_3
 158+ E139 CD 49 E1             call sfx_voice
 159+ E13C 21 90 3C             ld hl,sfx3_req                  ; splats, AY 3 (C)
 160+ E13F 3E FD                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_3
 161+ E141 CD 49 E1             call sfx_voice
 162+ E144 21 93 3C             ld hl,sfx4_req                  ; the base's warnings, AY 2 (C)
 163+ E147 3E FE                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_2
 164+ E149                      ; fall through
 165+ E149
 166+ E149              ; HL -> a voice (its request byte, then its sound's next step, a word: 0
 167+ E149              ; none), A = its AY chip's select value: start a sound asked for, and play
 168+ E149              ; the next step
 169+ E149              sfx_voice:
 170+ E149 32 96 3C             ld (sv_sel),a
 171+ E14C 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; a new sound asked for?
 172+ E14D B7                   or a
 173+ E14E 28 13                jr z,.play
 174+ E150 36 00                ld (hl),0                       ; (taken)
 175+ E152 E5                   push hl
 176+ E153 21 8C E1             ld hl,sfx_table-2
 177+ E156 87                   add a,a
 178+ E157 ED 31                add hl,a
 179+ E159 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 180+ E15A 23                   inc hl
 181+ E15B 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE -> it
 182+ E15C E1                   pop hl
 183+ E15D 23                   inc hl
 184+ E15E 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; it starts now (cutting any other)
 185+ E15F 23                   inc hl
 186+ E160 72                   ld (hl),d
 187+ E161 2B                   dec hl
 188+ E162 2B                   dec hl
 189+ E163 23           .play:  inc hl
 190+ E164 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 191+ E165 23                   inc hl
 192+ E166 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE -> the next step; HL -> its high byte
 193+ E167 7A                   ld a,d
 194+ E168 B3                   or e
 195+ E169 C8                   ret z                           ; nothing playing
 196+ E16A E5                   push hl
 197+ E16B 3A 96 3C             ld a,(sv_sel)
 198+ E16E 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 199+ E171 ED 79                out (c),a
 200+ E173 EB                   ex de,hl
 201+ E174 7E           .lp:    ld a,(hl)                       ; this step's register / value pairs
 202+ E175 23                   inc hl
 203+ E176 FE FE                cp SFX_STEP
 204+ E178 28 0E                jr z,.step
 205+ E17A FE FF                cp SFX_END
 206+ E17C 28 07                jr z,.end
 207+ E17E 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 208+ E17F 23                   inc hl
 209+ E180 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 210+ E183 18 EF                jr .lp
 211+ E185 21 00 00     .end:   ld hl,0                         ; over
 212+ E188 EB           .step:  ex de,hl                        ; (the next step, next interrupt)
 213+ E189 E1                   pop hl
 214+ E18A 72                   ld (hl),d
 215+ E18B 2B                   dec hl
 216+ E18C 73                   ld (hl),e
 217+ E18D C9                   ret

2764  E18E                      INCLUDE "sfx_data.asm"          ; the sound effects (sfx_tick plays them)
# file opened: sfx_data.asm
   1+ E18E              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E18E              ; Z-POLICE - sound effect data (in the audio page, with the players,
   3+ E18E              ; sound.asm: mapped into slot 7 by the interrupt routine while it plays)
   4+ E18E              ;
   5+ E18E              ; Played on AY 2 by sfx_tick (interrupts.asm); the game asks for one with
   6+ E18E              ; ld a,SFX_n / ld (sfx_req),a (the numbers are in audio.asm).  A sound is a
   7+ E18E              ; list of steps, one an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value
   8+ E18E              ; pairs, ended by SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (over).
   9+ E18E              ; The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is 109375/P Hz; a
  10+ E18E              ; lower noise period is a brighter hiss.
  11+ E18E              ;==============================================================================
  12+ E18E
  13+ E18E              ; One step of a zap: channel A at tone period p, channel B 2 periods flat
  14+ E18E              ; (the two beat: a buzz), volumes v and v-2
  15+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_ZAP p, v
  16+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_A, low (p), AY_TONE_A+1, high (p)
  17+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low ((p)+2), AY_TONE_B+1, high ((p)+2)
  18+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_A, v, AY_VOL_B, (v)-2, SFX_STEP
  19+ E18E                  ENDM
  20+ E18E
  21+ E18E              ; One step of a woosh: channel A's noise at period n, volume v
  22+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_WOOSH n, v
  23+ E18E ~                    db AY_NOISE, n, AY_VOL_A, v, SFX_STEP
  24+ E18E                  ENDM
  25+ E18E
  26+ E18E              ; An explosion: a deep noise (channel A, darkening: period 16 up to 30) over
  27+ E18E              ; a low rumble (channel B, BOOM_RUMBLE), both from volume peak (B 2 less)
  28+ E18E              ; fading to nothing over len steps.  (A falling level is an exponential fade:
  29+ E18E              ; the AY's levels are logarithmic.)
  30+ E18E              BOOM_RUMBLE     equ 2735            ; 109375 / 2735 = 40 Hz
  31+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_BOOM peak, len
  32+ E18E ~                    db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
  33+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
  34+ E18E ~            BOOM_I  DEFL 0
  35+ E18E ~                    DUP len
  36+ E18E ~                    db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(len)
  37+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_A, ((peak)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  38+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_B, (((peak)-2)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  39+ E18E ~                    db SFX_STEP
  40+ E18E ~            BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
  41+ E18E ~                    EDUP
  42+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END

 162+ E2B1              ; Explosions (rocket_blast, weapons.asm; on AY 3).  Each one's loudness in
 163+ E2B1              ; proportion to its blast's size, damage x reach (game units):
 164+ E2B1              ;   missile 15 x 256 = 3840, rocket 20 x 64 = 1280, autocannon 4 x 38 = 152,
 165+ E2B1              ;   proximity 3 x 25 = 75.
 166+ E2B1              ; Sound level is logarithmic (about 2 AY levels each doubling), so the peak
 167+ E2B1              ; is 15 + 2*log2(size / the missile's): 15, 12, 6, 4; and the bigger the
 168+ E2B1              ; blast the longer it rumbles, 2 steps (40 ms) per level: 600, 480, 240 and

2767  EA37              ;==============================================================================
2768  EA37              ; Game logic pages: assembled at $C000, swapped into slot 6.  They may call
2769  EA37              ; the core page in slot 7 (main_loop has the keys there while they run).
2770  EA37              ;==============================================================================
2771  EA37                      MMU LOGIC_SLOT e, PAGE_PLAYER, LOGIC_ADDR
2772  C000                      ORG LOGIC_ADDR
2773  C000                      INCLUDE "player.asm"
# file opened: player.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - player page (8K page PAGE_PLAYER, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Keyboard input, movement along the heading, world-edge clamping and
   5+ C000              ; building collision.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,
   6+ C000              ; PAGE_PLAYER, with the keys page (key_held) in slot 7.
   7+ C000              ; Uses the resident helpers get_sin, fmul and bld_height; camera state (cam_x/z/y, yaw, pitch, speed) is shared and
   8+ C000              ; stays in zpolice.asm.
   9+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  10+ C000
  11+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  12+ C000              ; Player input and movement
  13+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  14+ C000              update_player:
  15+ C000 AF                   xor a
  16+ C001 D3 FE                out ($FE),a                     ; border back to black
  17+ C003 21 80 01             ld hl,YAW_RATE                  ; this frame's turn (a frame's worth)
  18+ C006 CD B3 A7             call fs_mul
  19+ C009 22 89 C4             ld (yaw_step),hl
  20+ C00C                      ; remember position in case we fly into something
  21+ C00C 21 08 AF             ld hl,cam_x                     ; (and the heading: turning swings
  22+ C00F 11 7C C4             ld de,old_pos                   ; the VTOL's nose and tail)
  23+ C012 01 0A 00             ld bc,10                        ; cam_x(3) cam_z(3) cam_y(2) yaw(2)
  24+ C015 ED B0                ldir
  25+ C017 3A 26 AF             ld a,(vtol_dead)
  26+ C01A B7                   or a
  27+ C01B 28 07                jr z,.alive
  28+ C01D AF                   xor a
  29+ C01E 32 BC AF             ld (boost_on),a                 ; (no boost in a wreck)
  30+ C021 C3 E6 C3             jp vtol_wreck                   ; destroyed: out of control
  31+ C024              .alive:
  32+ C024                      ; (keys: kbd_scan has read them; actions from input.asm)
  33+ C024                      ; --- boost (zpolice.asm: BOOST_*): while on, the speed keys and the
  34+ C024                      ; air brake don't change the speed, and each frame burns a fuel
  35+ C024 3A BC AF             ld a,(boost_on)

 526+ C3E6              ; The VTOL has been destroyed (vtol_dead): the controls do nothing.  It
 527+ C3E6              ; spins DEAD_SPIN a frame and falls, a unit a frame faster each frame (up
 528+ C3E6              ; to DEAD_FALL_MAX), until it hits the ground under it (floor_y: the road,
 529+ C3E6              ; or the highest roof under its footprint).  Once down it lies still for

 531+ C3E6              ; then the main menu).

 585+ C44E C9                   ret

 587+ C44F              ; One damping step: move the signed 8.8 pitch (pitch_frac/pitch) towards 0
 588+ C44F              ; by max(PDAMP_MIN, |whole pitch| * PDAMP_K), stopping exactly at 0.
 589+ C44F              ; Calculated rather than looked up: the Z80N MUL makes it as quick as a
 590+ C44F              ; table, and the curve stays editable through the two equates.
 591+ C44F              pitch_damp:
 592+ C44F 2A 12 AF             ld hl,(pitch_frac)
 593+ C452 7C                   ld a,h
 594+ C453 B5                   or l
 595+ C454 C8                   ret z                           ; already level
 596+ C455 7C                   ld a,h
 597+ C456 F5                   push af                         ; sign
 598+ C457 CD CA AE             call abs_hl
 599+ C45A 54                   ld d,h                          ; whole part of |pitch|
 600+ C45B 1E 00                ld e,PDAMP_K
 601+ C45D ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = step
 602+ C45F 7A                   ld a,d
 603+ C460 B7                   or a
 604+ C461 20 08                jr nz,.sub
 605+ C463 7B                   ld a,e
 606+ C464 FE 80                cp PDAMP_MIN
 607+ C466 30 03                jr nc,.sub
 608+ C468 11 80 00             ld de,PDAMP_MIN
 609+ C46B B7           .sub:   or a
 610+ C46C ED 52                sbc hl,de
 611+ C46E 30 03                jr nc,.sgn
 612+ C470 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; would pass level: stop at 0
 613+ C473 F1           .sgn:   pop af
 614+ C474 17                   rla                             ; carry = was nose down
 615+ C475 DC C3 AE             call c,neg_hl
 616+ C478 22 12 AF             ld (pitch_frac),hl
 617+ C47B C9                   ret

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - weapons page (8K page PAGE_WEAPONS, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Player weapons.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS
   5+ C000              ; (the keys page in slot 7) after
   6+ C000              ; the frame is set up (it uses sin_y/cos_y/sin_p/cos_p) and the zombies have
   7+ C000              ; moved.  Bullet state lives in the resident `bullets` table so that the city
   8+ C000              ; page can draw the tracers (draw_bullets).
   9+ C000              ;
  10+ C000              ; Keys 1-5 select the weapon slot that SPACE fires (wpn_sel: 1 = the centre
  11+ C000              ; slot, 2-5 = the wing pylons).  An empty slot isn't selected: the HUD
  12+ C000              ; flashes it instead (wflash_slot / wflash_t).  What is fitted where is set
  13+ C000              ; on the load-out screen between levels (loadout.asm).
  14+ C000              ;
  15+ C000              ; Machine gun (WPN_GUN, the centre slot): hold SPACE to fire one round every
  16+ C000              ; GUN_INTERVAL frames.  Rounds leave the ship's centre line 0.5 m below the
  17+ C000              ; camera and fly straight along the view direction at 500 m/s until they hit
  18+ C000              ; something.
  19+ C000              ;
  20+ C000              ; Collision, every frame for every round in flight: the path from its last
  21+ C000              ; position to its new one (BULLET_STEP long) is walked cell by cell through
  22+ C000              ; the city grid, in order (a 2D DDA on the horizontal distance s along the
  23+ C000              ; path).  The first thing met ends the path:
  24+ C000              ;   * a building cell: hit where the path enters the cell if it is below the
  25+ C000              ;     roof there (a wall), otherwise where it drops below the roof (the roof);
  26+ C000              ;   * a street cell marked as holding zombies (CELL_ZOMBIE): those in it, each a box
  27+ C000              ;     0.5 m wide and 2 m tall, nearest along the path first;
  28+ C000              ;   * the ground, where the path reaches height 0;
  29+ C000              ;   * leaving the GRID x GRID map: the round is gone.
  30+ C000              ; A round that hits is drawn once at the impact point, then freed.  A zombie
  31+ C000              ; that is hit loses B_DMG hit points; at 0 it is killed (its map blip
  32+ C000              ; removed, its record made inactive).  A rocket also bursts (rocket_blast).
  33+ C000              ;
  34+ C000              ; Rocket pod (WPN_ROCKETS, a wing pylon, ROCKET_SHOTS rockets): rockets are
  35+ C000              ; rounds too (B_KIND = BK_ROCKET), at 150 m/s and drawn as a short white
  36+ C000              ; streak with a yellow trail.  Wherever one stops (a building, the ground,
  37+ C000              ; a zombie) rocket_blast does BLAST_DMG to every zombie, human and base tile
  38+ C000              ; within BLAST_R on each axis, and sprays BLAST_PARTS orange particles.
  39+ C000              ;
  40+ C000              ; Autocannon (WPN_AUTOCANNON, a wing pylon, AUTOCANNON_SHOTS shells): the
  41+ C000              ; machine gun's rounds (B_KIND = BK_AUTOCANNON, drawn as tracers) one every
  42+ C000              ; AUTOCANNON_INTERVAL frames; each bursts where it stops: AUTOCANNON_DMG
  43+ C000              ; within AUTOCANNON_R (3 m) on each axis, AUTOCANNON_PARTS particles.
  44+ C000              ;
  45+ C000              ; Proximity cannon (WPN_PROX, a wing pylon, PROX_SHOTS shells): the
  46+ C000              ; autocannon (B_KIND = BK_PROX), its shells also bursting when they pass within
  47+ C000              ; PROX_R (2 m) of a monster (b_pr widens the monster hit boxes,
  48+ C000              ; cell_zombies); the burst does PROX_DMG within PROX_R on each axis.
  49+ C000              ;
  50+ C000              ; Missile pod (WPN_MISSILE, a wing pylon, MISSILE_SHOTS missiles): as the
  51+ C000              ; rockets (B_KIND = BK_MISSILE, drawn the same) at half the speed; the burst
  52+ C000              ; does MISSILE_DMG within MISSILE_R (1.0 tile) on each axis, and sprays
  53+ C000              ; MISSILE_PARTS particles.  Guided: one fires only with a target locked
  54+ C000              ; (lock_update: the reticule), and turns towards it (msl_steer) at
  55+ C000              ; MISSILE_TURN a frame until it is more than LOCK_RANGE away.
  56+ C000              ;
  57+ C000              ; Damage: each round carries its damage (B_DMG): machine gun GUN_DMG, chain
  58+ C000              ; gun CHAIN_DMG, the laser LASER_DMG a beam frame, a rocket none directly
  59+ C000              ; (only its blast).  A zombie dies when its hit points (+18) run out.
  60+ C000              ;
  61+ C000              ; Positions are world units (1 tile = 20 m = 256 units, 1 m = 12.8).  Along the path,
  62+ C000              ; x = x0 + s*sinY, z = z0 + s*cosY and y = y0 + s*slope, with sinY/cosY the
  63+ C000              ; S7.8 heading at firing and slope = tan(pitch) in S7.8.
  64+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  65+ C000
  66+ C000              ; A = the ticks between this weapon's shots: the next due that many on
  67+ C000              ; from when this one was (gun_ovs: past due by up to a frame), so the rate
  68+ C000              ; holds whatever the frames' length; at least a tick away

 314+ C20E              ; A chain gun round from IX: the view direction turned by a random angle

 375+ C287              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 376+ C287              ; Aim assist, for a centre slot round IX just spawned, pointing where the gun
 377+ C287              ; does (or a linked chain gun's, from its own muzzle: each on its own): the

 380+ C287              ; AIM_DEV steps of the path, or its box on the path already.  The round turns to its middle, at most
 381+ C287              ; AIM_DEV steps sideways and AIM_DEV up or down: aa_d and aa_ds, kept for the
 382+ C287              ; frame's shots (aim_apply) and the sight.  Only the round: the view doesn't
 383+ C287              ; move.  A chain gun's spread goes on top.
 384+ C287              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 385+ C287

 743+ C571
 744+ C571              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 745+ C571              ; The missile lock, each frame in flight.  With the missile pod selected the
 746+ C571              ; reticule is shown (ret_on).  Searching (lock_state 0), it wanders the view.
 747+ C571              ; A monster drawn last frame (fig_seen: +31) within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL
 748+ C571              ; along x and z, the nearest, becomes the target (lock_tgt): locking (1),
 749+ C571              ; the reticule moves to where it was drawn (+32, +33) at RET_STEP pixels a
 750+ C571              ; frame, and after LOCK_TIME frames on it (within LOCK_NEAR) the target is
 751+ C571              ; locked (2): the lock tone, and the reticule stays on it.  The target lost
 752+ C571              ; (killed, out of view, out of range) it searches again.  With a target,
 753+ C571              ; K_TARGET (M) moves to the next one (lk_next).  Then the drawn marks are
 754+ C571              ; cleared for this frame's drawing.
 755+ C571              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 756+ C571              lock_update:

 811+ C5EE 18 44                jr lk_clear

 814+ C5F3 4F                   ld c,a

 875+ C658              ; K_TARGET: the next target after lock_tgt (by index, round the list: the
 876+ C658              ; first after the last) that lk_valid takes, drawn last frame and in range;
 877+ C658              ; it locks on afresh (locking, lock_t 0: LOCK_TIME again).  Back round to

 899+ C684 32 9C AF             ld (lock_t),a
 900+ C687 C9                   ret
 901+ C688
 902+ C688              ; A = monster index -> IY = its record

 911+ C694              ; Monster IY: a target?  In play, not fading out, drawn last frame, and

1300+ C93B              ; HL = x, DE = z (signed) -> A = the angle of (x, z) from +z towards +x,

1636+ CBC6              ; A lich's fireballs, every frame (not with the VTOL a wreck).  A lich with
1637+ CBC6              ; its reload done (LICH_WAIT 0) and the VTOL within FB_RANGE fires at where
1638+ CBC6              ; the VTOL will be: from its velocity (its move last frame, sideways and up
1639+ CBC6              ; or down too) and the flight time at FB_MS, worked out twice over.  The
1640+ CBC6              ; aim is then turned by up to FB_DEV each way (round_spread).  A
1641+ CBC6              ; fireball is a round (BK_FIREBALL, in its own records: the player's guns
1642+ CBC6              ; can't use them up) that passes through monsters and stops at a building,
1643+ CBC6              ; the ground, the VTOL (within FB_HIT_R: fb_step) or after FB_FRAMES frames
1644+ CBC6              ; (FB_RANGE).  Wherever it stops it bursts (rocket_blast): FB_DMG within

   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Game over, game complete and the load error.  Game over (the VTOL or the
   5+ C000              ; landing pad destroyed) is drawn over the view, on the game's own Layer 2:
   6+ C000              ; GAME OVER, why, and PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE.  Game complete and the load
   7+ C000              ; error are Layer 2 320x256 screens in the large font (screen320, as the
   8+ C000              ; level complete).  The main menu and level complete have their
   9+ C000              ; own pages (mainmenu.asm, levelend.asm): these go back to the main menu
  10+ C000              ; through menu_go (zpolice.asm).

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - main menu (8K page PAGE_MAINMENU, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Shown after start-up, after game over, a load error, and quitting from the
   5+ C000              ; pause (menu_go, zpolice.asm, pages it in).  Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256
   6+ C000              ; (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in slot 2) in the large font
   7+ C000              ; (26 x 25 characters), over a picture: ZPDATA/MAINMENU.ZPI, read from the
   8+ C000              ; SD card as the menu opens (l320_image; tools/screen_editor.py edits it),
   9+ C000              ; drawn first as the background, the text printed over it with no paper.  Every frame it
  10+ C000              ; advances the random number generator (zrand), so the game doesn't start
  11+ C000              ; from the same seed each time (the wait for a key press varies), then reads
  12+ C000              ; the keys:
  13+ C000              ;   1  New game   -> newGame (zpolice.asm): level 1
  14+ C000              ;   2  Continue   -> the save game (made by save and quit, from the pause:
  15+ C000              ;                 game_pause), its level at its wave (load_save,
  16+ C000              ;                 continue_game, zpolice.asm); NO SAVED GAME if there's none
  17+ C000              ;   9  Redefine keys -> keydef_screen (keydef.asm)
  18+ C000              ; The game start puts the game's Layer 2 back (l2_game_mode).
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              MM_COL          equ 2               ; the options' column
  22+ C000              MM_NOSAVE_ROW   equ 18
  23+ C000
  24+ C000              main_menu:
  25+ C000 CD D6 A0             call screen320                  ; (text.asm) the input page in slot 7
  26+ C003 21 A6 C0             ld hl,mm_img                    ; the background picture (none
  27+ C006 CD 86 45             call l320_image                 ; without the file: the plain screen)
  28+ C009 3E E3                ld a,L320_NOPAPER               ; the text over it
  29+ C00B 32 AE 58             ld (l320_paper),a
  30+ C00E 21 4E C0             ld hl,mm_text                   ; title and options
  31+ C011 CD DC 41             call l320_print_list
  32+ C014 CD 47 A1     .loop:  call menu_frame                 ; one video frame
  33+ C017 CD A2 27             call zrand                      ; stir the random number generator
  34+ C01A CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan
  35+ C01D 21 01 03             ld hl,KB_1
  36+ C020 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  37+ C023 C2 0F A4             jp nz,newGame
  38+ C026 21 02 04             ld hl,KB_9                      ; redefine keys
  39+ C029 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  40+ C02C C2 55 A9             jp nz,keydef_go                 ; (zpolice.asm)
  41+ C02F 21 02 03             ld hl,KB_2                      ; continue the save game
  42+ C032 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  43+ C035 28 DD                jr z,.loop
  44+ C037 CD F8 AB             call load_save                  ; (zpolice.asm; pages the file
  45+ C03A D2 34 AC             jp nc,continue_game             ; handler in)
  46+ C03D ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; none (or not usable): say so
  47+ C041 11 06 12             ld de,MM_NOSAVE_ROW<<8 | (F12_COLS-13)/2
  48+ C044 0E E0                ld c,SCR_BAD
  49+ C046 21 98 C0             ld hl,txt_no_save
  50+ C049 CD D0 41             call l320_print_at
  51+ C04C 18 C6                jr .loop
  52+ C04E
  53+ C04E              ; row, column, colour, text, 0 ... $FF
  54+ C04E              mm_text:
  55+ C04E 03 09 FC             db 3, (F12_COLS-8)/2, SCR_TITLE
  56+ C051 5A 2D 50 4F          db "Z-POLICE", 0
  56+ C055 4C 49 43 45
  56+ C059 00
  57+ C05A 09 02 FF             db 9, MM_COL, SCR_TEXT
  58+ C05D 31 2E 20 4E          db "1. NEW GAME", 0
  58+ C061 45 57 20 47
  58+ C065 41 4D 45 00
  59+ C069 0B 02 FF             db 11, MM_COL, SCR_TEXT
  60+ C06C 32 2E 20 43          db "2. CONTINUE SAVED GAME", 0
  60+ C070 4F 4E 54 49
  60+ C074 4E 55 45 20
  60+ C078 53 41 56 45
  60+ C07C 44 20 47 41
  60+ C080 4D 45 00
  61+ C083 0D 02 FF             db 13, MM_COL, SCR_TEXT
  62+ C086 39 2E 20 52          db "9. REDEFINE KEYS", 0
  62+ C08A 45 44 45 46
  62+ C08E 49 4E 45 20
  62+ C092 4B 45 59 53

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level complete screen (8K page PAGE_LEVELEND, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; The level's last wave wiped out (main_loop pages it in): LEVEL n COMPLETE,
   6+ C000              ; the weapons rearmed, those aboard rescued, the humans saved and the
   7+ C000              ; salvage, and a line for each reward the salvage gives; then PRESS SPACE TO
   8+ C000              ; CONTINUE and the load-out screen (loadout_go).  After the last level, the
   9+ C000              ; game complete screen instead (game_done_go: menu.asm).  Drawn on Layer 2
  10+ C000              ; at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in slot 2) in the
  11+ C000              ; large font (26 x 25 characters), with the input page in slot 7.
  12+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  13+ C000
  14+ C000              LE_TITLE_ROW    equ 2
  15+ C000              LE_SAVED_ROW    equ 5               ; HUMANS SAVED n
  16+ C000              LE_SALV_ROW     equ 6               ; SALVAGE n
  17+ C000              LE_REARM_ROW    equ 8               ; AMMUNITION REPLENISHED
  18+ C000              LE_COL          equ 1               ; the lines' column (NIGHT VISION -
  19+ C000                                                  ; MONOCHROME is 25 long)
  20+ C000              LE_NUM_COL      equ 17              ; the numbers'
  21+ C000              LE_PROMPT_ROW   equ 23              ; PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE
  22+ C000
  23+ C000              ; The level's last wave is wiped out: LEVEL n COMPLETE, until SPACE is
  24+ C000              ; pressed, then the load-out screen and the next level (next_level,
  25+ C000              ; zpolice.asm)
  26+ C000              level_complete_screen:
  27+ C000 31 43 B7             ld sp,stack_top
  28+ C003 3A 22 AF             ld a,(level)                    ; the last level: the whole game
  29+ C006 FE 32                cp LEVEL_LAST
  30+ C008 D2 4E A9             jp nc,game_done_go              ; (zpolice.asm: menu.asm's page)
  31+ C00B CD D6 A0             call screen320                  ; (text.asm) the input page in slot 7
  32+ C00E 3A 22 AF             ld a,(level)                    ; LEVEL n COMPLETE: its digits (a
  33+ C011 06 2F                ld b,'0'-1                      ; level below LEVEL_LAST: 1 or 2)
  34+ C013 04           .tens:  inc b
  35+ C014 D6 0A                sub 10
  36+ C016 30 FB                jr nc,.tens
  37+ C018 C6 3A                add a,'0'+10
  38+ C01A 4F                   ld c,a
  39+ C01B 21 58 C0             ld hl,txt_ld_num
  40+ C01E 1E 05                ld e,(F12_COLS-16)/2            ; (centred)
  41+ C020 78                   ld a,b
  42+ C021 FE 30                cp '0'
  43+ C023 28 03                jr z,.units
  44+ C025 77                   ld (hl),a
  45+ C026 23                   inc hl
  46+ C027 1D                   dec e
  47+ C028 71           .units: ld (hl),c
  48+ C029 23                   inc hl
  49+ C02A D5                   push de
  50+ C02B EB                   ex de,hl
  51+ C02C 21 64 C0             ld hl,txt_ld_end
  52+ C02F 01 0A 00             ld bc,TXT_LD_END
  53+ C032 ED B0                ldir
  54+ C034 D1                   pop de
  55+ C035 16 02                ld d,LE_TITLE_ROW
  56+ C037 0E FC                ld c,SCR_TITLE
  57+ C039 21 52 C0             ld hl,txt_level_done
  58+ C03C CD D0 41             call l320_print_at
  59+ C03F CD 6E C0             call rearm_all                  ; every weapon's ammo full again
  60+ C042 CD F4 32             call hum_unload_all             ; (human.asm) those aboard: rescued
  61+ C045 CD 90 C0             call salvage_award              ; the humans saved: salvage, unlocks
  62+ C048 CD F5 C3             call le_space
  63+ C04B 21 22 AF             ld hl,level
  64+ C04E 34                   inc (hl)
  65+ C04F C3 47 A9             jp loadout_go                   ; (zpolice.asm) the load-out screen,
  66+ C052                                                      ; then the next level
  67+ C052
  68+ C052              txt_level_done:
  69+ C052 4C 45 56 45          db "LEVEL "
  69+ C056 4C 20
  70+ C058              txt_ld_num:
  71+ C058 00 00 00...          ds 2+TXT_LD_END                 ; (filled in)
  72+ C064              txt_ld_end:
  73+ C064 20 43 4F 4D          db " COMPLETE", 0
  73+ C068 50 4C 45 54
  73+ C06C 45 00
  74+ C06E              TXT_LD_END      equ $-txt_ld_end
  75+ C06E
  76+ C06E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  77+ C06E              ; End of a level: every slot's weapon gets its full load again (wpn_cfg,
  78+ C06E              ; WCFG_LOAD; AMMO_INF for the guns, 0 for an empty slot), and the screen
  79+ C06E              ; says so
  80+ C06E              rearm_all:
  81+ C06E DD 21 15 AF          ld ix,wpn_slots
  82+ C072 06 05                ld b,WPN_SLOTS
  83+ C074 DD 7E 00     .lp:    ld a,(ix+WPN_TYPE)
  84+ C077 CD 30 A9             call wpn_cfg_ptr                ; (resident; preserves BC)
  85+ C07A 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; WCFG_LOAD
  86+ C07B DD 77 01             ld (ix+WPN_AMMO),a
  87+ C07E DD 23                inc ix
  88+ C080 DD 23                inc ix
  89+ C082 10 F0                djnz .lp
  90+ C084 16 08                ld d,LE_REARM_ROW
  91+ C086 1E 01                ld e,LE_COL
  92+ C088 0E FF                ld c,SCR_TEXT
  93+ C08A 21 DE C3             ld hl,txt_sa_rearm
  94+ C08D C3 D0 41             jp l320_print_at
  95+ C090                      ASSERT WCFG_LOAD == 0
  96+ C090
  97+ C090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  98+ C090              ; Salvage, at the end of a level: each human saved this level (saved) adds
  99+ C090              ; a salvage point (salvage_points).  Every point total in salvage_tab that
 100+ C090              ; the new total reaches (passed over from the old one) gives its rewards: a
 101+ C090              ; weapon unlocked (one more of that type in wpn_stock, for the load-out page)
 102+ C090              ; and / or (SA_* flags) a full repair (vtol_hp = VTOL_HP) or the booster
 103+ C090              ; module (fitted at once, its tank full).  After the table's last total,
 104+ C090              ; SALVAGE_TAIL, every SALVAGE_STEP more points is a full repair.  Shown on
 105+ C090              ; the LEVEL COMPLETE screen: the humans saved, the salvage, and a line for
 106+ C090              ; each reward (rows SA_ROW0..SA_ROW_MAX; any more aren't shown).
 107+ C090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 108+ C090              SA_REPAIR       equ 1               ; salvage_tab rewards (flags): full repair,
 109+ C090              SA_BOOSTER      equ 2               ;   the booster module,
 110+ C090              SA_NV_GREEN     equ 4               ;   vision modes (vision_owned): night
 111+ C090              SA_NV_MONO      equ 8               ;   vision green, monochrome,
 112+ C090              SA_THERMAL      equ 16              ;   thermal, the vertical thrusters
 113+ C090              SA_VTHRUST      equ 32              ;   (vthrust_fitted), the lateral
 114+ C090              SA_LTHRUST      equ 64              ;   thrusters (lthrust_fitted)
 115+ C090              SALVAGE_TAIL    equ 145
 116+ C090              SALVAGE_STEP    equ 5
 117+ C090              SA_ROW0         equ 10
 118+ C090              SA_ROW_MAX      equ 21
 119+ C090              salvage_award:
 120+ C090 16 05                ld d,LE_SAVED_ROW               ; HUMANS SAVED n
 121+ C092 1E 01                ld e,LE_COL
 122+ C094 0E FF                ld c,SCR_TEXT
 123+ C096 21 47 C3             ld hl,txt_sa_saved
 124+ C099 CD D0 41             call l320_print_at
 125+ C09C 3A AA 36             ld a,(saved)
 126+ C09F 6F                   ld l,a
 127+ C0A0 26 00                ld h,0
 128+ C0A2 11 11 05             ld de,LE_SAVED_ROW<<8 | LE_NUM_COL

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level loading (8K page PAGE_LEVEL, game logic: runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6; it pages the file handler, PAGE_FILE, into slot 7)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Each level is a file, ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL, naming its city, ZPDATA/CITYnn.ZPC
   6+ C000              ; (both made by gentables.py; the formats are described there).  A city is
   7+ C000              ; played for several levels.  load_level reads both:
   8+ C000              ;   * the level record into level_cur (levels.asm): city name, zombie and
   9+ C000              ;     wave counts, the draw distance, ...;
  10+ C000              ;   * the city into the city bank (page 7, slot 3): city_col at $6000 and
  11+ C000              ;     city_map at $7000, one 8K read;
  12+ C000              ;   * the level's own map changes (x, z, cell code, city_col), for hand-made
  13+ C000              ;     layouts;
  14+ C000              ;   * the city's palette and sky colour into the Layer 2 palette, then the
  15+ C000              ;     level's own palette over it, if it has one (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP);
  16+ C000              ;   * view_r / dot_r from the draw distance (2..VIEW_R tiles).
  17+ C000              ; Loading the map also clears every cell's zombie and human marks.  The
  18+ C000              ; files must be in the ZPDATA folder beside zpolice.nex on the SD card.
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              ; Level file
  22+ C000              LVF_CITY        equ 5               ; city number
  23+ C000              LVF_REC         equ 6               ; the level record (LV_SIZE bytes)
  24+ C000              LVF_NCHG        equ LVF_REC+LV_SIZE ; number of map changes,
  25+ C000              LVF_CHG         equ LVF_NCHG+1      ; then x, z, cell code, city_col each
  26+ C000              LVF_CHG_MAX     equ 64
  27+ C000              LVF_MAX         equ LVF_CHG+4*LVF_CHG_MAX
  28+ C000              ; City file
  29+ C000              CTF_SKY         equ 14              ; sky colour: RRRGGGBB, low blue bit
  30+ C000              CTF_PAL         equ 32              ; the palette, 256 pairs
  31+ C000              CTF_DATA        equ CTF_PAL+512     ; then city_col, city_map
  32+ C000              ; Level palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP, optional: tools/levelpal.py)
  33+ C000              LPF_PAL         equ 8               ; the palette, 256 pairs
  34+ C000              LPF_SIZE        equ LPF_PAL+512
  35+ C000              LEVEL_VERSION   equ 2               ; the files' format versions (+4): the
  36+ C000              CITY_VERSION    equ 1               ;   level file's 2 (specials by wave)
  37+ C000              LPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  38+ C000              ; Vision palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPV: tools/visionpal.py)
  39+ C000              VPF_PAL         equ 8               ; 4 palettes (VM_MODES), 256 pairs each
  40+ C000              VPF_SIZE        equ VPF_PAL+4*512
  41+ C000              VPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  42+ C000              LDERR_BADFILE   equ 255             ; error code: not a valid file
  43+ C000
  44+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  45+ C000              ; A = level (1..99): load it.  Carry set on failure, A = the esxDOS error
  46+ C000              ; code or LDERR_BADFILE.  Leaves PAGE_FILE in slot 7.
  47+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48+ C000              load_level:
  49+ C000 0E 2F                ld c,'0'-1                      ; the level's two digits
  50+ C002 0C           .tens:  inc c
  51+ C003 D6 0A                sub 10
  52+ C005 30 FB                jr nc,.tens
  53+ C007 C6 3A                add a,'0'+10
  54+ C009 32 C4 C3             ld (ll_level+13),a
  55+ C00C 79                   ld a,c
  56+ C00D 32 C3 C3             ld (ll_level+12),a
  57+ C010 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
  58+ C014 21 B7 C3             ld hl,ll_level                  ; the level file
  59+ C017 11 1B CC             ld de,ll_lbuf
  60+ C01A 01 78 01             ld bc,LVF_MAX
  61+ C01D CD 81 E0             call fh_load
  62+ C020 D8                   ret c
  63+ C021 21 1B CC             ld hl,ll_lbuf
  64+ C024 11 EF C3             ld de,ll_lmagic
  65+ C027 0E 02                ld c,LEVEL_VERSION
  66+ C029 CD 25 C2             call ll_check
  67+ C02C D8                   ret c
  68+ C02D 21 21 CC             ld hl,ll_lbuf+LVF_REC           ; its record
  69+ C030 11 65 A0             ld de,level_cur
  70+ C033 01 71 00             ld bc,LV_SIZE
  71+ C036 ED B0                ldir
  72+ C038 3A 20 CC             ld a,(ll_lbuf+LVF_CITY)         ; its city file: two digits
  73+ C03B 0E 2F                ld c,'0'-1
  74+ C03D 0C           .ctens: inc c
  75+ C03E D6 0A                sub 10
  76+ C040 30 FB                jr nc,.ctens
  77+ C042 C6 3A                add a,'0'+10
  78+ C044 32 D6 C3             ld (ll_city+12),a
  79+ C047 79                   ld a,c
  80+ C048 32 D5 C3             ld (ll_city+11),a
  81+ C04B 21 CA C3             ld hl,ll_city
  82+ C04E 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
  83+ C050 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
  84+ C053 D8                   ret c
  85+ C054 21 93 CD             ld hl,ll_cbuf                   ; header and palette
  86+ C057 01 20 02             ld bc,CTF_DATA
  87+ C05A CD 2E E0             call fh_read
  88+ C05D DA 2C C1             jp c,.cerr
  89+ C060 3A 2A E1             ld a,(fh_handle)                ; city_col and city_map: the whole
  90+ C063 21 00 60             ld hl,city_col                  ; city bank, in one read
  91+ C066 01 00 20             ld bc,2*GRID*GRID
  92+ C069 CD 2E E0             call fh_read
  93+ C06C DA 2C C1             jp c,.cerr
  94+ C06F 78                   ld a,b                          ; all of it?
  95+ C070 FE 20                cp high (2*GRID*GRID)
  96+ C072 3E FF                ld a,LDERR_BADFILE
  97+ C074 37                   scf
  98+ C075 C2 2C C1             jp nz,.cerr
  99+ C078 3A 2A E1             ld a,(fh_handle)
 100+ C07B CD 25 E0             call fh_close
 101+ C07E D8                   ret c
 102+ C07F 21 93 CD             ld hl,ll_cbuf
 103+ C082 11 F3 C3             ld de,ll_cmagic
 104+ C085 0E 01                ld c,CITY_VERSION
 105+ C087 CD 25 C2             call ll_check
 106+ C08A D8                   ret c
 107+ C08B                      ; the level's map changes
 108+ C08B 3A 92 CC             ld a,(ll_lbuf+LVF_NCHG)
 109+ C08E FE 41                cp LVF_CHG_MAX+1
 110+ C090 3E FF                ld a,LDERR_BADFILE
 111+ C092 3F                   ccf
 112+ C093 D8                   ret c
 113+ C094 3A 92 CC             ld a,(ll_lbuf+LVF_NCHG)
 114+ C097 B7                   or a
 115+ C098 28 2C                jr z,.pal
 116+ C09A 47                   ld b,a
 117+ C09B DD 21 93 CC          ld ix,ll_lbuf+LVF_CHG
 118+ C09F DD 6E 01     .chg:   ld l,(ix+1)                     ; row z
 119+ C0A2 26 00                ld h,0
 120+ C0A4                      ROWOFS
 120+ C0A4 29          >        add hl,hl
 120+ C0A5 29          >        add hl,hl
 120+ C0A6 29          >        add hl,hl
 120+ C0A7 29          >        add hl,hl
 120+ C0A8 29          >        add hl,hl
 120+ C0A9 29          >        add hl,hl
 121+ C0AA DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+0)                     ; column x
 122+ C0AD ED 31                add hl,a
 123+ C0AF 11 00 70             ld de,city_map
 124+ C0B2 19                   add hl,de
 125+ C0B3 DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
 126+ C0B6 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; the cell code
 127+ C0B7 11 00 F0             ld de,city_col-city_map
 128+ C0BA 19                   add hl,de
 129+ C0BB DD 7E 03             ld a,(ix+3)
 130+ C0BE 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; and its colour
 131+ C0BF 11 04 00             ld de,4
 132+ C0C2 DD 19                add ix,de
 133+ C0C4 10 D9                djnz .chg
 134+ C0C6              .pal:   ; the city's palette (the first Layer 2 palette), then its sky
 135+ C0C6 21 B3 CD             ld hl,ll_cbuf+CTF_PAL
 136+ C0C9 CD B3 C1             call ll_palette
 137+ C0CC ED 91 40 03          nextreg $40,SKY_COL
 138+ C0D0 3A A1 CD             ld a,(ll_cbuf+CTF_SKY)
 139+ C0D3 ED 92 44             nextreg $44,a
 140+ C0D6 3A A2 CD             ld a,(ll_cbuf+CTF_SKY+1)
 141+ C0D9 ED 92 44             nextreg $44,a
 142+ C0DC                      ; the level's own palette, if it has one (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP, from
 143+ C0DC                      ; levels/LEVELnn_PAL.json): in place of the city's.  None, or not a
 144+ C0DC                      ; whole palette file: the city's stays.  (Into ll_cbuf: the city's
 145+ C0DC                      ; header is done with.)
 146+ C0DC 3A C3 C3             ld a,(ll_level+12)
 147+ C0DF 32 E8 C3             ld (ll_lpal+12),a
 148+ C0E2 3A C4 C3             ld a,(ll_level+13)
 149+ C0E5 32 E9 C3             ld (ll_lpal+13),a
 150+ C0E8 21 DC C3             ld hl,ll_lpal
 151+ C0EB 11 93 CD             ld de,ll_cbuf
 152+ C0EE 01 08 02             ld bc,LPF_SIZE
 153+ C0F1 CD 81 E0             call fh_load
 154+ C0F4 38 1B                jr c,.view                      ; (none)
 155+ C0F6 21 F8 FD             ld hl,-LPF_SIZE
 156+ C0F9 09                   add hl,bc
 157+ C0FA 7C                   ld a,h
 158+ C0FB B5                   or l
 159+ C0FC 20 13                jr nz,.view                     ; (not all of it)
 160+ C0FE 21 93 CD             ld hl,ll_cbuf
 161+ C101 11 F7 C3             ld de,ll_pmagic
 162+ C104 0E 01                ld c,LPAL_VERSION
 163+ C106 CD 25 C2             call ll_check
 164+ C109 38 06                jr c,.view
 165+ C10B 21 9B CD             ld hl,ll_cbuf+LPF_PAL
 166+ C10E CD B3 C1             call ll_palette
 167+ C111 CD 36 C1     .view:  call vis_load                   ; its vision palettes
 168+ C114                      ; the draw distance, 2..VIEW_R tiles; the ground dots one less
 169+ C114 3A 71 A0             ld a,(level_cur+LV_VIEW_R)
 170+ C117 FE 02                cp 2
 171+ C119 30 02                jr nc,.v1
 172+ C11B 3E 02                ld a,2
 173+ C11D FE 09        .v1:    cp VIEW_R+1
 174+ C11F 38 02                jr c,.v2
 175+ C121 3E 08                ld a,VIEW_R
 176+ C123 32 23 AF     .v2:    ld (view_r),a
 177+ C126 3D                   dec a
 178+ C127 32 24 AF             ld (dot_r),a
 179+ C12A B7                   or a                            ; carry clear: loaded
 180+ C12B C9                   ret
 181+ C12C F5           .cerr:  push af                         ; an error with the city file open:
 182+ C12D 3A 2A E1             ld a,(fh_handle)                ; close it, keep the error
 183+ C130 CD 25 E0             call fh_close
 184+ C133 F1                   pop af
 185+ C134 37                   scf
 186+ C135 C9                   ret
 187+ C136
 188+ C136              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 189+ C136              ; The vision modes' palettes (tools/visionpal.py has the format):
 190+ C136              ; ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPV, the level's 4 palettes (normal, night vision green,
 191+ C136              ; night vision monochrome, thermal), kept in ll_vbuf.  vis_ok = 1 if it is
 192+ C136              ; there and whole (without it, only normal vision).  Every level starts in
 193+ C136              ; normal vision (vision_mode 0).
 194+ C136              ; (load_level: the file handler in slot 7.)
 195+ C136              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 196+ C136              vis_load:
 197+ C136 AF                   xor a
 198+ C137 32 B9 AF             ld (vis_ok),a
 199+ C13A 3A C3 C3             ld a,(ll_level+12)
 200+ C13D 32 07 C4             ld (ll_vpal+12),a
 201+ C140 3A C4 C3             ld a,(ll_level+13)
 202+ C143 32 08 C4             ld (ll_vpal+13),a
 203+ C146 21 FB C3             ld hl,ll_vpal
 204+ C149 11 12 C4             ld de,ll_vbuf
 205+ C14C 01 09 08             ld bc,VPF_SIZE+1                ; (one more: a longer file isn't one)
 206+ C14F CD 81 E0             call fh_load
 207+ C152 38 1A                jr c,.none
 208+ C154 21 F8 F7             ld hl,-VPF_SIZE
 209+ C157 09                   add hl,bc
 210+ C158 7C                   ld a,h
 211+ C159 B5                   or l
 212+ C15A 20 12                jr nz,.none                     ; (not all of it)
 213+ C15C 21 12 C4             ld hl,ll_vbuf
 214+ C15F 11 0E C4             ld de,ll_vmagic
 215+ C162 0E 01                ld c,VPAL_VERSION
 216+ C164 CD 25 C2             call ll_check
 217+ C167 38 05                jr c,.none
 218+ C169 3E 01                ld a,1
 219+ C16B 32 B9 AF             ld (vis_ok),a
 220+ C16E AF           .none:  xor a                           ; each level starts in normal vision
 221+ C16F 32 B8 AF             ld (vision_mode),a              ; (its palette is in already)
 222+ C172 C9                   ret
 223+ C173
 224+ C173              ; K_VISION pressed (main_loop, this page in slot 6): the next vision mode
 225+ C173              ; the VTOL has (vision_owned), or back to normal after the last; its
 226+ C173              ; palette into the Layer 2 palette.  Nothing without the level's vision
 227+ C173              ; palettes, or with no vision mode.
 228+ C173              vis_cycle:
 229+ C173 3A B9 AF             ld a,(vis_ok)
 230+ C176 B7                   or a
 231+ C177 C8                   ret z
 232+ C178 3A B5 AF             ld a,(vision_owned)
 233+ C17B E6 07                and (1<<(VM_MODES-1))-1
 234+ C17D C8                   ret z                           ; none yet
 235+ C17E 3A B8 AF             ld a,(vision_mode)
 236+ C181 3C           .nx:    inc a
 237+ C182 FE 04                cp VM_MODES
 238+ C184 30 14                jr nc,.norm                     ; past the last: normal
 239+ C186 47                   ld b,a                          ; has it?  bit (mode - 1)
 240+ C187 0E 01                ld c,1
 241+ C189 05           .bit:   dec b
 242+ C18A 28 04                jr z,.tst
 243+ C18C CB 21                sla c
 244+ C18E 18 F9                jr .bit
 245+ C190 47           .tst:   ld b,a
 246+ C191 3A B5 AF             ld a,(vision_owned)
 247+ C194 A1                   and c
 248+ C195 78                   ld a,b
 249+ C196 28 E9                jr z,.nx
 250+ C198 18 01                jr .set
 251+ C19A AF           .norm:  xor a
 252+ C19B 32 B8 AF     .set:   ld (vision_mode),a
 253+ C19E                      ; fall through
 254+ C19E
 255+ C19E              ; The vision mode's palette (vision_mode, 0..VM_MODES-1, from ll_vbuf) into
 256+ C19E              ; the Layer 2 palette
 257+ C19E              vis_apply:
 258+ C19E 3A B8 AF             ld a,(vision_mode)
 259+ C1A1 B7                   or a
 260+ C1A2 20 07                jr nz,.m
 261+ C1A4 3A 85 A8             ld a,(dv_dark)                  ; (normal, the devil hurt: darker)
 262+ C1A7 B7                   or a
 263+ C1A8 20 25                jr nz,vis_dark.go
 264+ C1AA AF                   xor a
 265+ C1AB 87           .m:     add a,a                         ; * 512: high byte * 2
 266+ C1AC 67                   ld h,a
 267+ C1AD 2E 00                ld l,0
 268+ C1AF 11 1A C4             ld de,ll_vbuf+VPF_PAL
 269+ C1B2 19                   add hl,de
 270+ C1B3                      ; fall through
 271+ C1B3                      ASSERT VM_MODES*512 == VPF_SIZE-VPF_PAL
 272+ C1B3
 273+ C1B3              ; HL -> 256 palette pairs (RRRGGGBB, low blue bit): into Layer 2 palette 0
 274+ C1B3              ll_palette:
 275+ C1B3 ED 91 43 10          nextreg $43,%00010000           ; edit Layer 2 palette 0, auto-inc
 276+ C1B7 ED 91 40 00          nextreg $40,0
 277+ C1BB 06 00                ld b,0                          ; 256 entries
 278+ C1BD 7E           .pl:    ld a,(hl)
 279+ C1BE 23                   inc hl
 280+ C1BF ED 92 44             nextreg $44,a                   ; RRRGGGBB
 281+ C1C2 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 282+ C1C3 23                   inc hl
 283+ C1C4 ED 92 44             nextreg $44,a                   ; low blue bit
 284+ C1C7 10 F4                djnz .pl
 285+ C1C9 C9                   ret
 286+ C1CA
 287+ C1CA              ; The devil hurt (dv_dark, devil.asm): in normal vision, the level's normal
 288+ C1CA              ; palette (from its vision palettes, ll_vbuf) with each r, g, b dv_dark
 289+ C1CA              ; lower (not below 0) into Layer 2 palette 0.  (Its eyes: the devil sets
 290+ C1CA              ; them each frame it charges.)  Nothing without the vision palettes.
 291+ C1CA              vis_dark:
 292+ C1CA 3A B8 AF             ld a,(vision_mode)
 293+ C1CD B7                   or a
 294+ C1CE C0                   ret nz
 295+ C1CF 3A B9 AF     .go:    ld a,(vis_ok)
 296+ C1D2 B7                   or a
 297+ C1D3 C8                   ret z
 298+ C1D4 3A 85 A8             ld a,(dv_dark)
 299+ C1D7 4F                   ld c,a
 300+ C1D8 21 1A C4             ld hl,ll_vbuf+VPF_PAL           ; (normal: the first)
 301+ C1DB ED 91 43 10          nextreg $43,%00010000           ; edit Layer 2 palette 0, auto-inc
 302+ C1DF ED 91 40 00          nextreg $40,0
 303+ C1E3 06 00                ld b,0
 304+ C1E5 C5           .pl:    push bc
 305+ C1E6 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; RRRGGGBB
 306+ C1E7 23                   inc hl
 307+ C1E8 5E                   ld e,(hl)                       ; the low blue bit
 308+ C1E9 23                   inc hl
 309+ C1EA E5                   push hl
 310+ C1EB 57                   ld d,a
 311+ C1EC 07                   rlca                            ; r: bits 7-5
 312+ C1ED 07                   rlca
 313+ C1EE 07                   rlca
 314+ C1EF E6 07                and 7
 315+ C1F1 91                   sub c
 316+ C1F2 30 01                jr nc,.r
 317+ C1F4 AF                   xor a
 318+ C1F5 0F           .r:     rrca
 319+ C1F6 0F                   rrca
 320+ C1F7 0F                   rrca
 321+ C1F8 67                   ld h,a                          ; r back in bits 7-5
 322+ C1F9 7A                   ld a,d
 323+ C1FA 0F                   rrca
 324+ C1FB 0F                   rrca
 325+ C1FC E6 07                and 7                           ; g
 326+ C1FE 91                   sub c
 327+ C1FF 30 01                jr nc,.g
 328+ C201 AF                   xor a
 329+ C202 87           .g:     add a,a
 330+ C203 87                   add a,a
 331+ C204 B4                   or h
 332+ C205 67                   ld h,a
 333+ C206 7A                   ld a,d                          ; b: its two bits and the low one
 334+ C207 E6 03                and 3
 335+ C209 87                   add a,a
 336+ C20A 6F                   ld l,a
 337+ C20B 7B                   ld a,e
 338+ C20C E6 01                and 1
 339+ C20E B5                   or l
 340+ C20F 91                   sub c
 341+ C210 30 01                jr nc,.b
 342+ C212 AF                   xor a
 343+ C213 6F           .b:     ld l,a
 344+ C214 CB 3F                srl a
 345+ C216 B4                   or h
 346+ C217 ED 92 44             nextreg $44,a
 347+ C21A 7D                   ld a,l
 348+ C21B E6 01                and 1
 349+ C21D ED 92 44             nextreg $44,a
 350+ C220 E1                   pop hl
 351+ C221 C1                   pop bc
 352+ C222 10 C1                djnz .pl
 353+ C224 C9                   ret
 354+ C225
 355+ C225              ; HL -> a file's first bytes, DE -> its 4-byte magic: carry clear if they
 356+ C225              ; match and the version byte after them is C (LEVEL_ / CITY_VERSION), else carry set
 357+ C225              ; and A = LDERR_BADFILE
 358+ C225              ll_check:
 359+ C225 06 04                ld b,4
 360+ C227 1A           .lp:    ld a,(de)
 361+ C228 BE                   cp (hl)
 362+ C229 20 07                jr nz,.bad
 363+ C22B 13                   inc de
 364+ C22C 23                   inc hl
 365+ C22D 10 F8                djnz .lp
 366+ C22F 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 367+ C230 B9                   cp c
 368+ C231 C8                   ret z                           ; (carry clear)
 369+ C232 3E FF        .bad:   ld a,LDERR_BADFILE
 370+ C234 37                   scf
 371+ C235 C9                   ret
 372+ C236
 373+ C236              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 374+ C236              ; At start-up (this page in slot 6, the file handler set up): the figures'
 375+ C236              ; graphics, ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG (gengraphics.py; tools/spritefile.py has the
 376+ C236              ; format; REAL_HARDWARE: SPRITEHW.ZPG, each level a rectangle), into pages PAGE_GFX0 on, each read through slot 4 (the ULA
 377+ C236              ; screen's, put back after: the screen still shows).  gfx_ok = 1 if they are
 378+ C236              ; all there and fit this game (magic, version, pages, purposes); else 0, and
 379+ C236              ; the figures aren't drawn.  Leaves the file handler in slot 7.
 380+ C236              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 381+ C236              gfx_load:
 382+ C236 AF                   xor a
 383+ C237 32 81 A8             ld (gfx_ok),a
 384+ C23A ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
 385+ C23E 21 85 C3             ld hl,gfx_name
 386+ C241 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 387+ C243 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 388+ C246 D8                   ret c                           ; (none)
 389+ C247 21 93 CD             ld hl,ll_cbuf                   ; the header
 390+ C24A 01 10 00             ld bc,GFX_HEADER
 391+ C24D CD 2E E0             call fh_read
 392+ C250 38 41                jr c,.cl
 393+ C252 21 93 CD             ld hl,ll_cbuf
 394+ C255 11 99 C3             ld de,gfx_magic
 395+ C258 0E 05                ld c,GFX_VERSION
 396+ C25A CD 25 C2             call ll_check
 397+ C25D 38 34                jr c,.cl
 398+ C25F 3A 98 CD             ld a,(ll_cbuf+5)                ; pages: 1..GFX_PAGES_MAX
 399+ C262 B7                   or a
 400+ C263 28 2E                jr z,.cl
 401+ C265 FE 3B                cp GFX_PAGES_MAX+1
 402+ C267 30 2A                jr nc,.cl
 403+ C269 32 9E C3             ld (gl_n),a
 404+ C26C 3A 99 CD             ld a,(ll_cbuf+6)                ; the game's purposes, and their
 405+ C26F FE 13                cp GFX_ENTRIES                  ;   (no vision set)
 406+ C271 20 20                jr nz,.cl
 407+ C273 3E 26                ld a,PAGE_GFX0
 408+ C275 32 9D C3             ld (gl_pg),a
 409+ C278 CD 99 C2             call gl_pages
 410+ C27B 38 16                jr c,.cl
 411+ C27D 3A 98 CD             ld a,(ll_cbuf+5)
 412+ C280 32 82 A8             ld (gfx_pages),a
 413+ C283 4F                   ld c,a
 414+ C284 3A 9A CD             ld a,(ll_cbuf+7)                ; the kept figures' pages (at most all)
 415+ C287 B9                   cp c
 416+ C288 38 01                jr c,.k
 417+ C28A 79                   ld a,c
 418+ C28B 32 83 A8     .k:     ld (gfx_keep),a
 419+ C28E 3E 01                ld a,1
 420+ C290 32 81 A8             ld (gfx_ok),a
 421+ C293 3A 2A E1     .cl:    ld a,(fh_handle)
 422+ C296 C3 25 E0             jp fh_close
 423+ C299
 424+ C299              ; gl_n pages (8K each) from the open file into pages gl_pg on, through slot
 425+ C299              ; 4 (the ULA screen's, put back after).  Carry if one couldn't be read whole.
 426+ C299              gl_pages:
 427+ C299 3A 9D C3             ld a,(gl_pg)
 428+ C29C ED 92 54             nextreg ULA_MMU,a
 429+ C29F 3A 2A E1             ld a,(fh_handle)
 430+ C2A2 21 00 80             ld hl,ULA_ADDR
 431+ C2A5 01 00 20             ld bc,MEMBANK_SIZE
 432+ C2A8 CD 2E E0             call fh_read
 433+ C2AB ED 91 54 0A          nextreg ULA_MMU,PAGE_ULA0       ; (the flags kept)
 434+ C2AF D8                   ret c
 435+ C2B0 78                   ld a,b
 436+ C2B1 FE 20                cp high MEMBANK_SIZE
 437+ C2B3 37                   scf
 438+ C2B4 C0                   ret nz                          ; (not all of it)
 439+ C2B5 21 9D C3             ld hl,gl_pg
 440+ C2B8 34                   inc (hl)
 441+ C2B9 21 9E C3             ld hl,gl_n
 442+ C2BC 35                   dec (hl)
 443+ C2BD 20 DA                jr nz,gl_pages
 444+ C2BF B7                   or a
 445+ C2C0 C9                   ret
 446+ C2C1
 447+ C2C1              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 448+ C2C1              ; At a level's start (wave_prepare, this page in slot 6), after a screen took
 449+ C2C1              ; the figures' last pages for its background copy (shared_pg; l320_bg_save)
 450+ C2C1              ; or the devil's graphics went over them (devil_gfx): A = the first page to
 451+ C2C1              ; read back (gfx_stale), from it to the file's last, from the graphics file;
 452+ C2C1              ; then gfx_ok again.  Carry if the file can't be read (it was read at
 453+ C2C1              ; start-up: the SD card is at fault).  Leaves the file handler in slot 7.
 454+ C2C1              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 455+ C2C1              gfx_reload:
 456+ C2C1 32 9D C3             ld (gl_pg),a
 457+ C2C4 4F                   ld c,a
 458+ C2C5 3A 82 A8             ld a,(gfx_pages)
 459+ C2C8 91                   sub c                           ; the pages from there on
 460+ C2C9 28 02                jr z,.none
 461+ C2CB 30 02                jr nc,.some
 462+ C2CD B7           .none:  or a                            ; (none: carry clear)
 463+ C2CE C9                   ret
 464+ C2CF 32 9E C3     .some:  ld (gl_n),a
 465+ C2D2 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
 466+ C2D6 21 85 C3             ld hl,gfx_name
 467+ C2D9 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - load-out screen (8K page PAGE_LOADOUT, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Before the first level (newGame) and between levels, after LEVEL COMPLETE
   5+ C000              ; (loadout_go pages it in).  On the
   6+ C000              ; left, the store: every weapon type unlocked (wpn_unlocked) with the number
   7+ C000              ; in store (wpn_stock), even 0 when the only one is fitted.  On the right,
   8+ C000              ; the VTOL's 5 weapon slots: a picture of the VTOL (ZPDATA/VTOL.ZPI, read
   9+ C000              ; from the SD card as the screen opens: l320_image) drawn first, as the
  10+ C000              ; background, with a box and the number at each slot's hardpoint (lo_hp),
  11+ C000              ; and the list of what is fitted in each.  The text is printed over the
  12+ C000              ; picture (no paper); a field that changes gets its piece of the background
  13+ C000              ; back first (l320_bg_save, l320_restore).
  14+ C000              ;   1-5    select a slot (yellow)
  15+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the store list.  The highlighted
  16+ C000              ;          weapon is green if it can be fitted in the selected slot (the
  17+ C000              ;          slot allows it, wpn_fits, and one is in store), red if not; the
  18+ C000              ;          rest of the list is white.
  19+ C000              ;   SPACE  fit the highlighted weapon in the selected slot, if it can be:
  20+ C000              ;          one comes out of the store, with a full load (WCFG_LOAD), and
  21+ C000              ;          whatever was fitted there goes back into the store
  22+ C000              ;   U      unload the selected slot: its weapon back into the store, the
  23+ C000              ;          slot EMPTY (lo_unload)
  24+ C000              ;   0      done: start the level (next_level), only with a weapon in slot 1
  25+ C000              ;          (the centre slot); while it is empty 0: START LEVEL is red
  26+ C000              ; Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in
  27+ C000              ; slot 2), with the keys page in slot 7: the title, help and START LEVEL in
  28+ C000              ; the large font (26 x 25 grid), the headings and lists in the 8x8 one (40
  29+ C000              ; x 32 grid: they need the columns).
  30+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  31+ C000

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - redefine keys screen (8K page PAGE_KEYDEF, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; From the main menu (option 9, keydef_go pages it in).  Lists every control
   6+ C000              ; (K_ACTIONS of them) with its key (key_defs) and its joystick input
   7+ C000              ; (joy_defs, "-" for none; input.asm).
   8+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the list (white; highlighted green);
   9+ C000              ;          KD_VIS rows of it show, scrolling to keep the highlight in view
  10+ C000              ;   SPACE  "PRESS A KEY OR JOYSTICK", a second's pause, then the next input
  11+ C000              ;          becomes the highlighted control's key, or its joystick input if
  12+ C000              ;          it is a joystick's, unless another control already uses it: then
  13+ C000              ;          "KEY ALREADY IN USE" (for a second) and no change
  14+ C000              ;   0      every key and joystick input back to its default (key_defaults,
  15+ C000              ;          joy_defaults)
  16+ C000              ;   1      back to the main menu (menu_go), saving the definitions first if
  17+ C000              ;          they changed (kd_save; "KEYS NOT SAVED" for a second if they
  18+ C000              ;          couldn't be)
  19+ C000              ; These keys are fixed (key_code_pressed), whatever the controls are set to.
  20+ C000              ; Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in
  21+ C000              ; slot 2), with the input page in slot 7: the title, messages and help in
  22+ C000              ; the large font (26 x 25 grid), the headings and the list in the 8x8 one
  23+ C000              ; (40 x 32 grid: they need the columns).
  24+ C000              ;
  25+ C000              ; The definitions are kept on the SD card as ZPDATA/KEYS.ZPK (beside the level
  26+ C000              ; files): "ZPKY", KF_VERSION, K_ACTIONS, then key_defs and joy_defs (2 bytes
  27+ C000              ; each control).  start loads them (kd_load, with this page in slot 6), if the
  28+ C000              ; file is there and fits this game: else the defaults.
  29+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  30+ C000
  31+ C000              KD_TITLE_ROW    equ 1               ; (large font)
  32+ C000              KD_HEAD_ROW     equ 3               ; the columns' headings (8x8)
  33+ C000              KD_ROW0         equ 4               ; first row of the list (8x8)
  34+ C000              KD_NAME_COL     equ 2               ; control names,
  35+ C000              KD_KEY_COL      equ 18              ; their keys,
  36+ C000              KD_KEY_LEN      equ 7               ;   (key names at most this long)
  37+ C000              KD_JOY_COL      equ 28              ; their joystick inputs
  38+ C000              KD_JOY_LEN      equ 8               ;   (joystick names at most this long)
  39+ C000                      ASSERT KD_KEY_COL + KD_KEY_LEN < KD_JOY_COL && KD_JOY_COL + KD_JOY_LEN <= L320_COLS-1
  40+ C000              KD_MSG_ROW      equ 22              ; messages (large font)
  41+ C000              KD_HELP_ROW     equ 23              ; the keys' help, two lines (large)
  42+ C000              KD_PAUSE        equ 50              ; a second of 50 Hz frames
  43+ C000              KD_VIS          equ 23              ; controls shown at once (the list scrolls)
  44+ C000                      ASSERT (KD_ROW0 + KD_VIS)*8 <= F12_Y0 + KD_MSG_ROW*F12_H  ; (more than
  45+ C000                      ASSERT KD_HEAD_ROW*8 >= F12_Y0 + (KD_TITLE_ROW+1)*F12_H   ; fit: the list
  46+ C000                      ASSERT KD_VIS <= K_ACTIONS  ;   scrolls, kd_top, to keep kd_cur in view)
  47+ C000
