# file opened: specials.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - special monsters (8K page PAGE_SPECIAL, game logic: runs at
   3+ C000              ; $C000 in slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Special monsters use the zombie records after the zombies' own (NZOMB ..
   6+ C000              ; NMON-1, zombie.asm), so they share the zombies' drawing (zombie_cell,
   7+ C000              ; fig_draw), map blips, cell marks (zflags), weapon hits and zdamage.  The
   8+ C000              ; record's type (+15) says which monster it is.  Each wave's specials come
   9+ C000              ; from the level file (level_cur, LV_WAVE_DATA: up to LV_SPEC_SLOTS types,
  10+ C000              ; SPEC_*, and how many of each), placed by spec_wave as the wave starts;
  11+ C000              ; the level's start is wave 1 (spec_init).  spec_update moves them each
  12+ C000              ; frame, after zombie_update.
  13+ C000              ;
  14+ C000              ; The ghost (ZT_GHOST, special monster id SPEC_GHOST): a stick man under a white
  15+ C000              ; sheet.  It can't attack the base.  It flies at twice the zombies' speed,
  16+ C000              ; at any angle, and up and down between the ground and the VTOL's ceiling
  17+ C000              ; (MAX_Y), over buildings lower than it.
  18+ C000              ;   * Roaming: it flies in a random direction (a random climb or descent
  19+ C000              ;     too) until something makes it turn: a building in the way or the map
  20+ C000              ;     edge (a new random direction at once), or, at its decision check
  21+ C000              ;     every GHOST_DECIDE (30) frames, a human or the VTOL within GHOST_SEE
  22+ C000              ;     (3 tiles) that it can see.
  23+ C000              ;   * Chasing: it flies straight at the nearest one it can see, aiming
  24+ C000              ;     again every GHOST_TRACK (5) frames.  If it loses sight of its target
  25+ C000              ;     (behind a taller building) or the target is gone, it roams again in a
  26+ C000              ;     random direction, back on the 30-frame cycle.
  27+ C000              ;   * Attacking: within ATTACK_R (0.1 tile) of its target on each axis it
  28+ C000              ;     stops and takes GHOST_DMG hit point every GHOST_HIT_FRAMES (10)
  29+ C000              ;     frames: from a human (HUMAN_HP) until it dies, or from the VTOL
  30+ C000              ;     (vtol_hp, VTOL_HP; at 0 it is destroyed and the game ends).  Its map blip is red
  31+ C000              ;     meanwhile (zatk_flags, zblip_red), as an attacking zombie's.  If the
  32+ C000              ;     target moves out of reach it chases it again; once the human is dead
  33+ C000              ;     it roams again.
  34+ C000              ;   * It has GHOST_HP (10) hit points; any weapon can shoot it.  Killed, it
  35+ C000              ;     fades out where it is, white to near black in 4 steps of 3 frames
  36+ C000              ;     (GM_DYING; zdamage starts it, zombie_draw colours it, g_dying ends
  37+ C000              ;     it), and can't be hit meanwhile.
  38+ C000              ; Ghost record fields, besides the zombies' (zombie.asm):
  39+ C000              ;   +11 frames to its next decision check, +16 mode (GM_*), +17 frames to
  40+ C000              ;   its next blow, +18 hit points, +21,+22 height of its feet, +23,+24 and
  41+ C000              ;   +25,+26 velocity x, z (signed 8.8 units a frame), +27,+28 the x and z
  42+ C000              ;   position fractions, +29 climb (signed units a frame), +30 target
  43+ C000              ;   (TG_NONE, TG_VTOL, or a human's index).
  44+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  45+ C000
  46+ C000              GHOST_HP        equ 10              ; hit points
  47+ C000              GHOST_DECIDE    equ 30              ; frames between decisions while roaming
  48+ C000              GHOST_TRACK     equ 5               ; and while chasing
  49+ C000              GHOST_SEE       equ 3*TILE_UNITS    ; it spots humans / the VTOL this near
  50+ C000              GHOST_HIT_FRAMES equ 10             ; frames between blows
  51+ C000              GHOST_DMG       equ 1               ; hit points a blow
  52+ C000              GHOST_CLIMB     equ 1               ; units a frame up or down
  53+ C000              GHOST_AIM_MIN   equ 80              ; (aiming: nearer counts as this far)
  54+ C000              GM_ROAM         equ 0               ; modes (+16)
  55+ C000              GM_CHASE        equ 1
  56+ C000              GM_ATTACK       equ 2
  57+ C000              GM_DYING        equ 3               ; killed: fading out (+17 frames left)
  58+ C000              GHOST_FADE_FRAMES equ 12            ; the fade: 4 steps of 3 frames
  59+ C000              TG_NONE         equ $FF             ; targets (+30)
  60+ C000              TG_VTOL         equ $FE
  61+ C000              TG_BASE         equ $C0             ; + a base tile's index (base_hp, 0..24)
  62+ C000              ; The banshee (ZT_BANSHEE, id SPEC_BANSHEE): a ghost that flies twice as
  63+ C000              ; fast, reaches BANSHEE_R (0.5 tile), does BANSHEE_DMG a blow and also
  64+ C000              ; attacks the base (the terrace and pad tiles).
  65+ C000              ; The ghoul (ZT_GHOUL, id SPEC_GHOUL, zombie.asm): a half-height zombie
  66+ C000              ; walking at five times the zombies' speed.  It is placed here (spec_wave)
  67+ C000              ; but moved, drawn and hit as a zombie.
  68+ C000              ; The lich (ZT_LICH, id SPEC_LICH): a city's boss, in the last wave of its
  69+ C000              ; last level (the level files).  Placed here (lich_init); walks as a zombie
  70+ C000              ; at 4 times the speed, drawn at LICH_H; shoots fireballs at the VTOL
  71+ C000              ; (lich_update, weapons.asm).  Each city's is harder: LICH_HP + LICH_HP_STEP
  72+ C000              ; hit points a city before it, and a shot every LICH_RATE frames,
  73+ C000              ; LICH_RATE_STEP fewer a city before it, at least LICH_RATE_MIN.  Its
  74+ C000              ; record: +18 and +23 (LICH_HP_HI) its hit points, 16 bits; +24 (LICH_WAIT)
  75+ C000              ; frames to its next shot; +25 (LICH_FRAMES) frames between.
  76+ C000              ; The devil (ZT_DEVIL, id SPEC_DEVIL): the final boss (devil.asm).
  77+ C000              ; (Which waves have which is the level files' business: gentables.py.)
  78+ C000              BANSHEE_HP      equ 8
  79+ C000              BANSHEE_DMG     equ 5
  80+ C000              BANSHEE_R       equ TILE_UNITS/2
  81+ C000              BASE_TILES      equ (2*TERRACE_R+1)*(2*TERRACE_R+1)
  82+ C000              LICH_HP         equ 25              ; the first city's
  83+ C000              LICH_HP_STEP    equ 5               ; more a city
  84+ C000              LICH_RATE       equ 150             ; the first city's frames between shots
  85+ C000              LICH_RATE_STEP  equ 5               ; fewer a city
  86+ C000              LICH_RATE_MIN   equ 10
  87+ C000
  88+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  89+ C000              ; A level's start: every special record inactive, then wave 1's specials
  90+ C000              ; (the level's start is wave 1, as any other: spec_wave)
  91+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  92+ C000              spec_init:
  93+ C000 DD 21 06 30          ld ix,zombies+NZOMB*ZREC
  94+ C004 06 08                ld b,NSPEC
  95+ C006 0E 28                ld c,NZOMB                      ; record index
  96+ C008 79           .lp:    ld a,c
  97+ C009 21 50 2A             ld hl,zatk_flags                ; not attacking
  98+ C00C ED 31                add hl,a
  99+ C00E 36 00                ld (hl),FALSE
 100+ C010 DD 36 0A 00          ld (ix+10),0                    ; inactive,
 101+ C014 DD 36 0E 00          ld (ix+14),0                    ; no blip,
 102+ C018 DD 36 13 FF          ld (ix+19),$FF                  ; no cell marked
 103+ C01C 11 22 00             ld de,ZREC
 104+ C01F DD 19                add ix,de
 105+ C021 0C                   inc c
 106+ C022 10 E4                djnz .lp
 107+ C024 CD D8 C7             call dv_reset                   ; (devil.asm) nothing coming down
 108+ C027 CD 2E C1             call spec_wave                  ; wave 1's specials (wave_number 1)
 109+ C02A C3 56 22             jp zflags                       ; (zombie.asm) mark their cells
 110+ C02D
 111+ C02D              ; Special monster IX (record sp_idx) of type sp_type: at a random street
 112+ C02D              ; position and height, roaming in a random direction
 113+ C02D              ghost_init:
 114+ C02D 3A A9 C7             ld a,(sp_type)
 115+ C030 DD 77 0F             ld (ix+15),a
 116+ C033 CD 20 C2             call g_params                   ; (its speed for its first direction)
 117+ C036 CD A2 27     .try:   call zrand                      ; (zombie page)
 118+ C039 7D                   ld a,l
 119+ C03A E6 3F                and GRID-1
 120+ C03C DD 77 01             ld (ix+1),a                     ; x cell
 121+ C03F 7C                   ld a,h
 122+ C040 E6 3F                and GRID-1
 123+ C042 DD 77 03             ld (ix+3),a                     ; z cell
 124+ C045 CD 6C 27             call zmap_ptr
 125+ C048 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 126+ C049 E6 1F                and CELL_CODE
 127+ C04B 20 E9                jr nz,.try                      ; a building: pick again

   2++C7D8              ; Z-POLICE - the final boss: the devil (in the special monsters' page,
   3++C7D8              ; PAGE_SPECIAL, at $C000 in slot 6: specials.asm includes it)
   4++C7D8              ;
   5++C7D8              ; Quatermass's horned Martian, ten building levels tall (DEVIL_H, 46 m) and a
   6++C7D8              ; whole square wide, in the last wave of the last level (the level files:
   7++C7D8              ; SPEC_DEVIL, alone).  It rises at the entrance to hell (HELL_X, HELL_Z: a
   8++C7D8              ; circle of road the level's map changes make) or, if that isn't road, on a
   9++C7D8              ; street at random (zplace).  A special monster record (zombie.asm), type
  10++C7D8              ; ZT_DEVIL; drawn by devil_draw (city2.asm) from its own graphics, which go
  11++C7D8              ; over the other monsters' pages when its wave starts (wave_prepare,
  12++C7D8              ; devil_load: only the zombies and humans are drawn with it).
  13++C7D8              ;   * It walks the streets to the landing pad, half a tile a step
  14++C7D8              ;     (DV_STEP_FR frames each: moving for DV_MOVE_FR, then planted), every
  15++C7D8              ;     footfall shaking the view.  At a cell's middle it takes the way that
  16++C7D8              ;     brings it nearest the pad (not back the way it came unless it must);
  17++C7D8              ;     a terrace or pad tile it steps onto is crushed (base_damage: the pad,
  18++C7D8              ;     game over).
  19++C7D8              ;   * Its eyes charge, black to blue, wherever the VTOL is, for
  20++C7D8              ;     DV_CHARGE_T interrupts (10 s; a rising whine for the last DV_HUM_T,
  21++C7D8              ;     3 s: SFX_CHARGE), then it fires lightning (a crackling zap and
  22++C7D8              ;     thunder: SFX_BOLT): straight at the
  23++C7D8              ;     VTOL, instantly, through anything in the way.  A building the bolt
  24++C7D8              ;     passes below the roof of comes down (dv_topple: DV_PARTS particles,
  25++C7D8              ;     falling 1 m every 2 frames to RUBBLE_H; the humans on it killed; the
  26++C7D8              ;     map in memory only).  The VTOL takes BOLT_DMG, spins 15-90 degrees
  27++C7D8              ;     either way (spin_rate, spin_t: player.asm), is pitched full up or
  28++C7D8              ;     down, and is braked to a stop as the air brake does (bolt_brake).
  29++C7D8              ;     Then DV_REST_T interrupts (2 s) before it charges again.
  30++C7D8              ;   * DEVIL_HP hit points (16 bits, as a lich's: +18 and LICH_HP_HI); its
  31++C7D8              ;     hit box DEVIL_HIT_R either side, DEVIL_H tall (weapons.asm).  Killed,
  32++C7D8              ;     it sinks into the ground over DV_DIE_FR frames in fire, then it's gone.
  33++C7D8              ; Its record, besides the zombies' fields: +4 heading (0 +z, 1 +x, 2 -z,
  34++C7D8              ; 3 -x), +5 its legs' frame, +7 1: stuck (nowhere to go), +11 the frame in
  35++C7D8              ; its step, +16 mode (0 walking, GM_DYING), +17 frames left sinking,
  36++C7D8              ; +21,+22 its feet (below the ground as it sinks), DV_EYES (0 resting,
  37++C7D8              ; 1 charging) and DV_T0 (game_now when that began).
  38++C7D8              ;==============================================================================
  39++C7D8
  40++C7D8              DEVIL_HP        equ 10
  41++C7D8              DV_STEP_FR      equ 24              ; frames a step
  42++C7D8              DV_MOVE_FR      equ 16              ; moving for this many of them
  43++C7D8              DV_STEP_U       equ TILE_UNITS/2/DV_MOVE_FR     ; units a frame (half a tile a step)
  44++C7D8                      ASSERT DV_STEP_U * DV_MOVE_FR == TILE_UNITS/2
  45++C7D8              DV_RANGE        equ 8*TILE_UNITS    ; it fires at the VTOL this near (160 m)
  46++C7D8              DV_CHARGE_T     equ 500             ; interrupts charging (10 s),
  47++C7D8              DV_HUM_T        equ 150             ;   the last of them whining (3 s: SFX_CHARGE)
  48++C7D8              DV_REST_T       equ 100             ; and resting after a shot (2 s)
  49++C7D8              BOLT_DMG        equ 10
  50++C7D8              ; The storm after its death (dv_storm): STORM_T ticks of lightning from
  51++C7D8              ; where it sank, into the sky and at the buildings around (within
  52++C7D8              ; STORM_R cells each way: they come down), NSTORM bolts at most at once,
  53++C7D8              ; a new one every STORM_GAP..STORM_GAP+3 ticks at first, slowing as it
  54++C7D8              ; goes (+1 tick each 16 ticks of it: about 35 at the end), each drawn
  55++C7D8              ; STORM_BOLT_T; the view shaking all through, a jolt at each
  56++C7D8              STORM_T         equ 500             ; 10 s
  57++C7D8              STORM_R         equ 4
  58++C7D8              STORM_GAP       equ 4
  59++C7D8              STORM_BOLT_T    equ 10

  66++C7D8              DEVIL_AIM_H     equ 240             ;   DEVIL_H tall; the guns' aim: its chest

  72++C7D8              DV_KILL_PARTS   equ 2               ; each monster dying with it: its burst

# file opened: zombie.asm
   1+ 2000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 2000              ; Z-POLICE - zombie page (8K page PAGE_ZOMBIE, mapped at $2000 in MMU slot 1)
   3+ 2000              ;
   4+ 2000              ; Placeholder zombies: Layer 2 stick-man silhouettes walking the streets.
   5+ 2000              ; The page stays mapped at $2000 the whole time (slot 0 is used for paging
   6+ 2000              ; Layer 2 sections, slot 7 for the other code pages), so the city page can
   7+ 2000              ; call in here while it draws.
   8+ 2000              ;
   9+ 2000              ; Each zombie is a ZREC-byte record:
  10+ 2000              ;   +0,+1  x  8.8 fixed point in cell units (high byte = cell, low = fraction;
  11+ 2000              ;             the same as world units, one cell = 256)
  12+ 2000              ;   +2,+3  z  likewise
  13+ 2000              ;   +4     heading 0 = +z, 1 = +x, 2 = -z, 3 = -x  (yaw angle = heading*64;
  14+ 2000              ;             heading+1 turns right, heading+3 turns left)
  15+ 2000              ;   +5     walk animation phase 0..3
  16+ 2000              ;   +6     step accumulator: fraction of a world unit (4 bits)
  17+ 2000              ;   +7     wait: frames left standing still (0 = walking)
  18+ 2000              ;   +8,+9  cell (x, z) of the last turn decision ($FF = none)
  19+ 2000              ;   +10    active: 1 = in play, 0 = gone (not moved, linked or drawn)
  20+ 2000              ;   +11    frames until this zombie's next decision check
  21+ 2000              ;   +12,+13  cell (x, z) of its blip on the street map
  22+ 2000              ;   +14    1 = blip plotted
  23+ 2000              ;   +15    type: 0 = zombie, 1 = fast zombie (walks at twice the speed),
  24+ 2000              ;          ZT_GHOUL (a special: 5x, half height), ZT_LICH (a special: 4x,
  25+ 2000              ;          twice the height), ZT_GHOST, ZT_BANSHEE
  26+ 2000              ;   +16    mode: 0 = walking, 1 = going for a base tile, 2 = attacking it
  27+ 2000              ;   +17    frames to its next hit on the tile
  28+ 2000              ;   +18    hit points left (ZHP, ZHP_FAST; weapons.asm zdamage)
  29+ 2000              ;   +19,+20  cell (x, z) marked with CELL_ZOMBIE in city_map ($FF = none)
  30+ 2000              ;   +21,+22  height of its feet (0 for zombies; special monsters fly)
  31+ 2000              ;   +23..+30 special monsters' own fields (specials.asm)
  32+ 2000              ;   +31    bit 0: drawn last frame (fig_seen; moved to bit 1 by lk_clear,
  33+ 2000              ;          weapons.asm); bit 1: so, once the missile lock has used bit 0, for
  34+ 2000              ;          the guns (aim_assist)
  35+ 2000              ;   +32,+33  where: the centre column and row on the view (the missile lock)
  36+ 2000              ; Records 0..NZOMB-1 are the zombies, NZOMB..NMON-1 the special monsters
  37+ 2000              ; (specials.asm), which share the drawing, cell marks, map blips and weapon
  38+ 2000              ; hits; their type (+15) says which.
  39+ 2000              ; zatk_flags (one byte per zombie, by index): TRUE while it attacks a base
  40+ 2000              ; tile, when its map dot is red; FALSE again once the tile is destroyed.
  41+ 2000              ;
  42+ 2000              ; The base: at junctions a zombie leans towards the road that points at the
  43+ 2000              ; landing pad (zbias_t, from the level).  A base tile (terrace or pad) in its
  44+ 2000              ; way isn't avoided: it walks up to ATTACK_R from it and hits it every
  45+ 2000              ; ZHIT_FRAMES frames.  A destroyed terrace tile becomes road and the zombie
  46+ 2000              ; walks on; the pad destroyed sets game_over.
  47+ 2000              ;
  48+ 2000              ; Street map blips: zblip / zblip_off (map.asm) are called on the zombie's
  49+ 2000              ; decision-check frames.  Call zblip_off for a zombie before making it gone.
  50+ 2000              ;
  51+ 2000              ; Decisions are taken one record a frame: zdec_i steps through the records
  52+ 2000              ; (0..NMON-1, round: zombies, then the special records, where ghouls and a
  53+ 2000              ; lich walk too), and only the record it points at decides this frame (an
  54+ 2000              ; empty one: nobody does).  So each walker decides once every NMON frames.
  55+ 2000              ; A decision: its map blip moves, junctions (zjunction), and a look-ahead
  56+ 2000              ; for a building or the map edge (zlook: ZMARGIN + zsteps frames of
  57+ 2000              ; walking; a smart turn, towards the pad, or a dead end's wait).
  58+ 2000              ; Between decisions every step is checked (zmove .step): a step that would
  59+ 2000              ; take it within ZMARGIN of the next cell, when that cell isn't a street,
  60+ 2000              ; isn't taken.  A base tile there: it goes for it (zattack); else it stops
  61+ 2000              ; and turns 90 degrees, left or right at random (zturn).  Crossing into a
  62+ 2000              ; new cell moves its map blip too.
  63+ 2000              ;
  64+ 2000              ; Movement (zmove), every frame:
  65+ 2000              ;   * Standing still: count the wait down and do nothing else.
  66+ 2000              ;   * Not this zombie's check frame: step forwards (see the last point).
  67+ 2000              ;   * Junctions: once per cell, when the zombie is 0.25-0.75 of the way
  68+ 2000              ;     through the cell along its heading, look for a road (street cell) to
  69+ 2000              ;     the left and to the right.  Left is tested first: if there is a road,
  70+ 2000              ;     turn left at random (1 in 2); if not taken, the same for the right.
  71+ 2000              ;     The cell is then marked as decided, so it isn't tested again until the
  72+ 2000              ;     zombie has been somewhere else.
  73+ 2000              ;   * Blocked (building or map edge within zlook ahead): turn left if there
  74+ 2000              ;     is a road there, else right; otherwise turn round and stand still for
  75+ 2000              ;     ZWAIT frames before testing anything again.
  76+ 2000              ;   * Otherwise step forwards zspeed/16 world units (the remainder is kept,
  77+ 2000              ;     so slow speeds still move smoothly on average).
  78+ 2000              ;
  79+ 2000              ; Zombies are only ever on street (empty) cells.  They are drawn by the city
  80+ 2000              ; traversal when it reaches their cell (draw_cell jumps to zombie_cell for
  81+ 2000              ; empty cells), so the painter's algorithm hides them behind nearer buildings.
  82+ 2000              ; A cell holding zombies has bit 7 (CELL_ZOMBIE) of its city_map byte set,
  83+ 2000              ; by zflags every frame; zombie_cell then searches the records for them.
  84+ 2000              ;
  85+ 2000              ; Sprites (tables_zombie.inc, generated): 8 scales from 1x4 to 8x16 pixels,
  86+ 2000              ; forward and left facings, 4 walk frames.  Rear and right are the mirrored
  87+ 2000              ; forward and left.  One byte per row, bit 7 = leftmost pixel.
  88+ 2000              ;==============================================================================
  89+ 2000
  90+ 2000              NZOMB           equ 40          ; zombie records: the most in a wave
  91+ 2000              NSPEC           equ 8           ; most special monsters (5 ghosts, banshees)
  92+ 2000              NMON            equ NZOMB+NSPEC ; records: zombies, then special monsters
  93+ 2000              ZREC            equ 34          ; bytes per record
  94+ 2000              ZT_FAST         equ 1           ; +15: fast zombie
  95+ 2000              ZT_GHOUL        equ 2           ; +15: a ghoul: a special monster that walks
  96+ 2000                                              ; as a zombie (zmove), half height, 5x speed
  97+ 2000              ZT_LICH         equ 3           ; +15: a lich, a city's boss: a special
  98+ 2000                                              ; monster that walks as a zombie (zmove),
  99+ 2000                                              ; twice the height, 4x speed; it shoots
 100+ 2000                                              ; fireballs (lich_update, weapons.asm)
 101+ 2000              ZT_GHOST        equ 4           ; +15: a ghost (specials.asm); types from
 102+ 2000              ZT_BANSHEE      equ 5           ; here on fly (specials.asm moves them)
 103+ 2000              ZT_DEVIL        equ 6           ; +15: the final boss (devil.asm), drawn by
 104+ 2000                                              ; devil_draw (city2.asm)
 105+ 2000              ZHP             equ 5           ; hit points: a zombie (level 1)
 106+ 2000              ZHP_FAST        equ 4           ; and a fast zombie
 107+ 2000              GHOUL_HP        equ ZHP         ; and a ghoul
 108+ 2000              ZSPEED_INIT     equ 10          ; starting zspeed: 0.63 units (4.9 cm) per
 109+ 2000                                              ; frame, ~0.7 m/s at 14 fps
 110+ 2000              ZSTEPS_INIT     equ 10          ; zsteps: a decision looks 10 frames' walk
 111+ 2000                                              ; ahead (decisions: one record a frame,
 112+ 2000                                              ; zdec_i)
 113+ 2000              ZMARGIN         equ 16          ; keep at least this far from walls: 1.25 m
 114+ 2000              ZC_TRIES        equ 16          ; zcluster: places to try near the parent
 115+ 2000              ZC_R            equ 2*TILE_UNITS ;  within 2 tiles of it on x and z
 116+ 2000                      ASSERT 383+128 <= ZC_R          ; (zc_axis)
 117+ 2000              ZWAIT           equ 100         ; frames' worth to stand still when stuck
 118+ 2000              ZOMBIE_H        equ 26          ; height: 2 m (the same as the hit box, ZHIT_H)
 119+ 2000              GHOUL_H         equ ZOMBIE_H/2  ; a ghoul's height: 1 m
 120+ 2000              LICH_H          equ 2*ZOMBIE_H  ; a lich's height: 4 m
 121+ 2000                      ASSERT LICH_H == FIG_LICH_H     ; (gfx_ids.inc)
 122+ 2000                      ASSERT ZSPEED_INIT*5+15 < 256   ; a ghoul's step (zcalc_step) fits
 123+ 2000

 126+ 2000              ; Seed NZOMB zombies at random street positions, away from building walls

   1+ 313C              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 313C              ; Z-POLICE - humans to rescue (in the zombie page, after zombie.asm: kept
   3+ 313C              ; mapped in slot 1)
   4+ 313C              ;
   5+ 313C              ; Up to HUMAN_MAX humans, nhumans of them placed at random at start-up (on a
   6+ 313C              ; road, or on a roof low enough to land on).  They stand facing the player,
   7+ 313C              ; and wave their right arm while the VTOL is within WAVE_R.  On the city map
   8+ 313C              ; each is a blue dot, flashing 3 frames on, 3 off.
   9+ 313C              ;
  10+ 313C              ; Fleeing (hum_flee): a human on the road (never one on a roof) with a
  11+ 313C              ; monster within FLEE_R runs from the nearest one for FLEE_TIME frames, at
  12+ 313C              ; HUMAN_FLEE units a frame, then looks again.  Its way is picked at random
  13+ 313C              ; of the two that take it away from the monster (along x or along z); if
  14+ 313C              ; that way is blocked (a building, the base, the wall) it takes the other,
  15+ 313C              ; and if both are, it stands.  It only runs along roads.
  16+ 313C              ;
  17+ 313C              ; Base: landed on the landing pad (map code PAD_CODE), the passengers get off
  18+ 313C              ; one every DISEMBARK frames (a second) and are counted as saved.
  19+ 313C              ;
  20+ 313C              ; Rescue: when the craft has landed (speed 0, resting on the road or on the
  21+ 313C              ; roof under it), carries fewer than PASSENGER_MAX and a human stands within
  22+ 313C              ; RESCUE_R at the same height (a roof of the same height, or the road), the
  23+ 313C              ; human runs to it at HUMAN_RUN units a frame and climbs in.  A human on a
  24+ 313C              ; taller or lower roof cannot be reached.
  25+ 313C              ;
  26+ 313C              ; Each human is an HREC-byte record:
  27+ 313C              ;   +0,+1  x  (world units: high byte = cell, as for zombies)
  28+ 313C              ;   +2,+3  z
  29+ 313C              ;   +4,+5  y  height of its feet (roof height, or 0 on the road)
  30+ 313C              ;   +6     state (HS_*): 0 unused, 1 waiting in the city, 2 aboard the
  31+ 313C              ;          VTOL, 3 rescued (off at the landing pad), 4 dead
  32+ 313C              ;   +7,+8  cell (x, z) of its map dot
  33+ 313C              ;   +9     1 = map dot shown
  34+ 313C              ;   +10    hit points left (HUMAN_HP; a rocket blast, weapons.asm)
  35+ 313C              ;   +11,+12  cell (x, z) marked with CELL_HUMAN in city_map ($FF = none)
  36+ 313C              ;   +13    how it's drawn this frame: 0 standing, HUM_WAVING waving, or
  37+ 313C              ;          running (to the VTOL, or fleeing): its way + 1 (1 +z, 2 +x,
  38+ 313C              ;          3 -z, 4 -x, as a zombie's heading + 1)
  39+ 313C              ;   +14    fleeing: frames left (0: not fleeing)
  40+ 313C              ;   +15    fleeing: its way + 1 (as +13)
  41+ 313C              ;
  42+ 313C              ; Drawing: draw_cell (city page) tests the cell's CELL_HUMAN mark in
  43+ 313C              ; city_map (bit 6, set by hum_flags) and draws them with human_cell: after
  44+ 313C              ; the building on whose roof they stand, so the roof doesn't cover them.  With
  45+ 313C              ; OCCLUSION_CULL the cell goes on the draw list instead (as its city_col
  46+ 313C              ; address, $6000-$6FFF) and is drawn from there.
  47+ 313C              ;==============================================================================
  48+ 313C
  49+ 313C              HREC            equ 16
  50+ 313C              HUM_WAVING      equ 5               ; +13: waving (above the 4 ways)
  51+ 313C              HS_NONE         equ 0               ; human states (+6)

  53+ 313C              HS_ABOARD       equ 2               ; aboard the VTOL
  54+ 313C              HS_SAVED        equ 3               ; rescued: off at the landing pad
  55+ 313C              HS_DEAD         equ 4               ; killed (a rocket blast, a ghost)

   1+ 39C1              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 39C1              ; Z-POLICE - interrupt mode 2 (in the zombie page, after map.asm: kept
   3+ 39C1              ; mapped in slot 1, so the table and routine are there whatever page is
   4+ 39C1              ; swapped in; the ROM replaces slot 1 only during esxDOS calls, when
   5+ 39C1              ; interrupts are off)
   6+ 39C1              ;
   7+ 39C1              ; In IM 2 an interrupt calls the address held in the word at I*256 + the
   8+ 39C1              ; byte on the data bus, which can be anything.  So:
   9+ 39C1              ;   * im2_table is 256 words, every one the address of im2_routine, at a
  10+ 39C1              ;     256-byte boundary (I holds the high byte of its address): any bus
  11+ 39C1              ;     byte, even $FF (bytes $FF and $100), reads a word inside it;
  12+ 39C1              ;   * an odd bus byte reads a word that straddles two entries, low byte
  13+ 39C1              ;     from one and high byte from the next, so im2_routine sits at an
  14+ 39C1              ;     address whose high and low bytes are the same (IM2_ROUTINE, $xyxy):
  15+ 39C1              ;     read either way round, it's the same address.
  16+ 39C1              ; im2_init sets I and IM 2 (start calls it after init_audio); start enables
  17+ 39C1              ; interrupts just before the main menu, and they stay on, 50 a second, except:
  18+ 39C1              ;   * over esxDOS calls (fh_rom_in / fh_rom_out): the ROM covers slot 1, this
  19+ 39C1              ;     page, so they are off and put back as they were;
  20+ 39C1              ;   * the span filler borrows SP (city.asm: PUSHes into Layer 2, slot 0).  An
  21+ 39C1              ;     interrupt there pushes its return address just below SP: into the
  22+ 39C1              ;     part of the span still to be filled, which the PUSHes then overwrite.
  23+ 39C1              ;     Interrupts are off from just before a span's last PUSH until SP is
  24+ 39C1              ;     back (push_blk), and a 1-pixel span doesn't borrow SP at all.
  25+ 39C1              ; The routine switches to its own stack at once, keeps every register, and
  26+ 39C1              ; touches the AY ports only while the engines are on (eng_on): code outside
  27+ 39C1              ; the interrupt writes the AY chips only with eng_on 0 (init_audio,
  28+ 39C1              ; engine_start).  Then it also borrows slot 7 for the sound page, and the
  29+ 39C1              ; NextReg ports ($243B, $253B) to find what's there: both put back as they
  30+ 39C1              ; were (the selected NextReg too).
  31+ 39C1              ;==============================================================================
  32+ 39C1
  33+ 39C1              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  34+ 39C1              ; Point I at the vector table and select interrupt mode 2.  (start enables
  35+ 39C1              ; interrupts later.)
  36+ 39C1              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  37+ 39C1              im2_init:
  38+ 39C1 3E 3A                ld a,high im2_table
  39+ 39C3 ED 47                ld i,a
  40+ 39C5 ED 5E                im 2
  41+ 39C7 C9                   ret
  42+ 39C8

  50+ 3C00              IM2_ROUTINE     equ ((high im2_table)+2)*$101

  53+ 3C3C
  54+ 3C3C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  55+ 3C3C              ; The interrupt routine, each video frame (50 a second): a tick counted
  56+ 3C3C              ; (isr_ticks), and with the engines on (eng_on), the engines' sound
  57+ 3C3C              ; (engine_tick) and the sound effects (sfx_tick): in the audio page
  58+ 3C3C              ; (sound.asm), mapped into slot 7 meanwhile and the page there put back
  59+ 3C3C              ; after.  The page there is read through the NextReg ports, so the main
  60+ 3C3C              ; code's selected NextReg ($243B, which it may have set and not yet read
  61+ 3C3C              ; or written through $253B) is read first and put back last.  On its own stack: SP may
  62+ 3C3C              ; be the span filler's.  It must never use the alternate registers (EXX,
  63+ 3C3C              ; EX AF,AF'): the city's cell walks keep their place in HL', DE' across
  64+ 3C3C              ; the whole drawing (draw_row, city.asm).
  65+ 3C3C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ 3C3C              im2_routine:
  67+ 3C3C ED 73 9B 3C          ld (isr_sp),sp                  ; its own stack at once (no PUSH on
  68+ 3C40 31 BF 3C             ld sp,isr_stack                 ; a borrowed one)
  69+ 3C43 F5                   push af
  70+ 3C44 C5                   push bc
  71+ 3C45 D5                   push de
  72+ 3C46 E5                   push hl
  73+ 3C47 2A 9D 3C             ld hl,(isr_ticks)               ; the frames counted (wave_prepare)
  74+ 3C4A 23                   inc hl
  75+ 3C4B 22 9D 3C             ld (isr_ticks),hl
  76+ 3C4E 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)                   ; nothing to play: the AYs alone
  77+ 3C51 B7                   or a
  78+ 3C52 28 2A                jr z,.out
  79+ 3C54 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; the NextReg the main code has
  80+ 3C57 ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; selected (it may be between its OUT
  81+ 3C59 32 99 3C             ld (isr_sel),a                  ; and its IN): put back after
  82+ 3C5C 3E 57                ld a,CODE_MMU                   ; slot 7's page, to put back after
  83+ 3C5E ED 79                out (c),a
  84+ 3C60 04                   inc b
  85+ 3C61 ED 78                in a,(c)
  86+ 3C63 32 9A 3C             ld (isr_mmu7),a
  87+ 3C66 ED 91 57 11          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO     ; the sound page (sound.asm)
  88+ 3C6A CD 75 E0             call engine_tick
  89+ 3C6D CD 27 E1             call sfx_tick
  90+ 3C70 3A 9A 3C             ld a,(isr_mmu7)                 ; slot 7 as it was,
  91+ 3C73 ED 92 57             nextreg CODE_MMU,a
  92+ 3C76 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; and the NextReg selection
  93+ 3C79 3A 99 3C             ld a,(isr_sel)
  94+ 3C7C ED 79                out (c),a
  95+ 3C7E E1           .out:   pop hl
  96+ 3C7F D1                   pop de
  97+ 3C80 C1                   pop bc
  98+ 3C81 F1                   pop af
  99+ 3C82 ED 7B 9B 3C          ld sp,(isr_sp)
 100+ 3C86 FB                   ei
 101+ 3C87 ED 4D                reti
 102+ 3C89                      ASSERT im2_routine == IM2_ROUTINE
 103+ 3C89                      ASSERT high im2_routine == low im2_routine

2847  0200              ; Sprite pattern banks, swapped into slot 7 ($E000) while they load
2848  0200                      MMU SPRBANK_SLOT e, PAGE_SPR0, SPRBANK_ADDR
2849  E000                      ORG SPRBANK_ADDR
2850  E000                      INCLUDE "sprite_data.asm"
# file opened: sprite_data.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - sprite pattern banks (8K pages, assembled at $E000)
   3+ E000              ;
   4+ E000              ; Hardware sprite patterns are only needed when they are loaded into the
   5+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory, so they live in their own pages, out of the way,
   6+ E000              ; each with its own loader so that no resident memory is used:
   7+ E000              ;
   8+ E000              ;       nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPR0      ; the bank into slot 7
   9+ E000              ;       call spr_load_bank              ; copy its patterns
  10+ E000              ;
  11+ E000              ; Call it from outside slot 7 (resident code or a game logic page in slot
  12+ E000              ; 6), and page back whatever slot 7 had afterwards if it is still needed.
  13+ E000              ; spr_load_bank is the same address ($E000) in every bank.
  14+ E000              ;
  15+ E000              ; Each bank (SPRBANK_ADDR = $E000):
  16+ E000              ;   +0          spr_load_bank: the loader (SPRB_LOADER), the same in each
  17+ E000              ;   SPRB_COUNT  number of patterns (1..31: 256 bytes each, 8-bit 16x16)
  18+ E000              ;   SPRB_FIRST  the pattern number the first one loads to (0..63)
  19+ E000              ;   SPRB_DATA   the patterns, one after another
  20+ E000              ; More sprites: add a bank (the next free page, its own PAGE_SPRn in
  21+ E000              ; memory_bank_defs.asm, the MMU / ORG lines in zpolice.asm and a block here
  22+ E000              ; starting with SPRB_LOADER).
  23+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  24+ E000
  25+ E000              ; Copy this bank's patterns into the sprite pattern memory.  Runs from the
  26+ E000              ; bank itself: reads only, so it needs no variables.
  27+ E000                      MACRO SPRB_LOADER
  28+ E000 ~                    ld a,(SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_FIRST)  ; from this pattern
  29+ E000 ~                    ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
  30+ E000 ~                    out (c),a
  31+ E000 ~                    ld a,(SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_COUNT)
  32+ E000 ~                    ld d,a
  33+ E000 ~                    ld hl,SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_DATA
  34+ E000 ~                    ld c,SPR_PAT_PORT
  35+ E000 ~            .lp:    ld b,0                          ; 256 bytes a pattern
  36+ E000 ~                    otir
  37+ E000 ~                    dec d
  38+ E000 ~                    jr nz,.lp
  39+ E000 ~                    ret
  40+ E000                      ENDM
  41+ E000
  42+ E000              spr_load_bank   equ SPRBANK_ADDR        ; the loader, in every bank
  43+ E000              SPRB_COUNT      equ spr_bank0_hdr-spr_bank0
  44+ E000              SPRB_FIRST      equ SPRB_COUNT+1
  45+ E000              SPRB_DATA       equ SPRB_COUNT+2
  46+ E000
  47+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48+ E000              ; Bank 0 (PAGE_SPR0): the human status sprites (patterns 0-3), then the
  49+ E000              ; compass bar's letters, dots and pointer (CSPR_*, hud_sprites.asm)
  50+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm maps PAGE_SPR0 to SPRBANK_SLOT, ORG SPRBANK_ADDR, first)
  51+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  52+ E000              spr_bank0:
  53+ E000                      SPRB_LOADER
  53+ E000 3A 1A E0    >        ld a,(SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_FIRST)  ; from this pattern
  53+ E003 01 3B 30    >        ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
  53+ E006 ED 79       >        out (c),a
  53+ E008 3A 19 E0    >        ld a,(SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_COUNT)
  53+ E00B 57          >        ld d,a
  53+ E00C 21 1B E0    >        ld hl,SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_DATA
  53+ E00F 0E 5B       >        ld c,SPR_PAT_PORT

  53+ E013 ED B3       >        otir
